name: Cold Splash
title: Cold Splash
description:
An extra cold burst of water wraps around an enemy within 5 Range, dealing Ice magic damage to them.

Aquae Crest: If LV 9 or higher, has an infliction-based chance to cause Frozen LV100 for 3 rounds. If successful, consumes 9 LV.

name: Dancing Water
title: Dancing Water
description:
Animate water in a tile within 6 Range, creating an attackable Dancing Tentacle there (LV based on duration and Rank).

Aquae Crest: If LV 5 or higher, +2 duration, +20 HP.

Dancing Tentacle

This is a special effect tile created by Aquamancer skills. At the start of a new round, it will attempt to attack an enemy within its attack range (1 Range if not on a Flooded Water or Dark Water tile, 2 Range otherwise), dealing damage to them that ignores evasion equal to its LV (Water damage by default, Dark damage if on Dark Water). It also has a chance to inflict Slow LV 2 (if not on water) or Immobilize (if on water) to the damaged enemy for 2 rounds.

When created, if there are any monsters in its attack range, it will attack one.

name: Jet Stream
title: Jet Stream
description:
Engulf an enemy within 6 Range in a strong spinning water torrent, dealing Water magic damage and knocking them back by 1 tile.

Aquae Crest: If LV 3 or higher, the knockback is increased to 3 tiles.

name: Steam Sear
title: Steam Sear
description:
Target a tile containing Flooded Water or Dark Water, or a unit with Soaked or Frozen status and quickly heats the water, causing it to evaporate rapidly. Ends Flooded Water, Soaked, and Frozen on that tile, and if an enemy, then deals Fire magic damage to them. It may also inflict Burn LV X (X = Rank * 5) for 3 rounds.

Aquae Crest: If LV 5 or higher, +10% Status Infliction and +25% damage to Jammer enemies.

name: Water Dragon
title: Water Dragon
description:
Summon a Water Dragon projectile in a 4-6 line within 3 Range, piercing enemies and dealing Water magic damage to them, and healing the HP of allies it passes over. It will then collapse into Flooded Water for 3 rounds.

Aquae Crest: If LV 3 or higher, all enemies hit will be Soaked for 3 rounds.

name: Water Pillar
title: Water Pillar
description:
Summons a fountain of water from underneath an enemy within 6 Range, dealing Water magic damage to them and knocking them Airborne, as well as ending any Proximity Effects involving them.

Aquae Crest: If LV 3 or higher, the target is also Soaked for 3 rounds.

name: Wild Waterfall
title: Wild Waterfall
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation.

Targets a 2-Size Circle up to 5 Range away and causes water to rush down enemies in that location, dealing Water magic damage, knocking them down, and creating Flooded Water tiles for 3 rounds.

Aquae Crest: If LV 3 or higher, also inflicts Soaked for 3 rounds.

name: Ring of Pearls
title: Ring of Pearls
description:
Surround yourself with an enchanted ring of magical pearls for 5 rounds. While active, the pearls will intercept attacks, boosting your Evade (based on Rank), as well as increasing your success rate when Convert Enemy effects are applied to sea-faring races. In addition, at a chance equal to 30% + (half of Scaled SKI), the pearls may parry attacks made by swords, axes, spears, and fists, reducing their damage by 25% as well as increasing your success rate when Convert Enemy effects are applied to sea-faring races.

Aquae Crest: If LV 5 or higher, all enemies in 2 Range are knocked back 3 tiles.

name: Water Wall
title: Water Wall
description:
Summons water from the ground into a 1-3 Range horizontal wall at a location within 4 Range for 3 rounds (any enemies in those tiles are knocked back 1 tile). The wall is dense enough to prevent units and projectiles from moving through it. When it ends, the wall will collapse into Flooded Water for 3 rounds.

Aquae Crest: If LV 2 or higher, the duration of the wall is increased by 2 rounds.

name: Brine Blade
title: Brine Blade
description:
Enchants a target ally's weapons within 5 Range with a biting torrent for 3 rounds. While active, their basic attacks will deal Water magic bonus damage equal to a percentage of your Water ATK (based on Rank).

Aquae Crest: If LV 3 or higher, consumes 3 levels and extends the duration to 5 rounds.

name: Ensui Veil
title: Ensui Veil
description:
Creates a protective bubble, like that of a legendary water dragon's, around an ally within 5 Range for 3 rounds. The bubble increases the target's Armor and Magic Armor by LV X (X = Rank), Fire Resistance equal to LV * 3%, and Burn status resistance by LV * 5%.

Aquae Crest: If LV 6 or higher, LV increases by 1 and duration by 2 rounds, and can cure Burn effects from the target.

name: Purifying Aquae
title: Purifying Aquae
description:
Targets 1 ally within 5 Range and rushes them with purifying divine waters which wash away impurities. Reduces the duration of the negative status effect with the highest LV that was caused by an enemy by X (X = Rank) rounds. Does not affect status effects which are immune to curing. (Via Hex, etc.)

Aquae Crest: If LV 9 or higher, consumes 6 levels and affects all negative status effects caused by enemies instead.

name: Refreshing Flow
title: Refreshing Flow
description:
Targets 1 ally in 5 Range and surrounds them with magically-enchanted waters which heal wounds slowly. That ally gains Refreshing Flow LV X (based on Rank) for 3 rounds, which increases HP Regeneration by its LV.

Aquae Crest: If LV 3 or higher, consumes 3 levels and restores their HP immediately equal to Refreshing Flow's LV.

name: Sea Stride
title: Sea Stride
description:
Targets 1 ally in 5 Range and instills them with the magical instincts of the sea for 3 rounds. While active, Sea Stride lets them ignore the movement penalties of Flooded Water, and they will not trigger tile effects.

Aquae Crest: If LV 6 or higher, duration is increased by 2 rounds.

name: Call Storm
title: Call Storm
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation.

Creates a localized Rainstorm on the battlefield for 5 rounds. If your Rainstorm is already active, its duration is extended by 5 rounds, and it gains additional effects.

Aquae Crest: If Invoking the skill and LV 6 or higher, consumes 6 levels and refunds 3 Momentum.

Rainstorm

This is a weather-based battlefield effect. While active, Flooded Water tiles do not lose duration when a new round occurs, and allies of the caster gain Water ATK. In addition, Aquamancer Support spells that target an ally will affect all allies instead (applies to all Aquamancers - not just the caster). The Rainstorm can also be powered up twice by casting the spell again:

name: Crest Surge
title: Crest Surge
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation.

Immediately imbue your focus into the Aquae Crest, increasing its LV to 9. In addition, you gain a status for 5 rounds, which regenerates 1 LV of Aquae Crest at the start of a new round.

name: Dead Sea
title: Dead Sea
description:
Flick your hand and release droplets of water that quickly expand. Targets a 2-Size Circle up to 5 Range away and creates Flooded Water tiles there for 3 rounds.

Aquae Crest: If LV 4 or higher, increases duration by 1 round. (If Dark Water, it instantly activates.)

name: Drowning Chant
title: Drowning Chant
description:
Sing a cursed song that fills a specific listener's mouth (within 5 Range) with water. Attempts to inflict Silence for 2 rounds on them, with a lower percentage of your Status Infliction, based on Rank. If successful, the song takes its toll, and you also inflict Silence on yourself for 2 rounds.

Aquae Crest: If LV 8 or higher, +10% Status Infliction, and if successful, consumes 8 levels for +1 duration (enemy only).

name: Water to Wine
title: Water to Wine
description:
Influence water a 2-Size Circle up to 5 Range away, causing all Flooded Water and Dark Water in those tiles to evaporate into an Intoxicating Mist for 3 rounds.

Aquae Crest: If LV 5 or higher, consumes 3 levels and +1 duration to status effects caused by the mist.

name: Aquae Crest
title: Aquae Crest
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description:
A magical crest of governing water. The crest fills with magical energy by casting Aquamancer spells, increasing its LV by 1 (max. 9). Aquamancer skills interact with the Aquae Crest by gaining bonus effects if its LV is high enough, sometimes by consuming some of its levels.

Your Water ATK is increased by the crest's LV.

name: Aquae Mastery
title: Aquae Mastery
description: A true display of aquatic mastery. If Aquae Crest is equipped, you begin the battle with Aquae Crest levels equal to Rank. If Aquamancer is both your main class and sub class, you start with double the amount instead.

name: Healing Aqua
title: Healing Aqua
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Sustained by the power of the Aquae Crest, the Aquamancer's healing is accelerated. At the start of battle, grants a permanent (but dispellable) buff that grants HP Regeneration equal to Aquae Crest LV.

name: Servant of a Dark Authority
title: Servant of a Dark Authority
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: The Aquamancer is not necessarily a force of purity; sometimes, they may worship or serve something 'darker'. While equipped, changes the functionality of most Aquamancer spells:

name: Voyager of Rough Waters
title: Voyager of Rough Waters
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: The owner of this skill is familiar with traversing water as easily as land. Ignore the movement penalty caused by walking on Flooded Water.

name: Crest Break
title: Crest Break
description: Overwhelm enemies with arcane power, thanks to your Aquae Crest. When Aquae Crest LV is at 9, you ignore 10% of elemental resistance of enemies. If Aquamancer is both your main class and sub class, this effect is doubled.

name: Sea Hunter
title: Sea Hunter
description: There's always a bigger fish. For sea-faring enemies: +10% Damage Dealt, -10% Damage Taken. Also half effective versus Theno and Shaitan enemies.

name: Blowback Cannon
title: Blowback Cannon
description:
Arbalest Cannon skill.

Launches your Special Armament in a powerful burst. Targets a 5 size wide line in cardinal Direction from you, scatters certain field objects in those tiles, and all enemies in those tiles take Pierce damage (can critically hit), and are knocked back several tiles (based on Rank). Enemies who were within 3 range of you are also knocked down afterward.

name: Buster Cannon
title: Buster Cannon
description:
Arbalest Cannon skill.

Send your Special Armament forward to bust through enemies. Target a 5 size wide line in cardinal direction from you. All enemies in those tiles take Pierce damage (Based on Rank, plus a bonus equal to Special Armament's Power, can critically hit), and are inflicted with a Buster Cannon Lv30 for 3 rounds. Buster Cannon: Reduce Armor by LV and Phys. and Magic Defense by (Half of LV)%. Cannot be cleansed.

name: Chained Boomerang
title: Chained Boomerang
description:
Requires a special armament. Swing your armament toward an opponent, performing a basic attack on that enemy with it from up to 5 Range away with a penalty to Hit (based on Rank). An oiled chain will reduce the Momentum cost of this skill by 1.

Cannot be used while Special Armament is on cooldown.

name: Oil Chain
title: Oil Chain
description: You cover your armament's chain in oil for 5 rounds. If you use a cannon skill during this time, the friction of the chain will ignite the oil, dealing physical fire damage in a line (in the direction you are facing, or a line from you to the target for Straight cannon). It also leaves behind a burning trail for 2 rounds, which will deal fire damage equal to half that to any enemy that walks through it.

name: Straight Cannon
title: Straight Cannon
extras: Perform Basic attack with Special Armament
description:
Arbalest Cannon skill.

Raises your special armament and fires it at a target within 6 Range, performing a basic attack with a Hit penalty based on its Weight. If it hits, you also perform a basic attack with the Special armanent on the same target, which cannot miss but deals 50% normal damage.

name: Heavy Tackle
title: Heavy Tackle
description: Just run at them. That'll be a surprise. Targets 1 enemy within 1 range, and ram your shoulder into them, causing them to take Blunt physical damage equal to your battle weight, plus a bonus (based on rank). They are also knocked back by 1 tile for every 15 battle weight, and if they are knocked back +3 tiles, they trip and become knocked down. (This knockback ignores immunity effect.)

name: Mighty Wall
title: Mighty Wall
description: Engage defensive mode, becoming a mighty wall for the enemies to crash on. For 3 rounds, increases your DEF and RES by LV, parry skill activation chance by LV%, and grants immunity to knockback effects. Additionally, until your next turn, you gain Arbalest Countershot. (When attacked in melee range, except behind, counter-attack for 50% damage. Reduces cooldown of Special armament by 1 afterward.)

name: Deadly Aim
title: Deadly Aim
description: Inspires all allies in a 3-size circle, granting them bonuses to Hit and Critical damage based on Rank, for five rounds.

name: Chained Dog
title: Chained Dog
description: Targets 2 locations within 3 range. In location 1, there must be an enemy, and location 2 must be an unoccupied tile. Using a portion of your chain, you lasso the enemy in L1, who is then pulled X (X = rank) tiles toward L2. If the target was a non-boss monster, they are slammed into L2 instead. An oiled chain will reduce momentum cost of this skill by 1.

name: Chained Leap
title: Chained Leap
description: Throw a portion of your chain forward in a 5 size line, where it latches onto the first dense tile, field object or unit it encounters. You then pull yourself towards it. An oiled chain will reduce the momentum cost of this skill by 1.

name: Chained Whirlwind
title: Chained Whirlwind
description: Spin your chain around in a whirlwind, affecting all enemies in an X (based on rank) Size circle, pulling them towards you Y tiles (based on rank), an oiled chain wil reduce the momentum cost of this skill by 1. If Special Armanent is not on cooldown, for each enemy; Trickery - Performs a basic attack on that enemy with your armament that deals 50% damage (and does not trigger critical or on-hit)

name: Firing Posture
title: Firing Posture
description: Drop down into a position to take a more careful aim (Reactivate to cancel, refund 2M). While activate, you cannot move, but you gain +5 Hit, +2 Attack range with bow and gun weapon, and at the start of a new round, accelerate the cooldown of Special Armament by 1. Additionally, it increases the size or range of Cannon skills by 2, Great Accuracy, and applies their bonus effects even if they glance.

name: Shore Up
title: Shore Up
description: Spend a few moments to shore up your defense, and prepare for the next attack. Can only be used while the Special armament is on cooldown. Resets the Special Armament's cooldown, restore your HP (based on rank), and reduce the duration of random negative status effect caused by an enemy by 3 rounds.

name: Arbalest Specialist
title: Arbalest Specialist
extras: Does not take up a SP slot.
description: The character is used to close-range fight with disadvantageous weapons. While wearing heavy armor, the close quarters penalty for bow weapons is reduced by 10% (bringing it to 40% total hit penalty); This reduction is doubled if you are monoclassing.

name: Blazing Artillery
title: Blazing Artillery
extras: Does not take up a SP slot.
description: Ignite your arrows like the sun streaking across the sky. At the start of a new round, if you are wearing heavy armor, in firing posture and Special Armament is not on cooldown, you take 30 Fire bonus protection-ignoring damage and activate Weapon Autocharge.

name: Long Chain
title: Long Chain
extras: Does not take up a SP slot.
description: The chain used to secure your Special Armament is a bit longer than the standard. Increases the range/size (where applicable) for chained skills by 1, but also increases your battleweight by 10, as it's a bit heavier.

name: Violent Reaction
title: Violent Reaction
description: Utilize your power to cause the flames created by your chain's oil to destroy everything. When created, causes oil chain's fires to destroy Hardiness 1 Field Objects made by enemies, leaving behind a smokescreen Lv20 for 3 rounds if it does.

name: Accelerant
title: Accelerant
description: The Arbalest's oil becomes elemental reactive. Triggering Oil Chain's effect after a Cannon skill grants you Accelerant Lv X for 2 rounds. (Bow attacks made in melee range deal bonus elemental damage equal to Lv% of Elemental ATK. Gun attacks create an elemental burst in 3 range line from your position that deals bonus elemental damage equal to (75% of LV) of Elemental ATK.)

name: Control Inertia
title: Control Inertia
description: More used to dealing with heavy objects, the Arbalest is capable of easily calculating how that weight will affect their long-range shots. Reduces penalty by 1 (Doubled while in firing posture). Additionally, when using a cannon skill, enemies at your sides are pushed one tile in the direction you are facing before damage and other effects are applied.

name: Heavy Bow Mastery
title: Heavy Bow Mastery
description: By utilizing the increased bulk of their weapon, the Arbalest can fire shots harder than anybody else. Increases your Power with Bow weapons that have at least 20 Weight based on rank. They also have reduced Battle Weight equal to this skill's Rank.

name: Honed Shot
title: Honed Shot
description: A mastery-type skill that shows affinity with hitting your mark. Increases SKI passively. If at max Rank, SKI is further increased by +1.

name: Punching Shot
title: Punching Shot
description: When preforming an attack with a Bow Weapon, or using an arbalest skill that requires a bow, if you have a Special Armament. You ignores up to X armor of your enemy (based on Rank).

name: Special Armament
title: Special Armament
description:
Allows the Arbalest to equip any Sword, Axe, or Spear as a sub-weapon. When a weapon of one of those types (or any type if monoclassing Arbalest) is equipped a sub-weapon, it is fired when using Cannon skills. See Arbalest Cannon Skills for more details.

These skills have special requirements in order to be used; you must have a Bow or Rifle weapon in your main hand, and a sub-weapon of certain types (Sword, Axe, Spear) equipped.

After using one of these skills, you enter a Reloading state for 4 rounds. This is essentially a global cooldown for all Arbalest Cannon skills; they cannot be used until the cooldown ends. You may end it prematurely by using Shore Up.

While on cooldown, your sub-weapon will be inaccessible, as if it weren't equipped; you won't be able to use it with skills, and its item effects won't apply.

name: Aerial Razor
title: Aerial Razor
description:
Bow skill. Fire a razor sharp arrow with great force in a line. Deals Pierce physical damage and inflicts Aerial Razor for 3 rounds. An enemy at the very end of the line takes 1.25x damage.

If Dynamic Shooting is at Rank 2 or higher, the length of the line can be adjusted.

Fire - Creates Cinder tiles. Ice - Creates Ice Sheet tiles. Earth - Increases damage by Rank * 2. Wind - Increases range. Lightning - May lightning critical. Dark - Creates Darkness tiles. Light - Creates Photon tiles.

name: Cripple Arm
title: Cripple Arm
description: Bow/Gun skill. Performs a basic attack (only 1 Round for Guns), aiming at the arms (or facsimile) of a target within your weapon's attack range with a 20% penalty to Hit. If it hits, the target's STR and SKI are reduced by X (X = Rank), and have the use of any Hands slot item they have disabled for 3 rounds.

name: Cripple Leg
title: Cripple Leg
description: Bow/Gun skill. Performs a basic attack (only 1 Round for Guns), aiming at the legs (or facsimile) of a target within your weapon's attack range with a 20% penalty to Hit. If it hits, the target's CEL is reduced by X (based on Rank), their move is reduced by X, and they suffer a damage penalty to certain Kick skills equal to Y (based on Rank), for 3 rounds.

name: Entangle Trap
title: Entangle Trap
description: Places an entangle trap at an unoccupied square within 2 range for 3 turns. If an enemy walks within 2 cardinal squares of the trap, it triggers, which halts the triggerer's Movement action (if any), will cause all tiles in its Range to be covered in Thick Vines for 3 rounds, as well as dealing Earth physical damage to the one who triggered it.

name: Pulling Shot
title: Pulling Shot
description:
Bow skill. Fire an arrow tied to a rope, and use that rope to pull your target/fish in. Performs a basic attack on the target that deals bonus damage; if successful, the target is pulled towards you a number of squares based on Rank.

If Dynamic Shooting is at Rank 5 or higher, if the target is suffering from any status that decreases Move, they are inflicted with Knocked Down.

name: Snake Shot
title: Snake Shot
description:
Bow Skill. Fire an arrow coated with poison at the target, performing a basic attack on them. If it hits, the target takes armor-ignoring acid magic bonus damage and may be inflicted with Poison LV X for 3 rounds (based on Rank).

If Dynamic Shooting is at Rank 4 or higher, if the target is already Poisoned, this skill instead inflicts Snake Wrap by twisting a rope around their legs, which halves Move until your next turn.

name: Starbow
title: Starbow
extras: Can be empowered by Weapon Charges.
description:
A trickshot, launching several arrows into the air and raining them down long-range onto the targets. Deals Pierce physical damage to all within the Area of Effect. Additional ranks in the skill will increase its range.

If Dynamic Shooting is at Rank 3 or higher, the damage is increased by 35% of your Scaled SKI.

LV1 - +10% Damage per Charge Level

LV2 - Arrows explode after a short delay, dealing Fire magic bonus damage to all enemies in those tiles equal to 100% Fire ATK. You also attack any attackable field objects in those tiles.

LV3 - Ignores Evasion.

Any weapon that uses this skill can consume active Weapon Charges to gain these effects, depending on the amount consumed.

name: Warning Shot
title: Warning Shot
description:
Bow/Gun skill. Fire a warning shot at a target in your weapon's attack range, which doesn't deal any damage, but inflicts Fear on the target for (1+Rank) Rounds.

If Dynamic Shooting is at Rank 1 or higher, the frightened target also jumps away 1 tile.

name: Fortune Wind
title: Fortune Wind
description: A spell that protects the target in a wrap of wind. The target gains Evade equal to X (Based on Rank) + 50% the caster's Scaled LUC. Lasts for 5 rounds. If used on a target that already has the effect, the effect will end, but all enemies with 4 Range will take Wind magic damage equal to Wind ATK + 3x the Evade bonus and be knocked back 1 square. The caster will also be refunded for the second cast's FP cost.

name: Nest
title: Nest
description: Creates a Nest at target location for 5 rounds. The Nest will help hide whoever is inside of it from monsters, slightly reducing the priority at which most monsters would attack them. Furthermore, being inside of the Nest will grant a Defense bonus, and reduce the FP cost of all Archer skills by 25%.

name: Fire Arrows
title: Fire Arrows
description:
Special Arrows skill.

Fire Arrows deal Fire damage equal to Rank + (5*Rank)% of your Fire ATK, and have a chance to inflict Burn LV X. Being enchanted with Nerhaven improves the chance by 50%.

name: Gust Arrows
title: Gust Arrows
description:
Special Arrows skill.

Gust Arrows increase the range of your Bow attacks and skills that use Special Arrows by Rank. Being enchanted by Talvyd will cause enemies hit by the arrows to be knocked back 1 tile from you.

name: Ice Arrows
title: Ice Arrows
description:
Special Arrows skill.

Ice Arrows deal Ice damage equal to Rank + (5*Rank)% of your Ice ATK, and cover tiles arrows launched by basic attacks and skills that use Special Arrows in Ice Sheets for 3 rounds. Being enchanted with Kraken also gives a chance to inflict Frostbite LV X for 3 rounds.

name: Longdraw
title: Longdraw
description: Drawing your string takes more effort, but allows you to increase the Range of your Bow basic attacks by 4 for 1 turn.

name: Stone Arrows
title: Stone Arrows
description:
Special Arrows skill.

Stone Arrows increase the power of Bow attacks and skills that use Special Arrows by 2* Rank, but reduce the range of those by 1 and increase your Battle Weight by 5. Being enchanted with Galren will increase the Power by 1 per Rank, and will negate the Battle Weight penalty.

name: Guerilla Tactic
title: Guerilla Tactics
description: Even one person can fight an army with the right strategy. Attacks made while you are in a Nest have increased critical (based on rank). If you have used the move skill in the same round while this skill's effect are activate. Critical chances have a chance to inflict confusion LV5 for 2 rounds.

name: Keyshot
title: Keyshot
description: Ideally, one shot, one kill. Aiming for vital points helps too. It's all about hitting that key shot.

name: Marked Target
title: Marked Target
extras: This skill does not take up any Skill Pool slots.
description:
Toggle skill. A two fold ability.

1) If toggled on, Pulling Shot will pull the nearest target towards the nearest trap (relative to them) you have set instead of you.

2) Enemies who trigger and/or are damaged by your traps become Trap Marked for 3 rounds. The mark is consumed when you hit the enemy with a basic attack, but causes the attack they're hit with to deal 15% extra damage.

name: Dynamic Shooting
title: Dynamic Shooting
description: The art of pulling off tricky shots; whether that requires bending at weird angles, firing in an odd angle, etc. Passively increases the Hit of Bow and Gun attacks, but also grants bonus effects to certain Archer skills if at a certain rank.

name: Snipe
title: Snipe
description: The training to hit far-off marks, a proper 'snipe' requires precision and distance. Increases your Hit and Range with Bows.

name: Fire Dance
title: Fire Dance
description: Dance skill. You target an unoccupied tile within 4 Range and move in a line to it. Every time you move through a tile, you deal Fire magic damage (based on your Fire ATK and Rank) to a random enemy within 2 Range. Enemies hit multiple times take 50% damage from additional hits.

name: Ice Slide
title: Ice Slide
description: Dance skill. Dash along the ground like a figure skater with chilling grace. You target an unoccupied tile within 4 Range and move in a line to it. Every time you move across a tile, you deal Ice magic damage (based on your Ice ATK and Rank) to a random enemy within 2 range. Enemies hit multiple times take 50% damage from additional hits.

name: Quaking Tap
title: Quaking Tap
description: Dance skill. Elegantly tap your feet on the ground below you, perhaps more strongly than expected. You will tap your feet 3 times, and every time, you deal Earth magic damage (based on your Earth ATK and Rank) to a random enemy in 7 Range (however, each enemy can only be damaged once).

name: Sound Wave
title: Sound Wave
description: Must be used by an Instrument weapon. Unleashes a wave of sound in a 4 Range line as a projectile, which will pierce through enemies and deal Sound magic damage.

name: Thunder Steps
title: Thunder Steps
description:
Dance skill. Leap into the air and crash down with the awe-inspiring effect of thunder. Targets 2 unoccupied tiles; you will leap to the first one, and then the second one. Each time you land at one of these locations, you deal Lightning magic damage (based on your Lightning ATK and Rank) to a random enemy within 2 Range.

If there is not an enemy within 3 range of you after using this skill, it is put on a 2 round cooldown.

name: Wind Pirouette
title: Wind Pirouette
description: Dance skill. A rapid spinning dance move while staying in place. You will spin in place 3 times, and every time, you deal Wind magic damage (based on your Wind ATK and Rank) to a random enemy within 3 Range.

name: Anthem of Enthusiasm
title: Anthem of Enthusiasm
description: Bard Song skill. A cheery, forceful tune to get allies excited. Play your instrument, gaining the Anthem of Enthusiasm aura (+2 WIL, +2 GUI, 5 Range), and giving all allies in 5 Range bonuses to Elemental ATK and Critical Damage for 3 rounds. (based on Rank).

name: Anthem of Enthusiasm
title: Dawr of Defense
description: Bard Song skill. A slow, methodical beat to make allies pay attention. Play your instrument, gaining the Dawr of Defense aura (+2 DEF, +2 RES, 5 Range), and giving all allies in 5 Range bonus Critical Evade and X% resistance to all elements for 3 rounds (based on Rank).

name: Aria of Agility
title: Aria of Agility
description: Bard Song skill. A light and airy tune that makes allies feel just as swift. Play your instrument, gaining the Aria of Agility aura (+2 CEL, +2 SKI, and 5 Range), and giving all allies in 5 Range additional bonuses to Hit and Evade for 3 rounds. (based on Rank).

name: Cantus of Consideration
title: Cantus of Consideration
description: Bard Song skill. A soothing melody that'll make everything feel alright. Play your instrument, removing any active Bard aura, and healing all allies in 5 Range for X HP (based on Rank), plus 25 HP for every active Bard song buff they have.

name: Samba of Strength
title: Samba of Strength
description: Bard Song skill. A spicy melody that really cuts to the heart of the matter. Play your instrument, gaining the Samba of Strength aura (+2 STR, +2 SKI, 5 Range), and giving all allies in 5 Range a bonus to their Scaled Weapon Attack and Critical for 3 rounds (based on Rank).

name: Volume Up
title: Volume Up
description: Crank up the volume. For 3 rounds, boosts your Sound ATK, and the range of your Bard class Song skills (based on Rank).

name: Auto-Tune
title: Auto-Tune
extras: Auto-starts the battle with first equipped bard support skill.
description: You know just when to kick in the music. At the start of battle, if you have a Bard base class Song skill equipped, you will automatically use the first skill of that type equipped in your Skill Pool. (You must still pay the FP cost and satisfy the conditions of that skill.)

name: Light-Handed Playing
title: Light-Handed Playing
description: It's so much easier to perform when your hands are as empty as your mind. When you only have 1 weapon equipped, and that weapon is an Instrument, FP costs for Bard base class skills are reduced by 10%

name: Musical Prodigy
title: Musical Prodigy
description: Some Bards just have the talent. Passively increases SAN, based on Rank. At Rank 5, SAN is further increased by +1.

name: Bard's Armory
title: Bard's Armory
description:
Besides a good voice and quick feet, what does a Bard need? An instrument.

Allows you to equip any Instrument weapon, regardless of weapon type.

name: Charmer's Wit
title: Charmer's Wit
description: With a reputation for being more charismatic than reliable, the Bard is a natural charmer, increasing their Status Infliction when inflicting Charm status by 10%.

name: Never Quiet
title: Never Quiet
description: With a reputation for never shutting up, perhaps to the benefit or anger of others, the Bard is a natural talker, increasing their Status Resistance versus the Silence status by 15%.

name: Repeat Sign
title: Repeat Sign
extras: Gains 2 FP for every enemy defeated by a party-member you buffed.
description: There's nothing quite like the satisfaction of good music while you fight. When an ally under the effect of one of your Bard song status effects defeats an enemy, you regain 2 FP for each of your song effects active on them.

name: Trained Ears
title: Trained Ear
description: A Bard is used to loud noises - music, singing, the crowd cheering (or booing...). As such, sound has a lesser effect on them, increasing their Sound damage resistance by 10%.

name: Board Shaker
title: Board Shaker
power: 110/125/140% Earth ATK + 50/60/70% Scaled WPN ATK + Torso Weight
description:
Slam something heavy, be it your weapon or foot, into the ground, causing it to shake. All enemies in a 4 Range Circle around you take Earth magic damage (this damage is increased by your Torso's weight). Enemies who take damage may also be inflicted with Clumsy for 2 rounds. (Clumsy prevents the use of movement skills besides basic Movement.)

Does not affect flying or airborne units.

name: Bright Bishop
title: Bright Bishop
description: Sword, Axe, or Spear skill. Fires a cross of light in a diagonal line, travelling up to 5 Range. The first enemy hit takes elemental magic damage (based on enchanted element, or Light if none), and is inflicted with Glowing LV X (3 * Rank). It will also leave behind Light Shafts with LV X for 3 rounds on each space it passes over (unless an Elemental Impact effect leaves behind a different special tile).

name: Checkmate
title: Checkmate
description:
A heavy attack iconic to the Black Knights, using their heavy armor to crush their opponent with power. On use, attacks a nearby target. If the attack hits, you deal bonus damage equal to your Scaled DEF.

If the target is Immobilized or Flatfooted, the attack cannot miss. If they are defeated by this attack, the unit is inflicted with Certain Defeat for 6 rounds. (Certain Defeat prevents defeated enemies from being revived.

name: Crescent Rook
title: Crescent Rook
description:
Sword, Axe, or Spear skill. Unleashes a projectile in a line that deals elemental magic damage to the first enemy hit (based on enchanted elemental).

If you have invoked the Black Wind this round, the target may also be inflicted with Interference for 3 rounds. Otherwise, you invoke the Black Wind to appear either nearby the enemy hit, or if none, the tile the projectile expired at.

name: Hanging
title: Hanging
description:
Can only target an enemy with no adjacent allied units. Exploit your target's lack of protection, performing a basic attack with a bonus to Hit. (This bonus is higher the further away you were from the enemy.)

If you have invoked the Black Wind this round, gains +15% Critical Damage for the attack. Otherwise, invokes the Black Wind to change skill Range and teleports you near the target.

name: Castling
title: Castling
description:
A protective move to get an ally out of danger. Targets 1 ally within 2 Range and switches place with them. You and that ally also gain a Defense buff based on Rank for 3 rounds.

If the Black Wind has been invoked this round, the duration of the buff is doubled. Otherwise, the Range of the skill increases by 5, and you invoke the Black Wind to utilize it.

name: Prophylaxis
title: Prophylaxis
description:
Prepare yourself to fend off the worst. Creates a group of counter-attack tiles at all tiles within 1 Range of you. When an enemy steps on one and you are within 1 Range of that tile, you perform a basic attack (treated as a counter attack) with a bonus to your Critical Damage equal to X (X = Rank * 10%). If the attack hits and the enemy was using basic Movement, they stop.

The tiles will last for 2 rounds or until triggered.

name: Sacrifice
title: Sacrifice
description: Sometimes strategic sacrifices are required to protect something important. Targets an ally within 1 Range. Until your next turn, if the target ally is within 1 Range of you and takes damage from an enemy, you take that damage instead.

name: Forced Move
title: Forced Move
description:
Utilize sheer force to manipulate your enemies into making unwise moves. Inflicts Forced Move LV X (X = Rank) on all enemies within a circle until your next turn, reducing their Move by LV.

If you have invoked the Black Wind this round, all those enemies are also pushed back 1+X tiles. Otherwise, you invoke the Black Wind to draw them closer, pulling them 1+X tiles towards you.

name: Steel Aura
title: Steel Aura
description: The Black Knight gains the power of Negation, preventing weapons with On Hit and On Critical effects from utilizing them when attacking the Black Knight for X rounds (based on Rank).

name: Steel Blood
title: Steel Blood
description: Either through a magical ability or sheer will, the Black Knight purges all Poison effects with a LV equal to or less than X, based on Rank.

name: Steel Body
title: Steel Body
description: The Black Knight takes a moment to re-evaluate their defenses. Reduces the duration of all negative status effects caused by another unit that reduce your Defense or Phys defense by Rank rounds.

name: Steel Mind
title: Steel Mind
description: The knights' code lets the Black Knight remove certain mental status effects from themself. Depending on the Rank of this skill, more status effects are removed.

name: Unmoving
title: Unmoving
description: Every move a Black Knight makes should be deliberate. Until your next turn, inflicts Immobilize and Unmoving on yourself. Unmoving prevents pull and push effects from affecting you, and grants immunity to Vydel's movement effects (though you still take damage).

name: Black Deflection
title: Black Deflection
description: Black Knights are capable of turning their foe's momentum against them. When you successfully trigger your own Parry skill, you gain +5 Hit for 2 rounds.

name: Black Drain
title: Black Drain
description: Sap the strength from your foes using the mysterious power of the Black Knight's gale. If you have invoked the Black Wind, physical damage dealt from Soldier class skills drains the target of their Scaled Weapon ATK, as a stacking status effect (1 LV, 3 rounds per damage instance, max LV 1+(Rank*3), 10 rounds). You gain the same amount of Scaled Weapon ATK. (The drain effect can apply to multiple enemies, but you only gain this status once.)

name: Stalemate
title: Stalemate
description:
Parry skill (only one takes effect at a time.)

Grants the ability to parry attacks and skill damage (excluding spells) from Sword, Axe, Spear, or monster weapons, at a chance equal to half of your Scaled DEF + a bonus based on Rank. When triggered, damage is reduced by 50%. If the attacker was within 1 Range, and you have a weapon with 15 Weight or more equipped, they are also inflicted with Flatfoot LV 1 until their next turn.

You can only parry attacks you can see.

name: Sudden Death
title: Sudden Death
description: It is painfully obvious when a Black Knight is unaffected by a strike. When an enemy deals physical damage equal to or less than your Scaled SKI+5, they are Feared for 3 rounds. In addition, enemies who you have Feared suffer -15 Critical Evade versus you.

name: Grandmaster
title: Grandmaster
description:
A sharp mind is a deadly weapon. Increases your Hit with Greatsword, Greataxe, and Greatlance weapons by half of your scaled GUI.

Additionally, your Tactician's class's Tactics Rank boosts the range of Black Knight projectiles and skills that can invoke the Black Wind to gain increased range (by half of its value). Furthermore, Tactics Rank cannot decrease due to taking damage during a turn your Parry skill triggered, or have invoked the Black Wind.

name: Indomitable
title: Indomitable
description: An unrelenting will that numbs pain. If you are wearing Heavy Armor with 10 or more Weight: Reduces physical damage taken and your total Battle Weight by 1+(Rank*3)% (10% at max rank). Against enemies that you have inflicted with Fear, the reduction is doubled.

name: Iron Wall
title: Iron Wall
description: A master of defense can fend off attacks no matter what the condition. Passively increases your DEF. If at max Rank, further increases DEF by +1.

name: Knight's Intimidation
title: Knight's Intimidation
description:
Black Knights have a reputation for being intimidating figures, even saying to give those who know no fear a taste of it. You can inflict Fear on enemies who are normally immune to it (excluding Boss monsters). In addition, defeating a unit will attempt to inflict Fear on all other enemies for 3 Rounds.

Main Class only.

name: Negation
title: Negation
description: An otherworldly quality possessed by the user of the Black Wind. Blades and blows seem to veer off their course to lethal spots against the Black Knight. When wearing Heavy Armor, Passively increases your Critical Evade, lessening your chance of taking critical hits. Does not work against Tome weapons.

name: Zugzwang
title: Zugzwang
description: A tactic that forces enemies to make moves they don't really want to. Enemies affected by your Forced Move, Flatfoot, or Fear status effects have their Parry skill's reduction effectiveness halved and suffer -5 Evade (versus you only).

name: Aliagmato
title: Aliagmato
description: Spear skill. Elemental compatible. Dash in a 2-3 Range line, performing a basic attack with bonus damage on all enemies in that line. If you have Bonded Youkai summoned, they will duplicate the attack themselves in the direction they are facing. If you have only one Bonded Youkai, the Range of this skill is increased by 3. Must end in an unoccupied square. (Those who do not satisfy this condition will not attack.)

name: Infernal Summon
title: Infernal Summon
description: Axe skill. Elemental compatible. Targets a 3 Range line, summons the first alive and unsummoned Bonded Youkai available, and sends it along that line. If the Youkai encounters an enemy along its path, it will stop, deal damage (type based on Youkai) to them. If you have only one Bonded Youkai, the Youkai will also perform a basic attack on that target.

name: Pinball Strike
title: Pinball Strike
description: Targets an empty tile within 5 range and teleports to it. If there is an enemy within 1 Range of that tile you attack them; they are knocked back 2 + Rank tiles. Any bonded youkai within 1 Range of them while being knocked down automatically attack them,with bonus hit.

name: Riagri
title: Riagri
description:
(Swords, Axes, and Spears can be used as casting tools for this spell.) Can only be used if you have Bonded Youkai. For each Bonded Youkai, a projectile is launched in a 5 Range line in one direction. A projectile that hits the target will deal magic damage (damage type depends on the Youkai). If you have only one Bonded Youkai, the damage is also increased by half of that Youkai's Scaled WIL, and the Range is increased by 2.

Note: Projectile 2 will be fired at a 45 degree turn from your direction. Projectile 3 will be fired from a -45 degree turn from your direction.

name: Ritual Sword
title: Ritual Sword
description: Sword skill. Performs a basic attack on 1 enemy within 1 Range. If the target is successfully hit by the attack, you steal FP from the target, based on Rank. (If the attack was a critical hit, the FP steal is also increased.) If you have only one Bonded Youkai, you also summon that Youkai to your side. (If it is summoned already, it is moved to a random tile next to you. If the Youkai is already within 2 Range of the attacked enemy, this effect will not trigger.)

name: Sagum Ruinam
title: Sangum Ruinam
description: Summon Spectral versions of your weapon that launch at all enemies within 8 range. dealing its damage type as magic damage to them. Enemies above Parted Pain's threshold take only half damage.

name: Wrap Strike
title: Warp Strike
description: Throws your weapon as a projectile in a 5 Range Line. If it encounters an enemy, you teleport to unoccupied tile within 1 Range of them and preform a basic attack that does magic damage. Otherwise when it stops, if it is on a valid tile, you teleport to it.

name: Two Souls Beyond
title: Two Souls Beyond
description:
Active: Can only be used if you are installed with a Bonded Youkai. Ends the Install.

Passive: Increases install duration with bonded Youkai.

If you have only one bonded Youkai, and you are Install with it. You gains the effect of Fight As One.

name: Conduct: Avant
title: Conduct: Avant
description: Targets 1 of your Youkai within 10 Range and commands them to preform a diving attack. They will move up to 4 tiles in the direction they are facing, dealing Pierce damage to all enemies encountered, based on the Youkai's SKI. (The Youkai will travel through enemies as long as the last tile in the line is a valid battle tile.) Bonded Youkai will move 1 extra tile.

name: Conduct: Jete
title: Conduct: Jete
description: Targets 1 of your Youkai within 10 Range and commands them to preform a rushing attack. They will move up to 3 tiles in the direction they are facing, dealing Blunt damage to the first enemy encountered, based on the Youkai's STR. Bonded Youkai move 1 extra tile.

name: Conduct: Plie
title: Conduct: Plie
description: Targets 1 of your Youkai within 10 Range and commands them to preform a spinning attack. They will move up to 2 tiles in the direction they are facing, dealing Slash damage to all enemies within 1 Range at the start of the skill and after each step based on the Youkai's CEL. Bonded Youkai move 1 extra tile.

name: Healing Discharge
title: Healing Discharge
description: Releases a pulse of healing energy, healing yourself and all allies within a 3 Range circle. If you have only one Bonded Youkai, they will receive the effects of the skill while summoned regardless of where they are on the battlefield.

name: Attention Please
title: Attention Please
description: Clap your hands, causing all summoned Bonded Youkai to face towards a tile you target within 5 Range.

name: Fast Offense
title: Fast Offense
description: Imbues yourself with quick arcane energies. For 2 rounds, when you summon a Youkai, it gains Momentum equal to 1+Rank, allowing it to act immediately. (Youkai must normally wait a turn after being summoned to act.) If you have only one Bonded Youkai, it gains an additional 2 Momentum.

name: Shift Dimension
title: Shift Dimension
description: Targets 1 of your bonded Youkai in range and instantly swaps places with them.

name: Contract Tres
title: Contract Tres
description: While equipped, all Youkai except for the first 3 Youkai in your contract list will be ignored. (You can't summon or install them, and they will not count against you for the purposes of determining Bonder benefits. You can rearrange the order of your contracts list in the Companions menu. If Contract Uno is equipped as well, this skill has no effect.)

name: Contract Uno
title: Contract Uno
description: While equipped, all Youkai except for the first Youkai in your contract list will be ignored. (You can't summon or install them, and they will not count against you for the purposes of determining Bonder benefits. You can rearrange the order of your contracts list in the Companions menu.)

name: Fight As One
title: Fight As One
description: When you and your Bonded Youkai are within 2 Range of each other, all of you gain a bonus to Hit, Evade, Critical, and Critical Evade, based on Rank. (All of your Bonded Youkai must be summoned for this to take effect.) If you have only one Bonded Youkai, the effect is doubled.

name: Hell Above
title: Hell Above
description: When a Bonded Youkai deals damage to an enemy, you inflict Hell Above on that target for 3 rounds. When an enemy with Hell Above takes damage from you, the status is consumed and deals protection-ignoring Akashic damage to the target equal to 5% of the damage dealt. (If you have only one Bonded Youkai, it does 10% instead.)

name: Parted Pain
title: Parted Pain
description: When summoned, your Bonded Youkai gain a permanent status that increases their damage dealt by 15% and halves their Maintenance and Skill FP costs, but your Youkai cannot bring enemies below 15% of their maximum HP (Any excess damage that would bring them below that is ignored).

name: Shared Joy
title: Shared Joy
description: Toggle skill. While active, if you have Bonded Youkai summoned, any source that restores your HP triggers this skill. When triggered, the healing is reduced by 70%, but you and all summoned Youkai will receive that healing together.

name: Shared Pain
title: Shared Pain
description: Toggle skill. While active, if you have Bonded Youkai summoned, damage taken by you or your Bonded Youkai triggers this skill. When triggered, the damage taken is reduced by 30%, but you and all summoned Youkai suffer that damage together.

name: Synchro Summon
title: Synchro Summon
description: Synchronize your mind with your Youkai's, granting them bonus stats (based on Rank) for 3 rounds after being Summoned. If you have only one Bonded Youkai, you also gain the effects of this skill when applied.

name: Grand Finale
title: Grand Finale
description:
Requires Parted Pain. Defeating a monster in melee range that was within Parted Pain's HP threshold restores 3M and resets Repeat Action for you, but your damage against monsters outside of Parted Pain's HP threshold is reduced by 30%.

If Heaven Below is active, triggering this effect increases it's active LV by 3.

name: Heaven Below
title: Heaven Below
description: Requires Parted Pain. At the start of every round, grants or increases Heaven Below at LV2 (max 10). LV decreases by 1 upon taking non-bonus non-status, non-field effect damage. Increases damage against enemies within Parted Pain's threshold by LV * 2%, and upon defeating them, restores LV * 5 FP, and heals all summoned Bonded Youkai's HP and FP for that same amount. Every enemy you defeat that procs this effect increases the maximum level by 10. If you end the battle with a maximum level of 30 or more, all allies gain 10% bonus EXP and 10% drop rate boost.

name: Spiritual Bond
title: Spiritual Bond
description:
Allows you to have Bonded Youkai and increases their maximum possible level (max. 60). The following conditions are required to have a Bonded Youkai.

Your total contracts must not exceed the Rank of this skill.

The friendship of that Youkai must be above average (50%).

If you do not satisfy the first condition, no Youkai you have will be treated as Bonded. If you do not satisfy the second condition, only the Youkai with low friendship will not be treated as Bonded.

name: Symbol of Trust
title: Symbol of Trust
description: Being a Bonder means putting your trust in your Youkai allies to cover your weaknesses. As such, this skill increases the WIL and FAI of the character, based on Rank.

name: Asura Fist
title: Asura Fist
description: Unleashes a blow of darkness in a 4 Range line. The projectile will deal Dark magic damage to the first enemy hit, and will increase your Schwarz Sturm level by 1 on use. Fist weapons are treated as valid casting tools for this spell.

name: Felhook
title: Felhook
description:
Fist skill. A weighty hook punch that sets the target off-balance.

Deals Blunt Damage to the target and inflicts them with Flatfoot. If you are Swaying, this skill can critically hit (25% damage).

name: Felsmanege
title: Felsmanege
description:
Finisher (resets Schwarz Sturm to 0 when used). Deal a crushing blow to the ground in a 3 Range circle around you, dealing Earth magic damage to all enemies inside of it.

It will also create pillars of rock at the edge of the circle, which last for rounds equal to your Schwarz Sturm level.

name: Grandupper
title: Grandupper
description:
Finisher (resets Schwarz Sturm to 0 when used). The strongest punch a Boxer has. Deals Blunt damage to one enemy within 1 Range. If your Schwarz Sturm level is 8 or higher, an additional effect occurs:

If the target is a non-Player Character and non-boss, it is instantly reduced to 0 HP. If they are, they are knocked into the air and removed from the battle for 1 turn; afterwards, they land in the battle again, and take Blunt damage equal to half of the original damage.

name: Korkenzieher
title: Korkenzieher
description: A strong forward charging punch in an adjustable X Range line (X = 1 + Schwarz Sturm level) that must end in an empty square. All enemies in the line take Blunt damage and are knocked airborne.

name: Orkam Drehen
title: Orkam Drehen
description: A powerful spinning attack. Targets an X Range circle (2 + half of Schwarz Sturm level). All enemies in that area are drawn in X tiles, based on Rank, towards you, and then deals Blunt physical damage to all enemies within 1 Range of you.

name: Regenschauer
title: Regenschauer
description: Fist Skill. A series of fast punches at the target that ignores protection. You hit the target a number of times equal to your Schwarz Sturm level +1, and the damage they each deal is based on Rank. (This skill will not trigger Nachbeben.)

name: Sturm Shreik
title: Sturm Shreik
description: Fist Skill. Deals a hard blow to the gut of an enemy within 1 Range, inflicting Blunt damage and reducing their FP by your Schwarz Sturm level. It can also inflict Silence for 2 rounds at a rate of 30% of your normal Status Infliction, plus 10% per Schwarz Sturm level. If the target is Flatfooted, this skill can critically hit (25% damage).

name: Geist Schritt (Eins)
title: Geist Schritt (Eins)
description:
A common type of dash used by close-range fighters. You dash in a 3-6 Range line that must end in an unoccupied tile. Only 1 Geist Schritt skill can be used per turn.

Eins style. The dash also attempts to bait out basic attack skills; if you are targeted by one, it is negated, and the follow-up dash activates, moving you towards the attacker, restoring 3 Momentum and increases your Schwarz Sturm level by 1.

name: Geist Schritt (Zwei)
title: Geist Schritt (Zwei)
description:
A common type of dash used by close-range fighters. You dash in a 3-6 Range line that must end in an unoccupied tile. Only 1 Geist Schritt skill can be used per turn.

Zwei style. The dash also attempts to bait out non-basic attack skills; if you are targeted by one, it is negated, and the follow-up dash activates, moving you towards the attacker, restoring 3 Momentum and increases your Schwarz Sturm level by 1.

name: Swaying
title: Swaying
description:
Spin your body and rock it back and forth unpredictably.

Targets yourself or 1 unoccupied tile within 1 Range; you being Swaying (LV X, until your next turn) and move to that tile (without changing directions).

name: Scharfe
title: Scharfe
description:
Focus your mind and energy.

Increases your Hit and Critical by X (based on Rank) * your Schwarz Sturm level for 3 rounds.

name: Fegen
title: Fegen
description: Fist skill. Sweep the legs or whatever counts of target enemy, knocking them down. Cannot target Airborne enemies or enemies with the Flying attribute. This skill has a lengthy cooldown, but is reduced by half of your Schwarz Sturm level.

name: Geist Schritt (Drei)
title: Geist Schritt (Drei)
description:
A common type of dash used by close-range fighters. You dash in a 3-6 Range line that must end in an unoccupied tile. Only 1 Geist Schritt skill can be used per turn.

Drei style. The dash also attempts to scare your opponent; at the end of the turn, if you have not been targeted by an enemy at all, the follow-up dash activates, moving you towards the attacker, restoring 3 Momentum and increases your Schwarz Sturm level by 1.

name: Gotthand
title: Gotthand
description:
A powerful aesthetic surpassing magic.

When your Schwarz Sturm level is 4 or higher, you ignore resistance, immunity, absorb, and reflect for Blunt damage. (Does not affect Phys. or Magic Def, nor Armor).

name: Kid Gloves
title: Kid Gloves
description:
Sometimes you want to be gentle. Sometimes not.

When toggled on, damage you deal will not bring enemies below 1 HP.

name: Krahenflugel
title: Krahenflugel
description: The storm only gets worse if you anger it. When you evade a basic attack, your Schwarz Sturm level raises by 1.

name: Muunden
title: Muunden
description:
A brief lull in activity can bait your opponent into making a mistake.

While toggled on, after using a Geist Schritt skill, you also skip your turn (unless the Geist Schritt skill activates, in which case you stop skipping.)

name: Nachbeben
title: Nachbeben
description:
Knock the wind right out of them. Or into them. All around them.

While toggled on, when you damage an enemy with certain Boxer Offensive skills, you create an explosion of Wind magic damage around the target in a circle, damaging all enemies within it for 50% of the original damage dealt.

name: Weir Konnen
title: Weir Konnen
description:
Defensive Knowledge skill. Knowledge is power. The power to defend yourself.

Increases your Phys. Def by (20% of your Scaled WIL)%. (Multiple Defensive Knowledge skills will not stack.)

name: Fighting Pace
title: Fighting Pace
description:
Sometimes you just need a breather.

Ending your turn with unspent Momentum restores 3 FP per momentum point.

name: On The Ropes
title: On The Ropes
description:
True Boxers will take every advantage they can get when the enemy has their back to the wall.

While not at the edge of the battlefield, any enemy who is, or has a dense object behind them, takes 15% extra damage from you.

name: Schwarz Sturm
title: Schwarz Sturm
description:
The Boxer is an entity that relies on momentum and prediction, to which they have a unique, authentic quality. Once a Boxer gets started, you need to stop them as soon as possible, or things will just get worse.

Schwarz Sturm is a gauge that will increase when using most Boxer Skills, up to a maximum. Using a non-Boxer skill, even ones like Movement (except End Turn), will reset it to 0. Boosts Boxer skill power by 5% per level, and some skills will change based on it.

name: Wind Weave
title: Wind Weave
description:
When you fight up close and personal all the time, it's important to be able to move quickly, especially if you're on the offensive.

Increases your Evade by your Schwarz Sturm level * 2.

name: Alchemic Barrage
title: Alchemic Barrage
description:
Requires an unused Magic Stone in your item belt. Prepares a barrage, up to 1 per chemical type (A, B, etc.), up to a max of your Momentum. Then, launches them at an enemy in 2 Range as Alchemic Bullets. Momentum cost equals the number of Stones used.

Damage against your Marked Targets consumes the mark to increase damage by its LV% and gain Great Accuracy. +2 Range under Longdraw and consumes it.

name: Alchemic Bullet
title: Alchemic Bullet
description:
Requires an unused Magic Stone in your item belt. Fire the top-most Magic Stone at an enemy within 5 Range as an Alchemic Bullet.

Damage against your Marked Targets consumes the mark to increase damage by its LV% and gain Great Accuracy. +2 Range under Longdraw and consumes it.

name: Eight-Pointed Weaving
title: Eight-Pointed Weaving
description:
Targets a 1-3 Size Octagon around yourself, weaving a complex shape of strings, which last until your next turn, which deals Slash damage to enemies in those tiles or who cross over it (once).

If you have Coated Ammo active, 1 LV is used to coat the strings; any enemies that trigger them will also have its effect applied to them (once, doesn't use further LVs).

name: Forgotten Brew
title: Forgotten Brew
description:
Dig up something from your belongings that you completely forgot mixing. Targets 1 tile in X Range (based on Rank) and applies the forgotten brew at it, just as if you'd use Use Mixture.

The forgotten brew is not part of your normal Flasks, in case you were unaware. You are also unaware of exactly what it is - it could be anything. Drink at your own risk!

name: Shake Shake
title: Shake Shake
description: Must have a completed Flask selected. Give it a good shake (ill-advised), which causes it to become an Unstable Mixture. If it's already unstable, well...

name: Lick Weapon
title: Lick Weapon
description:
Lick your weapon in an unsettling, intimidating, or cool(?) manner. Enemies in 2 Range who do not have Hesitation may be inflicted with Hesitation (LV 10, until your next turn).

If you have Coated Ammo, you apply its effects to yourself.

name: Safety Gear
title: Safety Gear
description:
Equip yourself in protective safety gear. You gain Safety Gear (LV X, Permanent Duration) or remove it (restores 2M). It will protect you from common hazards, including some you may expose yourself to, but it's rather bulky and difficult to talk in.

If you have a Personal Wardrobe with an outfit named 'Safety Gear', it will be applied/removed when you put on your gear.

name: Bolt Delivery
title: Bolt Delivery
description:
Requires your currently selected Mixture to be complete. Targets 1 tile within X Range (boosted by Longdraw & consumes it). If the tile is your location, you gain Long Range Item (LV 3, until your next turn).

Otherwise, you launch your Mixture at that location with an appropriate weapon, applying it as if used by Use Mixture.

name: Coat Ammunition
title: Coat Ammunition
description:
Requires your current loaded Mixture to be complete. Target 1 unit within 2 Range with a Bow, Gun, Dagger, Strings, or monster weapon and coat it in your Mixture, giving them Coated Ammo (LV X, 5 rounds).

Depending on the Mixture, it may not be suitable for this purpose. (Including Unstable and Evaporation mixtures, among others.)

name: Continuous Production
title: Continuous Production
description:
Requires your selected Mixture be completed. Hunker down for a long production cycle, gaining Continuous Production (LV = Rank, 5 rounds).

Effect will prefer to use chemicals if possible; otherwise, the first available battle item will be used. No effect if you lack the proper resources or empty flasks.

name: Dynamic Rainshot
title: Dynamic Rainshot
description:
Requires your currently selected Mixture to be complete. Targets 2 tiles within 5 Range. First, throw the Mixture towards Location 1. Then, slide to Location 2 and take a shot at it - if it hits, its effects are applied in a Size 3 Star with -20% Efficacy.

There is a chance you'll miss based on how far you move, in which case the Mixture will just hit the ground. (Higher Dynamic Shooting ranks decrease miss rate.)

name: Hasty Mixture
title: Hasty Mixture
description: Must have a completely empty active Flask. Hastily throw together whatever you can find in arm's reach and create a Mixture without consuming resources; however, the Base and Chemicals are randomly selected.

name: Outsourced Collection
title: Outsourced Collection
description:
Targets 1 of your summoned units or mercenaries in 7 Range (except units with Summon Limit/Fading Clone, etc.) and sends them out to gather ingredients for you. Inflicts them with Removed From Battle and Outsourced Collection (LV X, based on Rank).

Lasts for 3 rounds (-1 round for every 30 Scaled CEL of target. Min. 1).

name: Collect Ingredients
title: Collect Ingredients
description:
Targets 1 tile in 2 Range with a field object that produces a chemical, and gathers 1 dose of that chemical from it (some objects may be destroyed when harvested). Plants are often good sources of chemicals.

Gathered chemicals are stored for use with Create Mixture. At the start of a new round, if you are standing on a Nest, this skill's effect is automatically applied to it.

name: Create Mixture
title: Create Mixture
description:
Create a unique concoction known as a Chemist Mixture. Each Mixture is created by combining a Base with two Chemicals in a Flask, and have wildly varying effects. The Mixture is used by various other Chemist skills, or on its own with Use Mixture.

The amount of Flasks you have is equal to 2 + Rank. (Flasks are reusable, even if broken, or misplaced, or melted, or eaten. This skill must be equipped to use Flasks, however!)

name: Dillution
title: Dillution
description:
Targets 1 Water tile in 2 Range. If your currently selected Mixture is complete (and not Dilluted), and you have an empty flask, you split it between those flasks, duplicating it, but both become Dilluted (-X% Efficacy). The excess is used to restore 1 per battle use of 1 Potion-class in your item belt (which has been used, randomly).

Using the water will also destroy the field tile you target.

name: Evaporative
title: Evaporative
description: Requires your currently loaded Mixture to be complete. Add a reagent to it that causes rapid vaporization, turning it into an Evaporating Mixture.

name: Ichor Recoating
title: Ichor Recoating
description:
Utilize a direct infusion of focus from your blood to replenish magic stones.

You take 10 protection-ignoring Pierce Kickback Damage, and restore 1 per battle use of a random Magic Stone in your item belt. by coating it with your blood. Furthermore, you apply or power up Ichor Recoating (LV 1, permanent, max LV 10).

name: Powder Arrows
title: Powder Arrows
description:
Requires you to have Elemental Arrows loaded. Grind some of those arrows down into powder, expending 3 LV of them to gain 1 dose of a chemical based on its element. (Fire = A, Ice = B, Stone = C, Gust = D).

Also gain Embered Ashes (LV 1, 2 rounds) with the same element.

name: Quick Refresher
title: Quick Refresher
description:
Flip through your notes, gaining Quick Refresher (LV 15, permanent) if you don't already have it. You then gain renewed insight on a certain Mixture (randomly chosen). Furthermore, you will know if a Mystery Mixture is of a type you have studied when selecting it.

When Prepared Mixture's effect triggers, and this skill is equipped and can be used, you gain its effects for that Mixture.

name: Restocking
title: Restocking
description:
Spend some time (and maybe money) to make sure you have everything you need.

Restores 1 per-battle use of all Potion class items in your item belt. If 15+ Fanciness is available, reduces Momentum cost by 1 per 15 (up to -2 Momentum & 30 Fanciness) by spending it.

name: Chaotic Chemist
title: Chaotic Chemist
description:
You do not follow trivial things like recipes or safety guidelines. While equipped, your Mixtures become Mystery Mixtures. At the start of a new round, and when you use Create Mixture, you create a random completed Mixture. (Create Mixture will still use chemical resources, but results may vary.)

Out of flasks when a new round hits? No problem! You'll just empty one out on a random nearby tile.

name: Chemist's Belt
title: Chemist's Belt
description:
What is a chemist to do when they simply can't carry everything they need for their job? Get a belt, obviously.

While equipped, your Battle Weight increases by 10, but you gain 5 additional Item Belt slots.

name: Mad Science
title: Mad Science
description:
Your Mystery Mixtures are guaranteed to trigger a Mixture Bonus effect, and doubles the efficacy bonus given by Mystery Unstable Mixtures. Furthermore, if you have Quick Refresher equipped and can use it, being affected by your own Mystery Mixture automatically studies it.

However, when created and at the start of a new round, your Mixtures have a 5% chance to become unstable (+5% every time it fails to). Mad science is not without risks!

name: Needle & Thread
title: Needle & Thread
description: When using the Attack skill of your Bow or Gun weapon, if you have a different Strings weapon equipped, you also perform a basic attack with the Strings which deals 15% normal damage. (Does not stack with similar effects.)

name: Prepared Mixture
title: Prepared Mixture
description:
While equipped, at the start of monster battles, you begin with a Mixture. The Base will be based on the category of the first skill equipped in your skill pool, while the chemicals are based on the first 2 battle items in your item belt. (Requires Create Mixture and 2 valid battle items equipped.)

If Monoclassing Chemist, applies at the start of ANY battle.

name: Spillage
title: Spillage
description:
You know, like, when just stuff gets spilled.

While equipped, when you are defeated in battle, all of your completed Mixtures fall from your control, spilling their contents on a random tile within X Range (based on Rank). The effect is the same as if you used Use Mixture on said tiles.

name: Perfected Tolerance
title: Perfected Tolerance
description: Exposure to certain hazards has made the Chemist a little better at dealing with them. Grants +15% Poison Resistance, and +15% effectiveness to potions you use (including Mixtures). If Monoclassing Chemist, both effects are doubled.

name: Specimen Containment
title: Specimen Containment
description: Uh, they weren't supposed to get a hold of that... +10% Damage and Grapple success VS enemies with a beneficial Mixture, Mutagen, Vaccine or Perfume effect caused by you (5% damage versus non-monsters). Grappling such a target will reduce one of those effects by 3 rounds, and may Pacify non-boss monsters (until your next turn) if this ends the effect. (3 round CD per unit)

name: Dhessence
title: Dhessence
description: Create a vitality-stealing burst of darkness that hits 1 enemy within 5 range, dealing Dark magic damage to them. If it hits, you recover HP (based on rank). If the enemy was weak to Dark damage, you recover 50% more.

name: Holy Arrow
title: Holy Arrow
description: Launches an arrow of divine light in a 4-8 Range line, dealing magic Light damage to the first enemy hit. Bows are also treated as valid casting tools for this spell.

name: Kel
title: Kel
description: Release a jet of water around one target enemy within 4 Range, dealing Water magic damage to them.

name: Solar Lance
title: Solar Lance
description: Spear skill. Unleashes a piercing spear of solid light at a target enemy within 5 Range. On impact, it deals Pierce physical damage to the target, and the spear will remain in the target for up to 3 rounds. If the target takes Fire or Light damage, the spear will glow red and explode when the status expires, dealing Fire magic damage (100% Fire ATK).

name: Brighten
title: Brighten
description:
A spell that causes a light of protection or debilitation to be created. Can target an ally, an enemy, or a battlefield tile. All effects last for 3 rounds.

Ally: Grants Brighten status. (An ally's light is protecting you. Increases RES by 1 + LV*3, Light resistance by LV*5%, and deals unresistable Light damage to attackers equal to LV*5.)

Enemy: Inflicts Glowing on the enemy. (Evade is reduced by LV.)

Location: Creates a light shaft for 3 rounds.

name: Graft
title: Graft
description: Healing skill. Can only be used once per round. Holy energy envelops the target, curing wounds. Restores a target ally's HP.

name: Invigoration
title: Invigoration
description: Fills a target ally with a powerful confidence, increasing their STR and WIL for the duration. Lasts 3 rounds.

name: Quickness
title: Quickness
description: Fills a target ally with a divine speed, increasing their CEL (based on Rank) and Move by 2 for the duration. Lasts 3 rounds.

name: Rescue
title: Rescue
description: Pull your ally away from a disadvantageous situation, summoning them to your side. Affected allies will be moved to an unoccupied tile next to you. (You must have at least one available spot per ally affected.)

name: Second Chance
title: Second Chance
description: Give an ally a second chance to get back up and fight. By targeting an ally with 0 HP, they regain HP based on this skill's Rank. The heal is equal to a percentage of their maximum HP, or the flat value, whichever is higher.

name: Calm
title: Calm
description:
True Curates know that violence isn't always the answer. This skill targets 1 enemy, but has differing effects.

Player Character: Luck-based chance to reduce the duration of anger-based effects, such as Rage Energy, Soul Rage, etc.

NPC/Monster: Luck-based chance to inflict Pacify for 3 rounds.

Boss: May have a special effect or no effect.

name: Convert
title: Convert
description:
True Curates know that the path they follow is the right one, and are capable of convincing others of that. Targets 1 Pacified monster within 4 Range and attempts to convert them to your side. (Bosses, minibosses, and undead-race monsters are immune.) If successful, the monster joins your party for the rest of the battle. (It will still give EXP as if it were defeated.)

Your success rate is equal to the following:

Total FAI + (Devotion talent Rank * 2) + (your level - target's level, or 0 if less than 1) = success percent.

You can only have one converted enemy at a time.

name: Mass
title: Mass
description: A holy prayer that involves more than just yourself. For 1 round, the area of effect for all your Curate support spells is increased.

name: Pray
title: Pray
description: Cannot be used while silenced. Drop to your knees and offer prayers for help to the divine while forsaking all other actions that round. First, this prayer restores FP Equal to your FAI + Rank (max: Rank*6). Second, the duration of all positive status effects you have caused for all combatants are increased by 2 rounds. Third, it increases your LUC by half of your FAI for 4 rounds. This skill can then no longer be used while the LUC bonus is active. Finally, there is a chance based on your FAI that a bonus effect might occur.

name: Roar of Life
title: Roar of Life
description: Fill all other allies units with a divine energy, applying the charge weapon skill to them once.

name: Silent Prayer
title: Silent Prayer
extras: If Silence is cured, immunity to Silence for 2 rounds
description: Offer a quiet prayer to Mercala, asking her to remove a specific hex. If the caster is under the effect of 'Silence', the effect is instantly cured. At Rank 3, if Silence is cured, the caster also gains immunity to Silence for 2 rounds.

name: Aegis
title: Aegis
description: A holy ward that protects the holder and their allies. Allies within the Range gain a bonus to DEF and RES.

name: Pacifist Boon
title: Pacifist Boon
description: Some people just aren't good at fighting, but that usually means they're good at other things, like supporting the ones who are. At the start of battle, you gain a permanent status that increases the duration of your Curate support spells and grants FP Regeneration, and reduces the cooldown of Curate class (including promoted classes) that heal HP by 1 round. The status will immediately end if you deal any damage to any enemy.

name: Purity Edge
title: Purity Edge
description: Some prefer the power of magic to sharpen their blade, while others prefer the simple power of darkness and curses. But for some, the unhoned and unspoiled are the sharpest weapons. Unenchanted weapons you use gain bonus Power, Hit, and Critical based on Rank.

name: Antithesis
title: Antithesis
description: The Curate represents life in all of most of its forms. As such, they serve as the polar opposite to unlife; things that cling to the living realm unnaturally. Specifically, undead, and as such, all damage dealt to Undead and Ghost monsters is increased by a percentage, based on Rank. It is also effective against members of the Vampire and Possessed race, but only at half effectiveness, as they tip-toe the line between alive and undead.

name: Grace of God
title: Grace of God
description: It's a miracle you weren't hurt. When you evade a basic attack, you gain Grace of God for 3 rounds. When you Pray, Grace of God is consumed to guarantee it will activate a bonus effect.

name: Use Staff
title: Use Staff
description: The ability to use staves effectively. Further ranks increase your Staff Effectiveness, which reduces the FP Cost and increase the maximum Range of Staff skills by the same value.

name: Curtain Call
title: Curtain Call
description:
The end of the show. Can be used by any weapon.

All enemies within X Range (X = 3 + Tempo) take Dark magic damage, which is boosted by 15% per Tempo level, and then your Tempo is reset to 0. This skill will also trigger One-Two Steps on damaged enemies.

If used at 6+ Tempo, the damage ignores immunity, reflect, and absorb.

name: Dancer's Invitation
title: Dancer's Invitation
description:
Dance skill. Invite your foes close for a dance with a saucy move or two.

Targets all enemies within 8 Range, inviting them to move towards you X tiles (based on Rank). Player characters require a Status Infliction check to be lured, unless they're Charmed. Boss units are immune.

name: Fan Throw
title: Fan Throw
description:
Fan skill. Toss your fan, sending it out as a projectile in a 5 Size Line. The first enemy it encounters takes armor-ignoring damage equal to 5 + its Power, of its damage type, and applies on-hit effects to them.

This skill is not a Dance, but it will not stop your Singing nor alter your Tempo.

name: Idol Step
title: Idol Step
description: Dance skill. A simple but invigorating dance that affects all allies and enemies within 5 Range. Affected units may be inflicted with Charm LV X and are given Battle Rush LV X (based on Rank) for 3 rounds each. You will step X times (X = Rank) in place, and each time you do, you will heal a random ally and deal Light magic damage to a random enemy within 5 Range (based on Rank). If a specific enemy or ally is hit multiple times, the effectiveness is reduced by 50%.

name: Rose Toss
title: Rose Toss
description:
Dance skill. Throw a rose to a target tile within 4 Range, triggering One-Two Steps on all enemies. If the target tile is empty, all enemies within 3 Range of that tile have a chance to be Charmed LV X (based on Rank, 3 rounds). If it has an enemy, it only affects them, but also inflicted them with Holding Rose if successful.

If an enemy is defeated by One-Two Step triggered by this skill, you gain Boisterous Dancer for 5 rounds, and recover FP for each.

Holding a rose. Disables Two-Hand talent bonuses. Against enemies charming you, -LV Hit and -LV% Parry Activation chance.

You are just... so... COOL! +LV Critical, Evade, and Charm Infliction Rate. +10% Item Drop Rate.

name: Skating Spin
title: Skating Spin
description: Dance skill. An unarmed dance in a 1-3 Range line that must end in an unoccupied tile. You spin through the line, punching and kicking enemies, and every tile you move, you deal Blunt physical damage (based on Rank) to a random enemy within 1 Range. (Kick damage boosting effects apply to this skill's damage. Enemies can only be hit once per skill use.)

name: Dance Hour
title: Dance Hour
power: Cures Clumsy and Immobilization. Grants Immunity for 3 rounds.
description:
When it's time to dance, nothing will stop you.

Cures you of Immobilize and Clumsy, and grants immunity to those status effects for 3 rounds.

name: Rest Beat
title: Rest Beat
description: Dancing is hard work, so it's important to rest now and then. Requires Tempo. Restores HP and FP (based on Rank) and cures 1 negative status effect caused by an enemy for every 1 Tempo you have, and then resets it to 0.

name: Discourteous Dip
title: Discourteous Dip
description:
Dip your partner back, as in any tasteful dance... but then let them hit the ground.

Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range that is not Airborne or Flying, and inflicts Knocked Down on them. If you have Tempo, this skill's cooldown is reduced by its level when using this skill. (Note: This is not a dance skill, so you will lose your Tempo afterwards.)

name: Double Dance
title: Double Dance
description:
Dance skill. A deadly dance, with an even deadlier partner.

Targets 1 ally (except yourself) or 1 Charmed enemy within 5 Range. Both you and your target will spin around, attacking all enemies (of yours, if an enemy is selected) within 1 Range of each other. This attack deals X% normal attack damage (based on Rank).

name: Polished Step
title: Polished Step
power: Move one tile in any direction.
description: Dance skill. The sign of a skilled dancer; being able to get into place. You target any tile within 1 Range and step to it.
