name: Dancer's Tempo
title: Dancer's Tempo
description:
You are adept at building up a rhythm into a wonderful performance.

Using a Dance skill increases your Tempo by 1 (max: 6). The damage of your Dance skills is amplified by (Tempo*5)%, but increases their FP cost by (Tempo*2). Furthermore, provides a bonus to all Elemental ATK equal to Tempo*2. Using a non-Dance skill resets your Tempo to O, but it will persist between rounds. (Basic actions will not reset Tempo. These include Movement, Attack, Skip, and End Turn.)

name: Dancer's Tempo
title: Master of the Stage
extras: Learn skill, Chance: 25% Scaled CEL + 10% Per Tempo
description:
The power of a dancer's flexibility in full force, making fools of foes.

When an enemy with 1 Range of you performs a basic attack on you, while at least 1 other enemy is also within 1 Range of you, there is a chance that you will swerve out of the way, redirecting the attack to one of those other enemies but halving its damage. Triggering this effect requires 10 FP, and an enemy can only be affected by Master of the Stage once per round (unless you are monoclassing Dancer).

name: Dancing Circles
title: Dancing Circles
description: Toggle skill. While toggled on, damage you deal (except from One-Two Step) will not defeat enemies, leaving them at 1 HP instead. Furthermore, damage taken from enemies with 10 HP or less is reduced by 50%, as being so weak gives them two left feet.

name: Limbo
title: Limbo
description: Given your flexibility, you're more than capable of ducking under something when necessary. If an enemy projectile would hit you, there is a chance (based on Scaled CEL and Rank) that you will duck under it, and it will pass over you as if it didn't hit you. (Only applies to projectiles created by skills, not projectile basic attacks.)

name: One-Two Step
title: One-Two Step
description:
Dance skills that deal damage to an enemy also give them a status called 'One-Two (X)' (X = damage type) for 3 rounds. When they are hit by a basic attack, that status is consumed to deal armor-ignoring bonus magic damage of the same type to that enemy and all other enemies within 2 Range of the target.

(Different damage types will stack.)

name: Dancer's Agility
title: Dancer's Agility
description:
Even weapons and claws can serve as dance partners.

Using a Dance skill gives you a bonus to Evade for 1 attack/2 rounds (based on Rank). This effect can stack, up to a maximum of 6 attacks/3 rounds.

name: Dancer's Confidence
title: Dancer's Confidence
description:
Just pretend your mistakes were part of the show.

Damage dealt by Dance skills do not cause a Momentum penalty when hitting resistances, absorbs, or immunities.

name: Dancer's Intensity
title: Dancer's Intensity
description:
Not everyone can keep up with a true dancer.

Damage dealt by Dance skills has a chance to critically hit for 25% extra damage.

name: Signature Step
title: Signature Step
description:
Your dances sometimes leave their own 'autograph' behind.

Dance skills that deal elemental damage have a chance to inflict an appropriate status effect (per damage hit) for 2 rounds, using a percentage of your normal infliction rate (based on Rank). The LV of these statuses are predetermined based on the type.

name: Wide Stage
title: Wide Stage
description:
If you're flexible enough, even longer steps pose no challenge.

Increases the maximum Range of most Dance skills by 2.

name: Detonation Rift
title: Detonation Rift
description:
Dark Bard Song skill. Play your instrument, creating an explosion at a 3 size Circle within 3 Range, dealing Fire and Sound damage to all units inside of it. Enemies may be inflicted with Burn LV X (X = Rank * 10) for 3 Rounds.

Enemies take full damage, while allies take Kickback Damage.

name: Fatal Finale
title: Fatal Finale
description: Dark Bard Song skill. An end to the show that they'll never forget. All of your Shadow Moshes explode with dark energy, dealing Dark magic damage to all units within 1 Range of them. (Allies take Kickback Damage. Enemies can only be hit once per use.)

name: Hard Note
title: Hard Note
description: Dark Bard Song skill. The hardest of notes leaves the deepest impression. In a size 6 Circle around you; destroys Ice Sheets, deals Sound magic damage (allies take Kickback damage), and breaks Invocations (of allies and enemies).

name: Hell's Beating
title: Hell's Beating
description: Instrument skill. Take a swing at an enemy within 1 Range with your instrument, with greatly increased Critical Damage. If it hits, all other units within a 3 Range Circle take Sound magic damage (allies take Kickback Damage), and enemies may be inflicted with Hesitation LV X (X = Rank * 5) for 3 rounds, as that probably really hurt.

name: Kick Play
title: Kick Play
description:
Dance skill. Play your instrument while you hop forward, kicking your foot outwards. Every time you move, you deal Sound damage to a random enemy within 2 Range. Stops upon encountering an occupied or dense tile - if an enemy is in that tile, you apply the Kick skill to them automatically.

Trickery - You play the first Bard Song skill you have equipped automatically for free.

name: On A Leash
title: On A Leash
description:
Instrument skill. Put an enemy or another ally within 7 Range on a leash of fiery chains, dealing Fire magic damage to them (allies take Kickback Damage), and pulling them 2 tiles towards you. Enemies may be inflicted with Immobilize until your next turn. Allies are instead inflicted with On A Leash for 5 Rounds (if the target was an ally with this effect already, the effect ends and you regain 2M).

On A Leash: This is an effect given by the skill of the same name to allies. While active, the ally is treated as if they were Immobilized, and at the start of a new round they take Kickback Damage, but they also gain or power up Freakish Frenzy by 1 LV/3 rounds (max: LV 5, 3 rounds).

Freakish Frenzy increases Move by LV, Critical by LV * 10, and Critical Damage by LV * 5%.'

name: Pyrotechnics
title: Pyrotechnics
description:
Dark Bard Song skill. Play your instrument, dealing Sound magic damage in a 2-4 size circle around you, then all tiles in a ring outside of the circle launch the pyrotechnics, dealing Fire magic damage (based on SWA + Fire ATK).

Enemies take full damage, while allies take Kickback damage.

name: Raid the Rafters
title: Raid the Rafters
description: Dark Bard Song skill. Play your instrument, creating projectiles in all directions around you that travel up to 6 Range away. Enemies hit by the projectiles take Sound magic damage and are pulled two tiles towards you. (Allies the projectile passes through take Kickback Damage, but do not stop the projectile and are not pulled towards you.)

name: Unholy Diver
title: Unholy Diver
description:
Dance skill. Slide along the ground, on your knees (or whatever is appropriate, if you don't have knees), playing your instrument as you do. You target an unoccupied tile within 4 Range and move in a line to it. Every time you move across a tile, you deal Dark magic damage (based on your Dark ATK and Rank) to a random enemy within 2 Range.

Trickery - You play the first Bard song you have equipped automatically for free.

name: Dark Stage
title: Dark Stage
description:
Give yourself the perfect place to play. In a circle around you, creates Dark Stage tiles, with a LV based on Rank (infinite duration). (This will end other Dark Stage tiles you currently have active).

Dark Stage: This is a special effect tile created by Dark Bard skills. After playing a Song or using a Dance skill, if you are on a Dark Stage tile, you create 2 Shadow Moshes at random unoccupied locations near your Dark Stage tiles (if you are at the edge of a Dark Stage, it will prefer to spawn them within 1 Range of you.)

Furthermore, allies standing on a Dark Stage tile boosts their own Fire, Dark, and Sound ATK by (LV*3), and DEF & RES by LV.

name: Crazy Riff
title: Crazy Riff
description:
Dark Bard Song skill. Use up all of your Momentum to really shred your instrument. All allies (including yourself) within a 5 range Circle around you take Sound Kickback Damage and restore FP based on the amount of Momentum used (based on Rank).

If at least 3+ Momentum was used, Trickery: Automatically activate Pyrotechnics if the skill was equipped.

name: Second Set
title: Second Set
description: Dark Bard Song skill. Play a refreshing tune with your instrument, giving all allies in the same battle enough energy for a second set. All allies with Darkness Hype consume it to restore HP equal to its LV plus a bonus based on Rank, and for every 50 LV, they gain one (or more) of the following buffs in order: +5 HP Regen, +5 FP Regen, +5 Scaled Weapon Attack, +5 Hit, +5 Critical, and +5 to all stats, for 5 rounds.

name: Obey Your Master
title: Obey Your Master
description:
Dark Bard Song skill. Play your instrument towards two different locations up to 5 Range away. Applies to all tiles in a line from your position to those locations, depending on if there is a unit or not in it:

Unit - Deals Sound magic damage. (Enemies take full damage and may be inflicted with Confusion for 2 rounds, allies take Kickback Damage.)

No Unit - Creates a Shadow Mosh (if none exist in that tile).

name: The Pit
title: The Pit
description:
Time to teach them what a real show is like.

Targets a 2-4 Size Ring of tiles around you and creates a Shadow Mosh at each of those locations (except locations occupied by a unit, dense tile, or Shadow Mosh).

name: Dark Revelry
title: Dark Revelry
description:
A little bit of pain just makes the music more rockin'.

Allies who take damage from your Dark Bard skills gain Darkness Hype LV 10 (max LV: 300, max 10 rounds).

Darkness Hype: This is a stacking buff given by taking damage from allied Dark Bard skills. On its own, the effect grants +1 to all Elemental ATK per 10 LV. At the end of a battle, allies with Darkness Hype recover HP equal to its LV.

In addition, Darkness Hype may be used or consumed by other Dark Bard skills to gain bonus effects.

name: Power to the People
title: Power to the People
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a SP slot.
description:
Parry skill (but only active in certain conditions). Allied units, including yourself, within 1 Range of one or more Shadow Moshes, gain a chance to parry enemy damage, reducing it by 35% (50% if the attacker is Confused). The chance is equal to 15% per Shadow Mosh in 1 Range (+25% for the owner of this skill).

When triggered, a random Shadow Mosh in 1 Range will be blown away.

name: Bard's Dexterity
title: Bard's Dexterity
description:
A bard has to be dexterous to play their instruments well. Whether that be with fingers, teeth, or tongue depends on the situation.

Passively boosts Hit for Axe and Instrument weapons by 5.

name: Dark Bard's Pledge
title: Dark Bard's Pledge
description:
Pledge allegiance to the state of rock and roll.

Passively increases SAN and STR. Also grants you immunity to damage dealt by Dark Bard skills from other non-Confused allied units. (Effects like Darkness Hype will still be given, even if the damage is ignored.)

name: Distorted Beat
title: Distorted Beat
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a SP slot.
description:
There's just something a little different about this song...

Bard base class Song skills now deal Kickback Damage to allies when played, but those allies also gain Dark Distortion LV5 for 3 rounds, 1 attack.

Dark Distortion: +LV*2 Evade, +LV Armor and Magic Armor. Expires after being attacked.

name: Elemental Shredding
title: Elemental Shredding
description:
Rip apart all defenses and let the songs flow like blood.

While you are under the effect of Volume Up, skills from Bard classes that deal Fire, Dark, or Sound damage ignore up to 15% of enemies' elemental resistance. (This does not reduce those resistances below 0%.)

name: Getting Into it
title: Getting Into It
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a SP slot.
description:
An enemy absorbing, reflecting, or being immune to your Fire, Dark, or Sound damage triggers the following effects for 2 Rounds (3 if Volume Up is active):

1) Disables absorb, reflect, and immunity for that element.

2) Inflicts Lingering Damage LV X (X = half of damage) of the same type, and Battle Rush LV 5.

3) Infliction-based chance to apply Confusion.

name: Bellowing Stag
title: Bellowing Stag
power: 50% Dark ATK + 100/110/120% Scaled Weapon ATK + 15% Rage Energy
description: Matador stance. Requires at least 10 Rage Energy and consumes 15% of your total Rage Energy on use. You let out a mighty bellow, inflicting Dark magic damage based on Rank + Rage Energy consumed to all enemies in a 2 Range circle. If a damaged enemy is Airborne, they are knocked away 3 tiles and knocked down by the roar.

name: Chaser
title: Chaser
description:
Sword skill. Targets a 5 Range line in a cardinal direction from you and you move along it. The first enemy hit takes weapon-based damage, and on-hit effects are applied to them.

If used while Airborne, movement will continue until you hit an Airborne enemy (you still damage enemies). Airborne enemies are knocked back by the full range of the skill and knocked down.

name: Crashing Bull
title: Crashing Bull
description:
Matador stance. Requires 15 Rage Energy. Can only be used while Airborne. You come crashing down to the ground, dealing Dark magic damage to all enemies within a 2 Range Circle, as well as launching them Airborne.

If you are Grappling an enemy: You throw that enemy to the ground insteaad, increasing damage to all enemies by 15%, and damage the Grappled target takes ignores evasion.

name: Desperado Stance
title: Desperado Stance
description:
The Desperado is a man with nothing to lose, whose life and death is determined by how quick he draws his gun. They masterfully manipulate the art of gunplay and can take on large quantities of enemies effortlessly.

When you use this skill or a Desperado stance skill, your active stance becomes Desperado. Desperado stance increases your Hit by 5.

name: Double Down
title: Double Down
description:
Sword skill. Can only be used while Airborne. Swing down your weapon on a foe in a downward arc, using your fall to build up momentum. Performs a basic attack on a target within 1 Range; if it hits, inflicts Wear Down LV X (X = 2 + Rank) for 2 Rounds (3 Rounds on critical hit). If the target is Airborne, it also has a chance to inflict Knocked Down.

This skill will bring you and the target down to the ground, ending Airborne.

name: Elemental Rave
title: Elemental Rave
description:
Sword skill. Airborne Compatible. Deals physical Slash damage over 4 hits to one enemy within 1 Range.

If you and your target are both Airborne, the damage becomes magic damage and alternates between Fire, Ice, Wind and Lightning, and is increased by 10% of those respective ATKs.

name: Lead Storm
title: Lead Storm
description: Desperado stance. All enemies within a 3 Range circle are hit with a shower of projectiles, dealing damage based on your Gun's weapon damage type and applying on-hit effects to each of them once. If you are Airborne, the circle's size is doubled.

name: Nitrogen Drop
title: Nitrogen Drop
description: Desperado stance. Unleash a volatile bullet as a projectile in a line that will travel up to your Gun's attack range away. Upon contacting an enemy or at the end of its range, the bullet will burst into a massive explosion, dealing Blunt physical damage that ignores evasion. All damaged enemies are also launched Airborne. If you are in the explosion radius, you also become Airborne.

name: Quick and Wild
title: Quick and Wild
description: Desperado stance. A fast burst of bullets to lighten up your enemy's day. Targets 1 enemy within 3 Range and performs a basic attack on them with an equipped Gun weapon, which deals only 20% of its normal damage.

name: Reaver Stance
title: Reaver Stance
description:
The Reaver is a mighty melee fighter that is not bound by the normal laws of soldiers, making combat look more like a bloody dance than a battle.

When you use this skill or a Reaver stance skill, your active stance becomes Reaver. Reaver stance increases your Scaled Weapon Attack by 5, and enhances some Offensive skills.

name: Retaliate
title: Retaliate
description:
Matador stance. Give one enemy cabrone within 1 Range the horns, dealing unresistable Dark damage to them equal to your accumulated Rage Energy. Afterwards, your Rage Energy resets to 0.

Gains 1 Range per 10 Rage Energy available, to a max of 10 Range. Using this skill on an enemy outside of 1 Range will spend 5 Rage Energy (per tile) to move you next to them, before triggering its effect.

name: Rising Tide
title: Rising Tide
description: Sword skill. Targets a single tile within 1 Range (it can be an empty tile). Any enemy in that tile takes weapon-based physical damage. Both you and the target then become Airborne.

name: Wild Ride
title: Wild Ride
description: Desperado stance. Targets 1 Knocked Down enemy within 2 Range. You jump on top of and ride them in that direction for X tiles (based on Rank). Every tile you move, you shoot off a round at a random enemy, performing a basic attack that deals 50% damage (max 2 times per enemy). The enemy you are riding on will trigger special effect tiles, but you will not, and after the ride ends, they will be knocked away 3 tiles and cured of Knocked Down.

name: Iron Bull
title: Iron Bull
description: Matador stance. Prepare yourself to weather the worst, raising your arms to defend yourself; this skill behaves just like the Guard skill normally does, but does not require a Shield.

name: Matador Stance
title: Matador Stance
description:
The Matador is a wild berserker more like a bull than a tamer, storing Rage Energy from damage they take and unleashing it back on their enemies.

When you use this skill or a Matador stance skill, your active stance becomes Matador. Matador stance increases Armor/Magic Armor by 2, and 30% of damage you take is stored as Rage Energy.

This is a special resource generated for the Demon Hunter class, while in the Matador stance. Certain Matador skills will interact with it, or require a certain amount to use.

Rage Energy expires when battle ends, and if you are not in Matador Stance when a new round starts, you lose 5.

name: Cobra Stance
title: Cobra Stance
description:
The Cobra is a slippery fighter, capable of getting out of any tight danger and avoiding deadly attacks as if they were nothing. A fast, free-flowing style, much like an agilie snake's approach.

When you use this skill or a Cobra stance skill, your active stance becomes Cobra. Cobra stance increases your Evade by 5.

name: Descending Uroboros
title: Descending Uroboros
description:
Cobra Stance. Can only be used while Airborne. Targets 2 tiles in 3 Range; in Location 1, there can be an airborne enemy (optional), and Location 2 must be an unoccupied tile. You move towards Location 2, landing and regaining FP based on Rank.

If you targeted an Airborne enemy, you wrap your legs (or facsimile) around them, carrying them along for the ride, before slamming them into the ground, knocking them down and dealing 35 armor-ignoring Blunt damage to them.

name: Leaping Lizard
title: Leaping Lizard
description:
Cobra Stance. You spring into the air quickly, causing you to become Airborne.

Being within 1 Range of an enemy reduces the Momentum cost of this skill to 0.

name: Snake Lash
title: Snake Lash
description: Cobra Stance. Can only be used while Airborne, and must target an Airborne enemy. Applies the Grapple skill to the target (but does not activate bonus Grapple effects).

name: Winged Serpent
title: Winged Serpent
description:
Cobra Stance. Can only be used while Airborne. You dash in a 2-X Range line (based on Rank), flying over all enemies, obstacles, and hazards. (The last tile of the line must be a valid battle tile.)

If this skill is not subject to Repeat Action yet, it costs 1 Momentum to use.

name: Bonus Bloodshed
title: Bonus Bloodshed
extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Turn slashing into style. At the start of a new round (excluding the start of battle), if you are in Reaver stance and do not have an elemental effect active, you gain a 1 round Elemental status based on your Starsign. (Nerhaven, if none of that element doesn't have an enchantment.)

name: Bullet Barrier
title: Bullet Barrier
extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Parry skill. The ultimate counter to bullets will always be more bullets; swords be damned. While you are in Desperado Stance and have a Gun equipped, you gain a chance to parry Gun and Bow weapons (skills & attacks, excluding spells). (25% + half of Scaled GUI chance to activate, 50% damage reduction.)

name: Clay Pidgeon
title: Clay Pidgeon
description: Make your enemies into little more than targets to shoot. While you are in Desperado Stance:

name: Combination Fighter
title: Combination Fighter
extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Make a masterful dance of blows that leave your enemies bewildered and jealous. Toggle skill. While toggled on, using Demon Hunter Offensive skills (excluding skills with a base Momentum cost of 1, Retaliate, and Wild Ride) or a Soldier Offensive skill reduces the Momentum and FP cost of all skills of those types that you have not used this round by 1, but reduces their damage by 25%. This effect can stack up to 2 times (to a minimum of 1 Momentum and a maximum penalty of 50%.)

name: Danger Sense
title: Danger Sense
extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Instantly tell where the enemy is hitting you. While you are in Cobra Stance, if you take damage from an enemy you are not facing, you turn to face them immediately afterwards.

name: Goring Horns
title: Goring Horns
description: Leave a mark your foes won't forget. Enemies damaged by Matador skills have their maximum HP reduced for X Rounds (based on Rank). This effect can stack infinitely, but maximum reduction per damage instance is capped at 50 (excluding Retaliate, which has no cap).

name: Know No Pain
title: Know No Pain
extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Block blows with your forearms, letting your enemies know you mean business. While you are in Matador Stance, you gain a chance to parry monster weapons & non-ranged weapons (skills & attacks, excluding spells) (as long as you are facing the attacker). (25% + half of Scaled DEF chance to activate, 50% damage reduction.) Successful activation generates 15 Rage Energy.

name: Martial Lawbreaker
title: Martial Lawbreaker
extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: The rules are so boring. Toggle skill. While toggled on and you are in Reaver Stance, all Demon Hunter Sword skills, and all Soldier Offensive skills will use your Main Weapon, whatever that may be, instead of its intended weapon type. (For example, you could use Thousand Stab with a Sword, or Roundtrip with a Spear, etc.)

name: Snake Dancer
title: Snake Dancer
extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Dance around your foe's attacks, frustrating them. While in Cobra Stance, when you evade an attack; Trickery - All Cobra skills' Momentum costs are reduced by 1 for 2 Rounds. (While the effect is active, it cannot be reapplied.)

name: Cobra Stance
title: Gradient Blur
description:
Become a blur, switching between multiple stances with beautiful ease. All Stance changing skills become Airborne Compatible, and their first use in a Round will restore 1 Momentum.

When Auto-Stance Swapping, you gain a stacking buff for 1 Round that increases Scaled Weapon Power by 2.

name: Coyote Pack
title: Coyote Pack
description:
Unleash the wild cries of the swift hunters of the night; coyotes hunt in packs, after all.

While you are using two Shotgun weapons, you gain the ability to Twin Dance with them, even at range. If you have the Akimbo skill active, you can also gain the effect while wielding a Shotgun and a Handgun.

name: Jump Cancel
title: Jump Cancel
description: Everything becomes new again when you do it in the air. Once per Round, using Leaping Lizard will reset Repeat Action tracking, as well as remove Combination Fighter.

name: Pizza Lover
title: Pizza Lover
description: Pizza is a Demon Hunter's best and most loyal friend. Doubles the HP and FP Regen of all Pizza foods.

name: Aero of Disaster
title: Aero of Disaster
description:
Targets a 2 Size Circle up to 5 Range away and creates a violent squall within it. All enemies in it take Wind magic damage that can critical (+25% damage), and are spun around. +1 size of Mass is active.

Plant tiles (excluding Druid Plants) are torn from the ground, dealing armor-ignoring Earth bonus damage to 1 random enemy or other ally (max 3 per enemy, 1 per ally as Kickback Damage). Other tiles apply an Aero Shift (3) effect.

This is an effect typically created by wind element abilities, often listed as Aero Shift (X), where X is a number.

When applied to a tile, any movable field effects in that tile (such as rocks) are blown away tiles equal to the Aero Shift value. For example, Aero Shift (2) will blow the object away 2 tiles. The direction an object moves is usually away from the center of the effect.

Objects which collide with a unit may have additional effects; rocks, for example, can inflict stun. Other objects may be vulnerable to the wind and will dissipate from the Aero Shift; for example, Smokescreens, clouds of spores, etc. will disappear entirely.

name: Fulgur of Duplicity
title: Fulgur of Duplicity
description:
Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range, and creates a burst of static energy, dealing Lightning magic damage that can critically hit (+25% damage). If the target is hit and has a copiable effect, and an ally is within 3 Range of them, the lightning jolts to 1 of those allies randomly, dealing 25% of the damage as Kickback Damage, but they copy one of those effects (same duration, half LV).

If Mass is active, you can target 2 different tiles.

name: Geo of Crumbling
title: Geo of Crumbling
description:
Targets a 2 Size Circle up to 5 Range away and creates an eroding quake. All enemies within that circle take Earth magic damage that can critically hit (+25% damage). Enemies that are hit suffer from Wear Down LV X, if critically hit they suffer from Lingering Damage (Earth) LV X instead. This lasts for 3 rounds. +1 size if Mass is active.

Trickery: All enemy-placed attackable field objects in the circle take 10 damage.

(Wear Down reduces armor by LV.)

name: Summon Animal Companion (Bear)
title: Animal Companion (Bear)
description:
Grants you access to an Animal Companion, the Bear, a bulky and disruptive momma bear. Passively grants access to the skills Bear Bash (Call), Bear Hug (Call), and Bear Zerk (Call).

Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and summons the Bear to it, or targets the Bear and unsummons in. Unsummoning the Bear recovers 2M, but puts it on a 1 round CD (+1 round if the Bear was at less than 50% HP).

name: Summon Animal Companion (Wolf)
title: Animal Companion (Wolf)
description:
Grants you access to an Animal Companion, the Wolf, a powerful hunting beast. Passively grants access to the skills Wolf Run (Call), Wolf Howl (Call), and Wolf Agility (Call).

Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and summons the Wolf to it, or targets the Wolf and unsummons in. Unsummoning the Wolf recovers 2M, but puts it on a 1 round CD (+1 round if the Wolf was at less than 50% HP).

name: Wild Shape (Bear)
title: Wild Shape (Bear)
description:
Utilize the power of nature to Wild Shapeshift into a Bear. Whil ein Bear form, you gain bonuses to the following stats; DEF, RES, VIT.

You also gain a bonus to Armor and Scaled Weapon Attack, and access to the various skills listed in Wild Shape (Bear).

An animal form that the Druid can Wild Shapeshift into. While in this form, your race changes, you gain bonuses to various stats, and gain access to certain skills. However, you cannot cast spells.

When using the basic attack granted by this form, a special weapon is used. Additionally, when using these skills, you gain the benefit as if the animal were using them, and they do not affect your ability to use Calls of the same animal, etc.

Race Changed To: Beast

Stat Bonuses: DEF, RES, VIT, Armor, Scaled Weapon Attack

Additional Skills:

•Bear Maul (Weapon: Wild Bear Claw)

• Bear Bash

• Bear Hug

• Bear Zerk

• End Wild Shape

name: Wild Shape (Hawk)
title: Wild Shape (Hawk)
description:
Utilize the power of nature to Wild Shapeshift into a Hawk. While in Hawk form, you gain bonuses to the following stats; CEL, LUC, SKI.

You also gain a bonus to Evade and Hit, and access to the various skills listed in Wild Shape (Hawk).

An animal form that the Druid can Wild Shapeshift into. While in this form, your race changes, you gain bonuses to various stats, and gain access to certain skills. However, you cannot cast spells.

When using the basic attack granted by this form, a special weapon is used. Additionally, when using these skills, you gain the benefit as if the animal were using them, and they do not affect your ability to use Calls of the same animal, etc.

Race Changed To: Avian

Stat Bonuses: CEL, LUC, SKI, Evade, Hit

Additional Skills:

• Hawk Dive (Weapon: Wild Hawk Talon)

• Hawk Strike

• Hawk Glide

• Hawk Gale

• End Wild Shape

name: Wild Shape (Viper)
title: Wild Shape (Viper)
description:
Utilize the power of nature to Wild Shapeshift into a Viper. While in Viper form, you gain bonuses to the following stats; CEL, GUI, RES.

You also gain a bonus to Evade and Critical, and access to the various skills listed in Wild Shape (Viper).

An animal form that the Druid can Wild Shapeshift into. While in this form, your race changes, you gain bonuses to various stats, and gain access to certain skills. However, you cannot cast spells.

When using the basic attack granted by this form, a special weapon is used. Additionally, when using these skills, you gain the benefit as if the animal were using them, and they do not affect your ability to use Calls of the same animal, etc.

Race Changed To: Serpent

Stat Bonuses: CEL, GUI, RES, Evade, Magic Armor

Additional Skills:

• Viper Brushbite (Weapon: Wild Viper Fang)

• Viper Venom

• Viper Antivenom

• Viper Wrap

• End Wild Shape

name: Wild Shape (Wolf)
title: Wild Shape (Wolf)
description:
Utilize the power of nature to Wild Shapeshift into a Wolf. While in Wolf form, you gain bonuses to the following stats; STR, SKI, CEL.

You also gain a bonus to Evade and Critical, and access to the various skills listed in Wild Shape (Wolf).

An animal form that the Druid can Wild Shapeshift into. While in this form, your race changes, you gain bonuses to various stats, and gain access to certain skills. However, you cannot cast spells.

When using the basic attack granted by this form, a special weapon is used. Additionally, when using these skills, you gain the benefit as if the animal were using them, and they do not affect your ability to use Calls of the same animal, etc.

Race Changed To: Beast

Stat Bonuses: STR, SKI, CEL, Evade, Critical

Additional Skills:

• Wolf Strike (Weapon: Wild Wolf Claw)

• Wolf Run

• Wolf Howl

• Wolf Agility

• End Wild Shape

name: Aero of Kindness
title: Aero of Kindness
description:
Targets a 2 Size Circle in 5 Range and conjures a healing breeze. Allies and Druid Plants within it enhances it, recovering HP and giving HP Regeneration LV X (Rank x 8, 1 round) Heal and Regen duration increase based on enhancement (up to 150% wind ATK, 5 rounds); Druid Plants count as 'half' an ally. +1 size if Mass is active.

If 3+ allies affected, their enemy-caused effect durations are cut by 1 round, and all Druid Plants in the circle apply Growth 1.

name: Canto of Nature
title: Canto of Nature
description:
Song skill. Targets 1 tile within 5 Range, which has a flower, Druid Plant or Plant ally in it, and fills it with galdric energies. Flowers will grow in size, increasing their effective range, while Druid Plants will apply Growth 1. Plant allies gain Encourage LV X (X = Rank) for 5 rounds.

If the skill only affects a flower or Druid Plant, the skill refunds 2M.

name: Nature's Bounty
title: Nature's Bounty
description:
Targets 1 tile within 5 Range, and plants a Sweet Apple Sapling at that tile. If Mass is active, you can target 2 tiles. The second will create a Sweet Strawberry Sapling.

Growth Period: 3 Created by the Druid skill Nature's Bounty. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

A relatively unremarkable plant, but with a remarkable fruit.

HP: Not Attackable

Bloom: Grows a Sweet Apple.

Special: Units (including enemies) within 1 Range of the Sweet Apple Sapling can eat the fruit to recover 25% of their maximum FP. Eating the fruit destroys the plant.

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Recovery percentage increases by 10. Additionally, grants the eater Damage Amplified (LV 10, 5 rounds. Damage Amplified increases all damage dealt by LV%.).

Quickness Tending - Recovery percentage increases by 5. If an enemy tries to eat from the tree, they only have a (Enemy's CEL)% chance to successfully eat it. If they fail, they cannot attempt to eat it again for 1 round.

Growth Period: 3 Created by the Druid skill Nature's Bounty. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

A relatively unremarkable plant, but with a remarkable fruit.

HP: Not Attackable

Bloom: Grows a Sweet Strawberry.

Special: Units (including enemies) within 1 Range of the Sweet Strawberry Sapling can eat the fruit to recover 25% of their maximum HP. Eating the fruit destroys the plant.

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Recovery percentage increases by 10. Additionally, grants the eater Protection Up (LV 10, 5 rounds. Protection up increases Phys. and Mag. Defense by LV.).

Quickness Tending - Recovery percentage increases by 5. If an enemy tries to eat from the tree, they only have a (Enemy's CEL)% chance to successfully eat it. If they fail, they cannot attempt to eat it again for 1 round.

name: Summon Animal Companion (Hawk)
title: Animal Companion (Hawk)
description:
Grants you access to an Animal Companion, the Hawk, a flying eye in the sky. Passively grants access to the skills Hawk Strike (Call), Hawk Glide (Call), and Hawk Gale (Call).

Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and summons the Hawk to it, or targets the Hawk and unsummons in. Unsummoning the Hawk recovers 2M, but puts it on a 1 round CD (+1 round if the Wolf was at less than 50% HP).

name: Burning Bush
title: Burning Bush
description:
Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and plants a Burning Bush Sapling at it. If Mass is Active, you can target 2 tiles.

Growth Period: 3

Created by the Druid skill Burning Bush. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

These plants secrete an oil that ignites from friction of the vines rubbing together, producing smoke that attracts and incapacitates insects, which it then consumes.

HP: 20

Bloom: Deals Fire magic damage equal to 25 + (LV x 10)% of your Fire ATK to all enemies within 4 Range.

On New Round: Lashes out with a burning vine at an enemy within 2 Range, which deals 25 + (LV x 5)% of your Fire ATK as Fire magic damage (with Great Accuracy). If it hits, the target may be inflicted with Burn (LV 10, 2 rounds).

Special: These blazing vines are immune to fire-based effects that destroy plants.

Special 2: Aero Shift effects will spread the plant's oil onto enemies within 2 Range, inflicting them with Dangerous Liquid (2 rounds).

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Effective LV is increased by 25%.

Quickness Tending - Effective Range is increased by 1.

name: Dragging Vines
title: Dragging Vines
description:
Targets 2 tiles in 8 Range. Location 1 must contain one of your bloomed Druid Plants, and Location 2 must contain a unit within 5 Range of it. Grasping vines outreach from the plant, pulling the target unit 3 tiles closer to it.

If Predator and Prey is active and the target is an enemy, it deals 30 protection-ignoring Darkness damage, and restores 30 HP to you.

name: Dragging Vines
title: Devil Vines
description:
Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and plants a Devil Vines Sapling at it. If Mass is Active, you can target 2 tiles.

Growth Period: 1

Created by the Druid skill Devil Vines. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

These thorn-covered vines seemingly feed on the suffering of those who move through them, and are notorious for spreading like weeds.

HP: 30

Bloom: Creates another Devil Vines Sapling at a valid tile within 2 Range of itself.

Stepped On: Any unit who steps on a tile containing Devil Vines take armor-ignoring Pierce damage equal to its LV. This also damages the plant for 10 HP, however; boss enemies will deal 30 HP instead, as they completely trample the vines.

Special: An allied unit of the placer that is within 1 Range of Devil Vines gains a chance to parry physical damage (35% Reduction, 50% Chance) as the vines move to protect them.

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Effective LV is increased by 25%.

Quickness Tending - Parry success chance increased to 60%.

name: Fulgur of Flight
title: Fulgur of Flight
description:
Targets a 2 Size Circle up to 5 Range away and charges the area with polarized electricity, while also planting a Fulgurbloom Sapling in the center (Druids only). +1 Size if Mass is active.

In that area; all units take 15 Lightning magic Kickback Damage, are cured of Knocked Down (and gain immunity if so), go Airborne, recover X FP (Rank x 15), cut the duration of Interference, and Elemental Pierce (Wind) LV X (Rank x 5, 3 rounds).

Growth Period: 3 Created by the Druid spell Fulgur of Flight. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

The pollen of this plant manipulates electrical charges in the air it flows through, creating a deadly atmosphere of static.

HP: 20

Bloom: Creates Static Fields LV X (LV x 2, 2 rounds) at all tiles within 5 Range. (Deals armor-ignoring Lightning damage when created, stepped on, and at the start of a new round.)

On New Round: Creates Static Fields LV X (LV, 2 rounds) at all tiles within 2 Range.

Static Field tiles will only be created in tiles which do not already have them.

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Effective LV is increased by 25%.

Quickness Tending - Effective Range is increased by 1

name: Geo of Drought
title: Geo of Drought
description:
Targets a 2 Size Circle in 5 Range and dries out the air in it, while also planting a Bristleblade Sapling in the center (Druids only). +1 Size of Mass is active.

The target area is subjected to an instantaneous Natural Drought.

Growth Period: 3 Created by the Druid spell Geo of Drought. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

A hardy, leafless plant with extremely sharp branches. It is capable of thriving in environments other plants cannot.

HP: 20

Bloom: Deals X armor-ignoring Slash damage (LV x 10) to all enemies in 4 Range.

On New Round: Deals X armor-ignoring Slash damage (LV x 2) to all enemies in 2 Range.

Special: Aero Shift effects will sway the plant in place, applying its On New Round effect.

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Effective LV is increased by 25%.

Quickness Tending - Effective Range is increased by 1.

This is a magical effect created by the Druid spell Geo of Drought.

Within that area, the duration of all water-based effects and tiles are cut, such as;

• Soaked

• Brine Blade

• Refreshing Flow

• Water Veil

• Dancing Tentacles, Dark Water, Flooded Water, etc.

This applies to all units and tiles. If you are a Monoclass Druid, your control of the magic is stronger; field tiles are affected the same, but only negative effects for allies and positive effects for enemies receive the duration cut.

Additionally, enemies within the drought suffer from Elemental Pierce (Fire) LV X (Rank x 5, 3 rounds), and if they're a water-based monster, they may be inflicted with Burn of the same LV and duration.

name: Listblume
title: Listblume
description:
Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and plants a Listblume Sapling at it. If Mass is Active, you can target 2 tiles.

Growth Period: 3

Created by the Druid skill Listblume. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

The fragrance of this plant's flower is said to lead animals to it. Once enchanted, the plant's pollen drives them to kill other animals attracted to the Listblume, where the remains feed its rooted soil with nutrients.

HP: 20

Bloom: All enemies within 5 Range are inflicted with Charm LV X (X = LV, 3 rounds) and perform their main hand weapon's basic attack skill on one of your enemies within 3 Range of them (or themself, if none) for 50% damage. Bosses will resist the compulsion to attack themselves.

On New Round: Attempts to inflict enemies within 3 Range with Charm LV X (X = LV, 3 rounds).

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Effective LV is increased by 25%.

Quickness Tending - Effective Range is increased by 1.

name: Mortefiore
title: Mortefiore
description:
Targets an enemy within 5 Range and attempts to sow a deadly seed in their body, dealing 15 protection-ignoring Earth damage. If the attack hits, they will be inflicted with Mortefiore, the duration depends on an infliction check; if successful, 3 rounds, if not, 5 rounds.

Certain races may not be valid hosts for the plant. A unit can only be inflicted with Mortefiore once per Battle.

Sewn with a deadly plant. At start of new round, drain FP by LV. If duration is 1, painfully blooms, dealing Darkness damage based on LV (ignores Immunity/Absorb/Reflect); LV x 25 if causer level + 10 is greater or equal to this unit's level and this unit is a monster, or LV x 10 otherwise. Then inflicts Cursed Wound (LV = dmg dealt, 5 rounds) and Darkness Resistance Down (LV = level, 5 rounds).

name: Summon Animal Companion (Viper)
title: Animal Companion (Viper)
description:
Grants you access to an Animal Companion, the Viper, a sneaky and swift snake. Passively grants access to the skills Viper Venom (Call), Viper Antivenom (Call), and Viper Wrap (Call).

Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and summons the Viper to it, or targets the Viper and unsummons in. Unsummoning the Viper recovers 2M, but puts it on a 1 round CD (+1 round if the Wolf was at less than 50% HP).

name: Transplant
title: Transplant
description: Targets 2 tiles in 8 Range. Location 1 must contain one of your plant tiles (except non-Bloomed Druid Plants), and Location 2 must be an empty tile containing no plants. A flash of druidic magic instantly relocates that plant to a new location.

name: Active Animal Companion
title: Active Animal Companion
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description:
You and your favorite companion are used to working together.

At the start of battle, you automatically summon the first equipped Animal Companion to a tile within 1 Range of you.

Druids often work in tandem with the forces of nature, as their goals are often aligned. As such, they often employ animal companions as allies, who protect the Druid and follow its instructions.

The Druid has access to a few different Animal Companion skills. Simply having these skills equipped will give them additional access to 3 'Call' skills that utilize the animal's talents, which briefly call the animal companion to the battlefield to perform an action.

These skills have a shared cooldown on a per-animal basis. For example, utilizing one of the Wolf's Call skills will put its other Call skills, and the ability to summon them, on cooldown (dependent on the skill). However, even if you use one of the Wolf's Call skills, you will still be able to use the Bear's Call skills (if they aren't also on CD).

You can also use the skill directly to summon the animal companion as a unit to battle. When summoned this way, its level is equal to your character level, and it will be summoned with 3M immediately available. While summoned, however, you will not be able to use the companion's Call skills. You can use the skill on the companion again to unsummon them.

Animal Companions do not carry over HP/FP between battles, or even through multiple summons; they will always be summoned with full HP and FP.

When defeated, all of an Animal Companion's skills (including Calls) are put on a 6 round CD. However, they also drop a Druid Totem at their current location. If you enter the same tile as this totem, you will pick it up and accelerate the companion's CD by 3 rounds. Enemies can attack it to destroy it, to deny you this bonus.

Utilize caution and unsummon your animal companion if they are in dire straits, or you may find yourself without them when it matters most.

If an Animal Companion's skill references Rank, it means the master's rank of the Animal Companion skill that grants access to it. If a monster, wild animal, or other unit uses those skills somehow, it defaults to max Rank (3).

Animal Companions may also have benefits to their skills if they are Invigorated or Quickened. These benefits do not apply when using the Call versions of their skills, only when they are used by the companion while summoned. See individual skills for further information.

name: Druidic Tending
title: Druidic Tending
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description:
The Druid's Invigoration & Quickness spells become effective on their own Druid Plants. These spells grant the same type of Tending, which enhances the plant permanently; see plant descriptions for details.

But, Invigoration & Quickness gain a 1 round CD, and can only affect a number of your plants per single cast equal to the skill's Rank.

Druids are knowledgeable in special natural magic rituals that manipulate or grow plants. They have several skills that plant magical saplings at certain locations.

Each sapling has a Growth Stage and a Growth Period.

• Growth Stage - Starts at 0, and increases by 1 at the start of a new round. Certain Druid skills can accelerate this, listed as 'apply Growth X', where X is a number. Growth 1, for example, increases Growth Stage by 1.

• Growth Period - When the plant's Growth Stage reaches this value, it will Bloom.

Generally, saplings have no effect until they bloom. Once they do, they may trigger a Bloom effect (only once) and may have other additional effects, for example those that apply when a new round happens.

After blooming, these plants can also be attacked and destroyed, and most have 20 HP, letting them survive 2 attacks. However, plants created by these effects typically only last 10 rounds, unless prolonged by another effect.

name: Nutrient Brighten
title: Nutrient Brighten
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description:
Magically induced photosynthesis is not normally effective, but these are not normal plants.

Upon using Brighten, any Druid Plants in its target area which do not already have a Light Shaft atop them receive Growth 1.

name: Predator and Prey
title: Predator and Prey
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description:
One hunts, the other feeds. Animal Companion skills (including Calls), Wild Shape skills, and basic attacks of Animal Companions (and you in Wild Shapeshift), gain a Vampiric (10%) effect. Your Dhessence spell recovers twice as much HP.

In exchange, you have -15 Status Resistance VS Hunted, and the LV of Hunted applied to you increases by 5.

name: Still Shape
title: Still Shape
description:
Does not cost SP to equip. While equipped, Wild Shape skills will not change your appearance.

The Druid has the ability to use Wild Shape skills to Wild Shapeshift into various animal forms, changing their appearance and giving them access to certain skills while in that form.

While in a Wild Shape, you cannot cast spells, your race changes to match that of your new form (changing your base stats), and you gain access to a special basic attack, as well as certain skills (similar to those possessed by an Animal Companion). If those skills reference Rank, they are treated as max Rank (3) instead of whatever your Animal Companion skill's rank would be, as you are using the skill as an animal, not a companion.

You can change from one animal form into another without changing back. You can also use End Wild Shape, a 0M skill, to exit your form. However, bear in mind that End Wild Shape has a 1 round CD, so you will be stuck in your Wild Shape should you use it and then transform again. In battle, you will remain in your chosen Wild Shape until you transform again or end it manually.

You cannot use Wild Shape while you are Installed with a Youkai, and attempting to install a Youkai while in Wild Shape will fail.

If you want to use this in your RP, please keep the following in mind:

Druids that are in Wild Shape appear to be animals, but their presence is easy to notice and it is obvious to anyone on sight that they are not a normal animal (excluding brief glances, or the dimwitted). This form requires concentration to maintain, and can be kept for 1 hour concurrently at most, after which the Druid will require rest equal to the amount of time spent shapeshifting before the ability can be used again. Using Wild Shape to shift between forms, or briefly revert to a humanoid form, is treated as one continuous 'use'.

Animals are incapable of speech and therefore cannot talk in a way that is understandable, hence why they cannot cast spells.

You cannot partially Wild Shape yourself; you must take on (or revert from) the full form of the animal. IE, you can't use this ability to grow animal ears or tails, you can't turn only your head into a snake's, and so on.

name: Command Nature
title: Command Nature
description:
The Druid is skilled in commanding the forces of nature, and at times, earning their loyalty.

Plant and Beast enemies can be converted by your Convert skill without being Calmed first. Furthermore, any attempts to Convert one of those races gain a +10% success rate bonus.

name: Lone Wolves
title: Lone Wolves
description:
You work better alone, and so does your animal companion. But you work better alone together.

While you have only one Animal Companion skill in your Skill Pool, the CD of its skills (including Calls) are reduced by 1 round (min. 1). Furthermore, when it is summoned, the Animal Companion's level is increased by 10.

name: Nature's Conduit
title: Nature's Conduit
description:
Serving as a conduit through which nature flows, you can use any weapon made of a Wood material as a casting tool for Nature, Isespian, and Sylphid spells.

Additionally, when you use Pray, all allied Saplings within X Range (X = Rank) receive Growth 2.

name: Couloir
title: Couloir
description: Spear skill. Surprise an enemy with a spear strike from a distance. You perform a basic attack from 3 Range, gaining bonus Hit (based on Rank) due to the swiftness of the strike.

name: Crystal Rose
title: Crystal Rose
description: Sword skill. You charge the edge of your weapon with focus and cut in the air, channeling ice magic and causing the air to freeze and shatter, dealing Ice physical damage to all enemies in the area of effect. Freezing variation also has a chance to inflict Frozen LV 20 for 2 rounds.

name: Cyclone Spear
title: Cyclone Spear
description:
Spear skill. Throw your spear high into the air, where it will fall at a nearby location within 5 Range. Upon landing, it creates a cyclone, dealing Wind damage to all enemies within a 3 Range circle.

All enemies within 5 Range of the spear will be pulled towards it one tile, and all battlefield objects in the damage range will be blown 3 tiles away. If they impact with enemies, they may have special effects.

name: Eclair Lacroix
title: Eclair Lacroix
description:
Sword skill. An attack requiring a great amount of focus, you release a golden X-shaped energy projectile that pierces enemies and travels 6 tiles away, which deals Slash magic damage to all enemies it touches. Upon reaching the end of its path, it will grow and explode, dealing Light magic damage to all enemies within a 4 Range Circle of that location.

Cannot be used during the same turn as basic Movement. Enemies hit by the projectile will take 50% damage from the explosion.

LV1 - +10% Damage per Charge Level

LV2 - Tiles the projectile passes over also receive the explosion effect.

LV3 - Ignores Evasion.

Any weapon that uses this skill can consume active Weapon Charges to gain these effects, depending on the amount consumed

name: L'au-Dela
title: L'au-Dela
description: Sword skill. Attack your target with a dark slash, putting the fear of the grave into them. Performs a basic attack on the target which deals Dark physical damage. If successful, they are also Feared for 2 rounds (3 on a Critical Hit). (Enemies suffer -30 Hit if attacking an enemy that they Fear.)

name: Lance de Lion
title: Lance de Lion
description: Spear skill. An extremely powerful single strike that is unavoidable. Deals physical Pierce damage to all enemies in a 3x3 grid (directly in front of you), but requires an extreme amount of focus, both mentally and literally. If the target is Guarding, they will be Guard Broken before damage is taken, and Evasion cannot be triggered. Cannot be used during the same turn as basic Movement.

name: Photon Rose
title: Photon Rose
description: Spear skill. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and stabs at them in a unique manner, dealing Pierce physical damage. Additionally deals 50% of your Light ATK as Light magic damage that ignores Evasion, but requires a hit check, 3 times. If all 3 hit, a rose of light blooms and all enemies within 4 Range of that target have a chance to be inflicted with Charm LV (Rank*5) for 3 rounds.

name: Power Gradation
title: Power Gradation
description: Sword skill. You unleash a strike with such form that it transcends normal strikes, causing it to deal bonus damage (based on Rank), and deal magic damage instead of physical damage.

name: Sidecut
title: Sidecut
description: Sword skill. A quick forward stab in a line. You will attack all enemies in the line. The last square must be unoccupied, as you will end your travel there.

name: Sillcut
title: Sillcut
description: Spear skill. Pull your spear in a quick motion along a diagonal line, performing an attack on all enemies in it as you move along it. The last tile in the line must be unoccupied.

name: Disengage
title: Disengage
description: Pull back from your current location, hopping backwards up to 3 tiles (or until something blocks you). Upon landing, you recover HP (based on Rank) and gain a bonus to Evade for one attack (lasts 3 rounds).

name: Repel
title: Repel
description: Attacks the target with the intent of pushing them away. If the attack hits, the target is pushed back by 1 square. If the attack is a critical hit, it is increased to 3 squares.

name: Attrait
title: Attrait
description: Take a moment to focus your mind and abilities, giving yourself a good fighting form. Grants Poise and Perfect Poise for X rounds (based on Rank) at their normal values.

name: Sharpen
title: Sharpen
description: Hones your skill, boosting the effectiveness of your weapon, Grants a bonus to all weapons you use for 3 rounds. At Rank 5, the duration is 5 rounds instead.

name: Elangreve
title: Elangreve
extras: This skill does not take up any Skill Pool slots.
description: A true duelist's first strike should be their most beautiful. When attacking with a Spear or Sword, you gain bonus damage equal to twice your Momentum.

name: Eviter
title: Eviter
description:
Toggle skill. Parry skill (only one takes effect at a time).

While on, you will begin using one of your melee weapons (sub by default; else main) as a parrying tool. At a chance equal WPN durability (unbreakable = 40) + a bonus, you can parry attacks and skills (excluding spells) from monster, Sword, Axe, and Spear weapons. Success reduces the damage taken by 50% and WPN durability by 1. Protection from Arrows will let you parry Bows (easier at longer range). You can only parry attacks that you can see, and only if the parrying weapon isn't broken.

name: Fleur
title: Fleur
description: A flowery style that cuts the opponent apart like rose thorns. When you successfully score a Critical Hit with a weapon for the first time in a round, you gain an additional +1 Momentum. (This effect can only trigger on a specific enemy once per round.)

name: Flottement
title: Flottement
description:
Toggle skill. Evasive reaction skill (only one takes effect at a time).

While on, you will step one tile away from attackers you can see within X Range (X = Rank) who miss you with attacks. Upon triggering, you gain Voltiger LV X (or power up an existing status). Voltiger increases the Range of Sidecut and Sillcut by LV and increases the damage they deal by a percentage.

(Max: 25% bonus damage, 10 duration)

name: Riposte
title: Riposte
description: Accepting attacks and then returning them is a basic form of swordplay. When you are attacked in melee range, there is a chance that you will perform an automatic attack on your attacker (but this attack will deal 50% of its normal damage). This skill will not trigger for attacks made directly behind you.

name: One-on-One
title: One-on-One
description: True Duelists excel at just that; dueling. While they are still competent fighters in larger battles, they are better trained against single opponents. While there is only one enemy in the battle, you gain a bonus to all damage you deal. While you are the only living unit in your party, you reduce all damage taken by the same amount.

name: Poise
title: Poise
description:
To have poise means to have the upper hand and it requires quick reflexes. When you are attacked, you gain a bonus to your Critical for your next attack within 2 rounds.

If you evaded the attack, the duration is increased by 1 and you gain Perfect Poise, which doubles the bonus and keeps it active for multiple attacks. Perfect Poise will end if you are hit by a basic attack, and both will be reduced in duration and level (1/3 respectively) if you take any damage exceeding a threshold, based on Rank.

name: Vent Petale
title: Vent Petale
description: A flowery, two-weapon style using both sword and spear. When you have a Sword and Spear equipped at the same time (must be two weapons), you gain a bonus to SKI and DEF, and reduce the FP cost of all Duelist base class skills by 2+Rank. (Min. FP Cost: 0)

name: Deploy: Medibot
title: Deploy: Medibot
description:
Deploys a robot carrying special medical supplies on it at a location within 5 Range, and is most effective when used while Total Control is on.

When a Bot is destroyed, it will leave behind Scrap at its current location. You can pick it up to reduce the FP cost of the next Deploy skill you use.

name: Deploy: Metalaegis
title: Deploy: Metalaegis
description:
Deploys a robot primarily made for protecting you at a target location within 5 Range. The robot will intercept attacks if it is next to you, can create a Reflector to bounce back projectile skills, and is most effective when used while Total Control is on.

When a Bot is destroyed, it will leave behind Scrap at its current location. You can pick it up to reduce the FP cost of the next Deploy skill you use.

name: Deploy: Railgan
title: Deploy: Railgan
description:
Deploys a robot with long-range capabilities at target location in 5 range. Although it cannot move, it has access to a powerful long-range rail shot that deals Light magic damage, provided it can charge up for a turn.

When a Bot is destroyed, it will leave behind Scrap at its current location. You can pick it up to reduce the FP cost of the next Deploy skill you use.

name: Deploy: Turret
title: Deploy: Turret
description:
Deploys a robot primarily made for shooting at a target location within 5 Range. The robot can move and attack with special guns it has, and is most effective when used while Total Control is on.

When a Bot is destroyed, it will leave behind Scrap at its current location. You can pick it up to reduce the FP cost of the next Deploy skill you use.

name: Flamethrower
title: Flamethrower
description: Gun skill. Shoot a stream of fire from your gun in a line, dealing Fire physical damage to all enemies hit, and melting all ice tiles in the path. Any enemies hit may also be Burned and/or Feared for 3 rounds (LV = Rank * 5).

name: Grenade Launcher
title: Grenade Launcher
description: Gun skill. Fires a grenade, which functions like a mini-bomb, to target location within X Range (based on Rank). At the end of the round, it explodes, dealing Fire damage to all enemies within 3 Range. This bomb gains the effects of all skills that affect bombs, but only at 75% effectiveness.

name: Electro Shield
title: Electro Shield
description:
Generate a shield of electricity around you for rounds equal to 2+Rank. While active, the shield will shock any enemy who attacks you with a melee weapon, dealing Lightning magic damage to them, based on Rank.

You can reactivate this skill while it's active to overload it, which will deal Lightning damage to all enemies in a 3 Range circle around you equal to 3x the level of the shield, but will also put it on a 3 round CD.

name: Bashfix
title: Bashfix
description: Axe skill. A tried and true method of getting things to work. Targets an Engineer device within 2 Range and hits on it, curing it of any negative status effects.

name: Repair
title: Repair
description: Can only be used once per round. Fixes up broken machinery, which heals a target Engineer device or Mechanation for your Scaled GUI*2 HP. The heal is half as effective if used on yourself.

name: Upgrade (Electro Shield)
title: Upgrade (Electro Shield)
description: Upgrade skill. Targets an ally within 2 Range. Equips that target with a shield module, which allows them to use the Electro Shield skill. (The skill level for it will be equal to your skill level, or the target's skill level, whichever is higher). They also gain a bonus to Critical, based on rank.

name: Upgrade (Flamethrower)
title: Upgrade (Flamethrower)
description: Upgrade skill. Targets an ally within 2 Range. Equips that target with a flamethrower module, which allows them to use the Flamethrower skill. (The skill level for it will be equal to your skill level, or the target's skill level, whichever is higher). They also gain a bonus to Power, based on rank.

name: Upgrade (Jetpack)
title: Upgrade (Jetpack)
description: Upgrade skill. Targets an ally within 2 Range. Equips that target with a jetpack module, which allows them to use the Jetpack skill. (The skill level for it will be equal to your skill level, or the target's skill level, whichever is higher). They also gain a bonus to Evade, based on rank.

name: Upgrade (Launcher)
title: Upgrade (Launcher)
description: Upgrade skill. Targets an ally within 2 Range. Equips that target with a grenade launcher module, which allows them to use the Grenade Launcher skill. (The skill level for it will be equal to your skill level, or the target's skill level, whichever is higher). They also gain a bonus to Hit, based on rank.

name: Deploy: M.A.P.
title: Deploy: M.A.P.
description:
Deploys a mobile platform at a target location within 5 range. Your machines can attach to this platform; when you use basic Movement skill, all machines within 1 range also move along with you.

Useful for keeping your machines at effective and useful ranges.

name: Jetpack
title: Jetpack
description: Fire up a jetpack stored somewhere on you, quickly launching yourself to a tile within a certain Range away.

name: Overclock
title: Overclock
description: Targets an Engineer device and sends it into overdrive. Upon activation, the target immediately gains 2 Momentum, and will gain that much more every round. However, after every action it takes, it will lose 10% of its maximum HP. If destroyed while Overclocked, it will burst into a lightning explosion that leaves no scrap behind, dealing Lightning damage to all enemies in 3 Range. You can undo this effect by using the skill again.

name: Salvage
title: Salvage
description:
Might as well keep the parts that still work! Targets one of your Engineer devices and destroys it. The target's cooldown is reset and you gain Scrap LV X% (based on Rank). Best used when the Bot might be broken by an enemy.

Scrap reduces the cost of the next Deploy skill by LV%.

name: Good Materials
title: Good Materials
description: It turns out that building your machines out of things other than scrap makes them last longer. Boosts the maximum HP and FP of your Engineer bots by a percentage.

name: Explosive Art
title: Explosive Art
description: While dangerous, making your own tweaks to explosives gives them that personal touch, making them more deadly. Increases the damage of your Bombs.

name: Pure Genius
title: Pure Genius
description: Genius comes in two forms: inspiration and application. Only those who have both are really geniuses! At max rank, gives an additional 1 GUI.

name: Reuse and Recycle
title: Reuse and Recycle
description: Don't let your goodies go to waste. If an Upgrade skill of yours would end prematurely (for example, the battle ending) you recover the 15 FP you spent on the skill. Similarly, if an Engineer Bot is alive at the end of a battle, you will recover 50 FP for each.

name: Special Delivery
title: Special Delivery
description: What is the point of being able to use something if you can't use it from really far away? Increases the Range of Item, Upgrade, and Deploy skills.

name: Technological Marvel
title: Technological Marvel
extras: Increases Skill Pool size by 0.5 for every Engineer skill equipped.
description: Knowing your designs in and out, doing things over and over to get them right to the point of insanity. What word could you use besides 'marvelous'?

name: Toolbelt
title: Toolbelt
description: An Engineer is only as good as their belt, which is often filled with tools, gadgets, or emergency items. Increases the size of your Item Belt.

name: Exgalfa
title: Exgalfa
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range and fires 6 fireballs at them, dealing Fire magic damage to them. Every fireball has an even chance of dealing plus or minus 5*Rank extra damage. (Positive effect chance increases with LUC.) If you are enchanted with Nerhaven, two extra fireballs are fired.

"Burn the body, count the ashes..."

name: Intensify Cold
title: Intensify Cold
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range and rapidly freezes the air around them, dealing Ice magic damage. The target also gains a 50% Weakness to Ice for 3 rounds. If enchanted with Kraken, the target is also inflicted with Frostbite LV (20+ 10 * Rank) for 3 rounds.

"Be scarred by this arctic claw's embrace..."

name: Isenshi
title: Isenshi
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Raises sharp stones in a 6 Range Circle around yourself, dealing Earth magic damage. Airborne enemies within 3 range that are also magnetized by the user are slammed into the ground taking +(Rank*5)% damage, become knocked down, and the Damage has Great accuracy.

If enchanted with Galren, all enemies Magnetized by the user are drawn in 3 tiles prior to damage.

"Rage and pierce, spears of earth..."

name: Libegrande
title: Libegrande
description:
Freeze a sword made of ice at target location and launch it in a line, dealing Ice magic damage to the first enemy hit. Each tile passed over will also be covered in an Ice Sheet that lasts for up to 3 rounds. If enchanted with Kraken, the enemy hit with this spell will suffer from Guard Break (if guarding) before damage is applied.

Excel Crash: Level 1 - 10% Damage per Charge level. Level 2 - Upon hitting an enemy, the sword dances to all other enemies within 3 range circle around the target, dealing slash and Ice damage to them using the spell's normal power. Level 3 - Ignore Evasion.

name: Magaisendo
title: Magaisendo
description:
Targets a 3-tile wide, 5 tile long line in one direction from you. Causes earthen spikes to erupt in that line, dealing Earth magic damage to all enemies hit. If enchanted with Galren, the tremor will also destroy Hardiness 1 Special effect tiles in the area of effect.

Excel Crash: Level 1 - 10% Damage per Charge level. Level 2 - Enemies you have magnetized, who are also in the tiles at your sides, are pushed 1 tiles in the direction you are facing before damage. Rock tiles in the area of effect will explode, and any enemies within 1 range of them will have a chance to be inflicted with Lingering Damage (Earth) Lv X (X = Charges*10) for 1 rounds. Level 3 - Ignore Evasions.

name: Overload
title: Overload
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range and deals Lightning magic damage to them. The damage is further increased by X (based on Rank) for every bonus statistic point they currently have. If enchanted with Redgull, the lightning damage may critically hit.

"Judgmental thunder, turn power into pain..."

name: Ryemei
title: Ryemei
description:
Call down a thunderbolt at a target enemy within 5 Range, dealing Lightning magic damage to them. This spell can critically hit like an attack. If enchanted with Redgull, it may also inflict Interference on the target for 3 rounds.

Excel Crash: Level 1 - +10% Damage per Charge level. Level 2 - Damage pattern becomes a 2-size diamond and create Static Fields LV X (X = 5 +Charge*5) for 2 rounds within that area. Level 3 - Ignore Evasion.

name: Sear
title: Sear
description:
Create a firestorm at the target area, dealing Fire magic damage to all in the area. It will also create Cinders for 3 rounds in the affected area, with a LV equal to 50% of your Fire ATK. If enchanted with Nerhaven, the AoE size is increased slightly.

Excel Crash: Level 1 - 10% Damage per charge level. Level 2 - rapidly melts ice sheets in the area of effect, granting a chance to inflict Burn Lv X (X = 10 + Charges*5) for 2 rounds on any enemy standing on one. Level 3 - Ignore Evasion.

name: Vydel
title: Vydel
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Creates a tornado that rampages through a 3 tile wide, 12 tile long line. Enemies in the path of the tornado are sucked up and taken along for the ride. Afterwards, they are spit out to a random, unoccupied tile, and take Wind magic damage. If enchanted with Talvyd, all enemies are knocked down when they are thrown from the tornado.

"Cut and scatter, fly and disappear..."

name: Wind Slasher
title: Wind Slasher
description:
Creates a sharp blade of wind in a line that cuts through all enemies, dealing Wind magic damage to all enemies hit. The first enemy hit also takes Slash physical damage based on Rank that ignores armor. The size of the line can be resized.

If enchanted with Talvyd, the first enemy hit may be inflicted with Lingering Damage (Slash) with LV equal to the Slash damage, for 3 rounds.

Excel Crash: Level 1 - 10% per charge level. Level 2 - Increases minimum and maximum size by amount of Charges. Level 3 - Ignore Evasion.

name: Absorb Power
title: Absorb Power
description: Open your mind and body to absorb power from the world around you. Can only be used while your FP is below 50% of your Maximum FP. You gain 20+(Rank*10) FP regeneration and reduce your Status Resistance by 15% for 3 rounds.

name: Charge Mind
title: Charge Mind
description: Rev up your mind into a magical battery, gaining Charge Mind LV 3 for 2 rounds. When casting spells from Mage classes that have Excel Crash capabilities, Charge Mind will be expended as if it were Weapon Charges equal to it's LV, then its LV will decrease by 1. (For example, at LV3, it will grant one spell its 3 Charge effect, then become LV2. he next spell will gain its 2 Charge effects, etc. Doesn't stack with Weapon charges.

name: High-Speed Divine Words
title: High-Speed Divine Words
description: Temporarily accelerate your spellcasting abilities, letting you utilize invocations at a much faster speed than normal. For 3 rounds, when casting an Invocation spell from a Mage class, the Momentum cost is 3M, regardless of if the spell is being invoked or casted.

name: Tattoo Refresh
title: Tattoo Refresh
description: Fill your arcane tattoos with power, allowing you to re-activate Arcane Tattoo trait effects. You also gain Tattoo Refresh for 2 rounds, which doubles the effectiveness of your Arcane Tattoo Evoker skill.

name: Elemental Overtime
title: Elemental Overtime
extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Mind over matter, the saying goes. Why not both? After using Charge mind, you also gain Elemental overtime for the same duration, which increases the damage dealt by Elemental Augment by 100%.

name: Ephemeral Insight
title: Ephemeral Insight
description: Focus your mind to the highest level possible. While equipped, when you use Charge Mind while you already have Charge Mind active, you gain Ephemeral Insight for 2 rounds (your Charge Mind duration also becomes 2 rounds). Ephemeral Insight causes the next spell to deal Akashic damage instead of its original damage type and then ends. When Ephemeral Insight ends, you gain Worn Out LV 10 for 2 rounds.

name: Highwrath
title: Highwrath
description: Causes lightning to behave more aggressively, increasing your Critical rate if it is triggered by a lightning effect (such as Redgull Elemental Impacts, or Ryemei).

name: Pure Power
title: Pure Power
description: The truly powerful don't need items. In fact, they just get in the way. For every equipment slot that isn't occupied, you gain a Power bonus to all spells you cast.

name: Arcane Tattoo
title: Arcane Tattoo
description: A special kind of mage marking on the skin that invokes an incantation when supplied with focus, these tattoos are often found on battle-oriented magicians. This skill will reduce the FP cost of the first equipped Mage or Evoker spell in your Skill Pool by 25% if you are using Unarmored or Light Armor torso items. Unarmored torso items will instead reduce it by 40%.

name: Brainstorm
title: Brainstorm
description: Keep the electricity of your charged mind active for longer. Increases the duration of Charge Mind based on Rank.

name: Evocation
title: Evocation
description: The art of utilizing focus in the air around your body to increase the power of Arcana, by drawing it into your body, for which the Evoker is named. While utilizing Light Armor or Unarmored torso items, the damage of all your spells increases based on Rank. Unarmored torso items will grant you twice the bonus.

name: Evoke Retaliation
title: Evoke Retaliation
description: Play with fire, and... you know the rest. When you evade a basic attack, you gain Evoke Retaliation for 2 rounds, which increases the power of your spells by 10, as well as critical by 10 (But only for lightning criticals)

name: Greaper
title: Greaper
description: Your invocations become powerful enough to channel the power of death itself. All spells you cast which require Invocations have their total damage (before resistances are applied) increased based on the Rank of this skill.

name: Lazarus Wind
title: Lazarus Wind
extras: Affected enemies are also Knocked Down.
description: Drawing in such powerful arcane energies causes your invocations to release wind from the demon realm around you. When you begin casting an Invocation spell, enemies with 2 Range are knocked back X tiles (based on Rank).

name: Spiritual Domination
title: Spiritual Domination
description: Pure spiritual power, to put it simply. Increases WIL passively. if at max Rank, further increases WIL by +1.

name: Dive Down
title: Dive Down
description: Spear skill. Can only be used while airborne. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and dives down on them, spear first, performing a basic attack on them with a bonus to Hit. If the target is Airborne, if the attack hits, they are knocked down. If they are not, you inflict Aerial Razor LV X (X = Rank * 2) before the attack hits, which lasts until your next turn. Afterwards, you land.

name: Falcon Strike
title: Falcon Strike
description: Spear skill. Targets a location within 6 Range that is unoccupied, which you swiftly dash towards in a flexible line of tiles, faster than the eye can see. All enemies in those tiles take Pierce physical damage, which ignores evasion. Afterwards, if 3 Magical Feathers are available, they are consumed, and all of your feathers on the battlefield immediately resonate.

name: Feather Veil
title: Feather Veil
description:
Uses 10 Magical Feathers. Creates a spinning shield of feathers around you, which helps you move quickly and protects you from afflictions, granting you +X (based on Rank) Evade and Status Resist for 5 rounds.

Note: There's an in-game typo. "[...] which helps you move [...]" is written as "[...] which help you move [...]".

name: Kestrel Dive
title: Kestrel Dive
description:
Must be Airborne. Dive in a line towards a target location, dealing damage to all enemies you encounter, before landing. If 10 Magical Feathers are available, consumes them and wraps you in an Elemental Kestrel for the duration of the skill, which has a variety of effects.

This is a bonus effect gained by Kestrel Dive for consuming a certain amount of Magical Feathers. It bestows the following benefits to the skill, based on your current elemental (or Fire, if none):

Once the flight ends, the Elemental Kestrel explodes in a 2 Range Circle around you, applying the skill's damage to all enemies in that radius, and creating field tiles based on your elemental for 2 rounds, with a LV equal to half of your Magical Feather LV.

Enemies can only be affected by this skill once per use, even if it misses.

name: Lift Off
title: Lift Off
description: Airborne compatible. Spears can be used as casting tools. Slam your spear into the ground and create a magical burst of elemental energy, which deals elemental damage (based on element enchant - Fire by default) to all enemies in a 2 Range circle around you, knocking them airborne. If 5 Magical Feathers are available, they're consumed and all tiles in the area are covered by magical feathers, and the damage ignores evasion.

name: Oaring
title: Oaring
description: Spear skill. Airborne compatible. Targets 2 locations within 2 Range. In Location 1, there must be an enemy, and Location 2 must be an unoccupied tile. The enemy in L1 takes Pierce physical damage. If you are not airborne, you then move to L2, you pull the target to your old location. If you are airborne, you slam the enemy into L2 instead.

name: Pierce Linker
title: Pierce Linker
description: Spear skill. Thrust your spear forward harshly, performing a basic attack on all enemies in a 3 Range line in front of you, with a bonus to Hit. Each enemy beyond the first takes reduced damage; 75% for the second, 50% for the third.
