If more than one enemy is successfully hit, all enemies hit are inflicted with Immobilize until your next turn.

name: Soaring Spear
title: Soaring Spear
description: Spear skill. Cannot be used while airborne. Take careful aim at an airborne enemy in 10 Range (but further than 2 Range) and throw your spear at them, dealing a large amount of Pierce physical damage to them. The powerful impact also applies or powers up Cursed Wound by half of its damage dealt for 3 rounds.

name: Swooping Stroke
title: Swooping Stroke
description: Spear skill. Can only be used while airborne and must end in an unoccupied tile. You fly forward, sweeping over a 2-5 Range line, dealing Pierce physical damage to all enemies in it, blowing them airborne with a powerful gust of wind.

name: Nest Flight
title: Nest Flight
description:
A quick and Elusive flight which allows you to travel in a 1-4 Range line behind you (which must end in an unoccupied tile, but can pass through enemies). If there is a plant field object in your destination, you use it to protect yourself, gaining bonus Evade for 1 attack, 3 rounds. If there is not, you instead become Airborne, ready to strike, and recover 2m.

Trickery - If Attrait is equipped, activate it automatically.

name: Valley Gale
title: Valley Gale
description: Spear skill. Uses 3+M (1+M if Firebird is your main class). Airborne compatible. Flourishes your Spear around you defensively, granting Guard LV X (X = 10 per Momentum used). If at least 3 Momentum is used, you will also deflect up to 1 Bow or Gun attack. If you are Airborne, you gain the ability to avoid Guard Break once.

name: Burn Away
title: Burn Away
description: Uses 5 Magical Feathers. Targets a different allied unit within 5 Range and inflicts 30 protection-ignoring Fire magic damage to them. Afterwards, the burning strips away impurities and reduces the duration of the longest negative status effect caused by an enemy by 3 rounds.

name: Lighten the Load
title: Lighten The Load
description: Targets all allies within a 5 Range circle around you (including yourself) and encourages them, filling them with inspiration and confidence, and more willing to shoulder burdens. Boosts affected unit's maximum Battle Weight by LV*5, Move by 1, and CEL by LV, for 5 rounds.

name: Roaring Falcon
title: Roaring Falcon
description: Imbue all allies within a 4 Range circle around you with a cry of the falcon, granting them a bonus to Sound ATK, based on Rank, for 5 rounds. In addition, the first basic attack or first time a Firebird skill damages an enemy, that enemy takes armor-ignoring Sound magic damage equal to 50% of the attackers Sound ATK (Guns attacks only apply this once, regardless of how many rounds it fires.

name: Riser
title: Riser
description: Throw 2 Magical Feathers at the ground below any unit (including yourself) within 1 Range, which then creates a powerful gust that knocks that unit Airborne.

name: Wind Flourish
title: Wind Flourish
description: Spear skill. Airborne compatible. You spin your spear wildly while targeting an enemy within 3 Range. If the target is within 1 Range, the wind from the spinning pushes them back 2 tiles. Otherwise, they are pulled 2 tiles towards you. Afterwards, you generate 5 + Rank Magical Feathers for yourself.

name: Ignite Power
title: Ignite Power
description: Absorb the power from the nearby elements. At the start of a new round, gain +X Scaled Weapon Power for 1 round, where X is the number of a specific special effect tile in a certain Range around you. The special effect tile depends on your enchanted element, which defaults to Fire if none are present. (Fire = Cinder, Ice = Ice Sheet, Earth = Plants, Wind = Air Shaft, Lightning = Light Shaft)

name: Kagero
title: Kagero
description: When you attack an enemy unit and trigger a counter-attack skill (such as Riposte) while the tile behind them is unoccupied, if 4 Magical Feathers are available, they are consumed. You then create an elemental copy of yourself at your current location, which takes the attack in your place and explodes, dealing elemental magic damage equal to 100% of your elemental ATK to all enemies in 2 Range of that location. Meanwhile, you appear behind your opponent and create an Air Shaft there for 3 rounds. (Element effect is based on your current elemental enchant, or Fire if none.)

name: Magical Feathers
title: Magical Feathers
description:
The Firebird is defined by magical feathers that aid them. You begin with 10 and generate 2 automatically every new round (max 30). Tiles you move on will consume 1 and cover it. At the end of the round, they resonate, dealing magic damage of your enchanted element (treated as Fire, if none) to any enemy in that tile, then expire. (Damage = Firebird LV + 5, ignores armor)

They also destroy special tiles in their location. (Fire = Ice Sheet, Ice = Cinders, Earth = Void Pollution, Lightning = Dark Water, Wind = Blows away instead.)

At Rank 2, this skill does not take up a skill slot.

name: Roc's Rise
title: Roc's Rise
description: Mainclass Only Skill. When you recover from a knockdown, you unleash a quick burst of magical energy around you, dealing damage equal to your Magical Feather damage and of the same element to all enemies within 2 Range; enemies within 1 Range are also knocked back 1 tile. In addition, if at least 4 Magical Feathers are available, the Momentum penalty of the knockdown is reduced by 1 per 4 consumed. (IE, 4 feathers = -2M, 8 = -1M, 12 = -0M)

name: Boon of Apus
title: Boon of Apus
description: Stay strong, stay safe, stay close, stay quick. During battle, after using 1 each of Offensive, Defensive, Support, and Utility class skills, gain 30 Magical Feathers immediately. (This effect then resets and can be gained again. Only applies if the skill costs at least 3M or is from Firebird.)

name: Light Fall
title: Light Fall
description: You can float through the air as if you were your namesake. Using Movement while you are Airborne and have at least 10 Magical Feathers available will change it to flight movement.

name: Plume Echo
title: Plume Echo
description: Mainclass Only Skill. As a true Firebird, your feathers are magical enough to get another go. Your Magical Feathers do not expire after the first time they resonate (but will the second time).

name: Preening
title: Preening
description: Take your free moments to make sure everything is straight and even. Converts your unused Momentum into Magical Feathers at a ratio of 1:1.

name: Blood Spike
title: Blood Spike
description:
Costs 8% of your maximum HP. Targets a 2 Range circle up to 3 Range away. All enemies in that circle take ice and water damage (split evenly) and have claret call applied to them twice.

The range of the spell is increased based on your Rising Game level. Sword and Axe weapons are valid casting tools.

name: Cut Down
title: Cut Down
description: Axe Skill. Two quick swings from your axe on an enemy in 1 Range. The first swing applies Claret Call, and the second consumes it, deals damage, and inflicts Cut Down LV X (X = half of Claret Call's level) for 3 rounds. Cut Down reduces the targets Phys and Magic Defense by LV%.

name: Death Gaze
title: Death Gaze
description: A piercing gaze that seems to come from the grim reaper itself. The target of this skill must be marked by Claret Call and be Feared, and both must be caused by you. The target loses the Claret Call marking and becomes Unmarkable for 2 rounds, but is Silenced for 2 rounds. They also take Dark damage that ignores armor and evasion equal to 100% (+25% per additional Rank) of your Dark ATK.

name: Ether Invitation
title: Ether Invitation
description: An invitation to the underworld. Targets an enemy within 1 Range and pulls all Claret Calls on all enemies to them, stacking them together. Afterwards, you perform a basic attack on the target, which deals bonus damage equal to 20% of your missing HP. If it hits, and they are marked with Claret Call, the Claret Call explodes in the wound, consuming it and making them Unmarkable for 2 rounds, but giving them Cursed Wound LV X (X = damage dealt by the attack).

name: Ghastly Strike
title: Ghastly Strike
description: Sword skill. Attack an enemy in 1 range with a quick sword strike, then fake a follow up. Deals Slash physical damage to the target. If you have inflicted Fear on them, they may try to protect themselves from the fake hit, having the chance to inflict Guard LV 1 on them. The overall success rate is increased by the LV of you Claret Call the target has (if any).

name: Reaper Scythe
title: Reaper Scythe
description:
Axe or Scythe skill. A deadly blade that cannot be protected against. Deals Slash magic damage to all enemies in a crescent pattern. If any of those enemies are marked by Claret Call, they can be guard broken, but become Unmarkable until your next turn.

(Guard Break: If the target is Guarding, it's removed and they take 15% more damage for 1 round.)

name: Sanguine Star
title: Sanguine Star
description: Sword Skill. A flourish of sword strikes, dealing Slash damage plus bonus damage for every enemy in the area of effect that is marked by Claret Call.

name: Scarlet Twister
title: Scarlet Twister
description:
Costs 10% of your maximum HP. Targets a 2 range circle up to 3 range away. All enemies in those tiles are pulled 2 tiles towards the centre, and then all enemies in the circle take Dark and Wind damage (split evenly), and have Claret Call applied (twice if in 2 range of the center).

Size and pull strength are increased based on Rising Game level. Sword and Axe weapons are valid casting tools.

name: Painproof
title: Painproof
description: Costs 10% of your maximum HP to use. Cause damage to yourself in order to lessen the pain you feel from enemies, granting X% Physical and Magical Defense until your next turn versus targets marked by your Claret Call.

name: Wraithguard
title: Wraithguard
description: Creates a ghostly spirit that is tied to you at a target location within 3 Range. When you take damage, it is reduced by 30% and that reduction is subtracted from the Wraith's HP instead. The Wraith can still take damage normally and gets no turn, so try to keep it away from the action.

name: Dark Imbue
title: Dark Imbue
description:
Axe skill. Causes your Axe to extend with a dark blade similar to a scythe, increasing its Hit with Axe weaponsand dealing Dark magic damage when you hit an enemy with a basic attack with an Axe weapon, or with a Ghost Axe skill.

This effect lasts for 4 rounds. At Rising Game LV 3, it lasts for an additional round. At Rising Game LV 6, its Momentum cost is reduced by 2.

name: Gravestone
title: Gravestone
description: Creates up to one impassable but attackable Gravestone at target location for 3 rounds. Enemies in that tile take Earth magic damage and are knocked airborne. Enemies within 3 range of a Gravestone take double bonus damage from Claret Call, and Wraiths within 3 range of a Gravestone take no damage from enemies.

name: Haunting
title: Haunting
description:
Disappear into the mist and reappear at target empty square. Any enemies you have marked with Claret Call within 1 Range of that location are Feared for the duration. Lasts 2 rounds.

If Rising Game level is 3 or higher, the cooldown of this skill is reduced by 1 round.

name: Rebound
title: Rebound
description:
Draw back and consumes all of your Claret Calls on all enemies, which sap HP and FP from those enemies equal to their LV, restoring your HP and FP for each (HP recovery is increased by X% of your Scaled RES).

Small Note: There might be a typo in 'Draw back and consumes all'; as opposed to this, it might be 'Draw back and consume all'.

name: Red Rain
title: Red Rain
description:
Costs 5% of your Maximum HP. Creates a localized rainstorm of blood at a target location up to 5 Range away. When created, and at the start of every round, enemies in the rainstorm have Claret Call applied to them. At the start of a new round, if no enemies are in the area of effect, the rainstorm will creep towards the nearest enemy.

The rainstorm lasts for 2+Rank rounds, but can be dissipated by certain effects.

name: Afflicted Spectre
title: Afflicted Spectre
extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description:
The Ghost thrives on drawing out hidden power from situations where they are at a disadvantage, but sometimes that doesn't always mean 'near death'. While this skill is equipped, the Ghost's maximum HP is increased by 5% for every negative status effect that are suffering from.

Small Note: There may be a spelling mistake in the skill's in game description. It might be 'that they're suffering from' as opposed to 'that are suffering from'.

name: Last Chance
title: Last Chance
extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: As a last ditch effort, the Ghost can absorb the Claret Calls from their attackers, leaving them one step above actually being dead. When the Ghost takes damage that leaves them at 0 HP or less from an enemy that is marked by the user's Claret Call, they instead remain at 1 HP. However, the attacker has their Claret Call marking removed, and cannot be remarked for 3 rounds.

name: Anti-Curse
title: Anti-Curse
description: An innate property of the Ghost that wards off supernatural and magical effects. Passively increases your RES.

name: Claret Call
title: Claret Call
description:
A red mark that increases pain. When Claret Call is applied to an enemy, it gives them or powers up a status by LV X (X = 1, or 2 if below 50% HP) that lasts for 3 rounds. Claret Call boosts the damage of basic attacks, as well as the damage of Ghost skills.

Claret Call is applied by dealing physical damage to an enemy, or by various Ghost skill effects. (Max LV is equal to 5 + Ghost level.)

name: Fitting Form
title: Fitting Form
description: Ghosts, as in the spectres, do not typically carry a lot of weight in their appearance, so it is only fitting when Ghost duelists follow suit. Increases the base LV of Claret Call applications for each weapon and torso you have that is 5 Weight or less.

name: Pain Tolerance
title: Pain Tolerance
description: Ghosts are used to having to deal with shedding blood - sometimes their own. They can operate effectively in less ideal circumstances (and with less blood) than others, increasing their Hit Points. At max Rank, further increases maximum HP by 8.

name: Rising Game
title: Rising Game
description: The true strength of the Ghost that causes their combat parameters to significantly increases as death creeps closer. Something inside of them is honed with each step into the grave. Fortune smiles upon the reckless. This skill causes specific statistics to increase based on your missing HP. For every 15% of your HP that is missing, the affected stats increase by +1.

name: Judgement Blade
title: Judgement Blade
extras: If the target is a Youkai, or installed with one, the damage is increased by Rank*5%.
description: Cut your target with a dimensional blade. Deals Slash magical damage to target enemy within 3 Range. If the target is a Youkai, or installed with one, the damage is increased by Rank*5%. Additionally, if the target is a summoned unit, the damage is increased by Rank*5% (stacks additively if both conditions met).

name: Soul Chains
title: Soul Chains
extras: Target cannot recover FP for the 2/2/3/3/4 Rounds
Target is treated as if they were Installed with a Youkai. For the same duration, you cannot summon the Youkai
description: Can only be used if you have a Youkai installed. The Youkai's astral form jumps to target enemy within 3 Range for X rounds (based on Rank), ending the Install. During this time, that enemy cannot recover FP, and is treated as if they were Installed with a Youkai. For the same duration, you cannot summon the Youkai.

name: Encourage
title: Encourage
description: Targets a 3 Size Diamond within 4 Range. All allied youkai in that area gain Encourage LV X (2 + Rank) for 5 rounds, which boosts all of their stats by LV.

name: Reihou
title: Reihou
extras: Restores all unsummoned Youkai's HP by 1/10/50/100/200. This spell is also effective on Youkai with 0 HP, reviving them.
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Invoke an ancient word, restoring all unsummoned Youkai's HP by X (based on Rank). This spell is also effective on Youkai with 0 HP, reviving them.

"Ether reformed..."

name: Aegis Shift
title: Aegis Shift
description: Can only target one of your Youkai. Transfers your Astral Aegis to them for 3 rounds (or until they are unsummoned), letting them gain the benefits, but also removing them from you for the duration. If the target is already under this effect, your Astral Aegis returns to you.

name: Chain Unsummon
title: Chain Unsummon
description:
Targets 1 Youkai you control within 5 Range and unsummons the target. Any of your Youkai within 2 Range of that Youkai, and any Youkai that are affected by this effect, are also unsummoned.

This effect cannot be used if you have Skipped your turn this round.

name: Summon Storm
title: Summon Storm
extras: Summon 2/3/4/5/6 unsummoned Youkai at random, to random unoccupied squares on the battlefield.
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details). Create a massive explosion of focus around you, summoning X unsummoned Youkai (based on Rank) at random, to random unoccupied squares on the battlefield..

"Open the gate to another world..."

name: Astral Aegis
title: Astral Aegis
description: A strengthening of the spirit and body that is caused by summoned Youkai. If you have a Youkai summoned, you gain a bonus to DEF and RES. (This bonus is treated as a class bonus.)

name: Auto Summon
title: Auto Summon
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description:
One of the greatest flaws of being a summoner is that it is very taxing to have a Youkai summoned at all times. But if you are caught off guard, summoning a Youkai to protect you can take time you don't have. Sometime it's good to have a contingency.

While this skill is equipped, when a battle starts, you automatically summon the first available Youkai from your contracts (it must have at least 1 HP however).

name: Dimension Resonance
title: Dimension Resonance
description: Attack enemies with powerful dimension shifts. Every time a Youkai you control is unsummoned, after the effect of Impact Dismiss applies, you gain Dimension Resonance LV1 (stacks up to LV2+Rank). The damage of Impact Dismiss is multiplied by Dimension Resonance's LV. However, the damaged caused by it will become resistable.

name: Evoke Mastery
title: Evoke Mastery
extras: Reduces the FP cost associated with Evoking by 5/10/15/20/25 %
description: A mastery of utilizing evoking skills. While not on the level of the Miashima, it does reduce the FP cost associated with the art.

name: Impact Call
title: Impact Call
extras: When you summon a youkai, you cause enemies within 2 Range of that space to be knocked back 1/2/3 square(s)
description: Creates a gust of wind when you summon a Youkai, causing enemies within 2 Range of that space to be knocked back X squares, based on Rank.

name: Impact Dismiss
title: Impact Dismiss
extras: When you unsummon a Youkai manually, it creates an elemental explosion that damages enemies within 1/2/3 Range for damage equal to the Youkai's level. The damage type varies based on the Youkai
description: When you unsummon a Youkai manually, it creates an elemental explosion that damages enemies within X Range (based on Rank) for damage equal to the Youkai's level. The damage type varies based on the Youkai, and has Great Accuracy.

name: Misty Dimension
title: Misty Dimension
description: The mystic qualities of summoning sometimes make foes less aware. Increases the FP cost of using the Summon skill by 5, but causes it to give you Sneak status for 2 rounds, which lowers your chance to be targeted by enemies.

name: Ripple Dimension
title: Ripple Dimension
description: Abuse the ripples of dimensions to speed up your summonings. Hitting at least one enemy with Impact Call's effect will grant Ripple Dimension LV1 (stacks up to LV3) for 1 round, which lowers the momentum cost of Summon by LV.

name: Spirit Regeneration
title: Spirit Regeneration
extras: Every round, Youkai who are unsummoned and not at 0 HP regain 2/4/6/8/10 HP and FP.
description: As beings that live in the ether, youkai are more quickly able to recover when in it. Every round, Youkai who are unsummoned and not at 0 HP regain HP and FP based on the Rank of this skill.

name: Absorb Ether
title: Absorb Ether
description: A strong ability that lets the Grand Summoner more actively take in focus from other dimensions. Causes you to regenerate FP every round based on Rank.

name: Grand Repertoire
title: Grand Repertoire
description: The Grand Summoner earns their 'Grand' title, if for no other reason but numbers. Increases the number of active Youkai contracts you have by 1.

name: New Heights
title: New Heights
description: A truly skilled Summoner can bring out the power of their Youkai in a way that those who are not, cannot. Halves the FP cost of Summon Youkai.

name: Spirit Well
title: Spirit Well
description: The Grand Summoner's body and soul are much like a well, only it collects Focus instead of water. Increases maximum FP based on Rank. At max Rank, maximum FP is further increased by +3.

name: Youkai Tamer
title: Youkai Tamer
extras: Melee weapons gain +5/10/15/20/25 Power if the target is a Youkai (or treated as one).
description: As a being who must always interact with Youkai, the Grand Summoner is well versed in the ways to discipline them. Melee weapons gain a bonus to Power based on Rank if the target is a Youkai (or treated as one).

name: Black Bubble
title: Black Bubble
description:
Targets a 3 Range circle area within 4 Range. All enemies within the area of effect take magic damage split between Water and Dark. All damaged enemies may be Silenced for 2 rounds.

All tiles in the radius will be covered in Dark Water for 3 rounds (which reduce the Faith of those who stand in it to 0.), but it will take until the start of the next round for it to puddle and take effect.

name: Black Static
title: Black Static
description: Creates a strong jolt of energy in a 2 Range circle around you, dealing magic damage split between Lightning and Dark. There is also a chance that all enemies damaged will suffer from Interference for 3 rounds.

name: Death Knighting
title: Death Knighting
description:
Requires a Rank D Invocation. After casting, you will temporarily change into a Spectre Knight for 5 rounds. While you are a Spectre Knight, you gain access to the skills Calling, Hellspike, and Fallcall. You are also treated as the Possessed racial type for the same duration.

"Deliver death, become death..."

name: Earthbound Fog
title: Earthbound Fog
description:
Mist Skill. This sill requires a Rank D Invocation. When cast, the battlefield is covered in a purple mist that seems to induce uneasiness. The purple mist lasts for 5 rounds, and while active, enemies cannot use Attack (or Sub-Attack) or any Offensive-class skill during the same turn they use Movement. Boss enemies do not have actions prevented, but instead have -15% Dark Resistance. (Only one Mist skill can be activate on the battlefield at a time.)

"Stand your ground and fight into the grave..."

name: Earthbound Vengeance
title: Earthbound Vengeance
description:
Requires a Rank D Invocation. When cast, the ground gains shadowed faces of vengeful spirits. The vengeful spirits will remain for 5 rounds, and while they are active, enemies who use Attack (or Sub-Attack) or any Offensive-class skill suffer Dark damage that ignores armor based on Rank.

"Spirits of the fallen, deliver your grudge on these fools who dare to live..."

name: Enma's Summons
title: Enma's Summons
description:
Requires a Rank D Invocation. After casting, all enemies take Dark magic damage. The damage is increased by 2% for every 1% of the target's missing HP. After being successfully cast, goes on a 3 round Cooldown.

"Judge of hell, your verdict, please..."

name: Eternal Darkness
title: Eternal Darkness
description: Attacks the target with pure shadow, dealing Dark magic damage. If the target is suffering from Blind, the duration of that status effect is extended by 1 Rounds (to a maximum of 2 rounds).

name: Fleeing Spectres
title: Fleeing Spectres
description: Causes ghastly spirits to flee from every direction around you for up to 7 Range, dealing magic damage split between Wind and Dark. There is also a chance that enemies damaged will be Feared for 3 rounds.

name: Spirit Pain
title: Spirit Pain
description: Requires a Rank D Invocation. When cast, summons an invisible spectre that will loom around the battlefield for 5 rounds. At the start of each Round, a random enemy will be possessed by the spectre. If a possessed unit attacks, the attack will be negated, and they will suffer Dark damage that ignores armor based on Rank. You will also recover HP equal to the Dark damage.

name: Underworld Flame
title: Underworld Flame
description: Unleashes a burst of purple flame at a target enemy within 4 Range, dealing magic damage split between Fire and Dark. There is also a chance that enemy will be inflicted with Burn LV X (8*Rank) for 3 rounds.

name: Wretched Oil
title: Wretched Oil
description: A spell which bubbles black mud from beneath the ground. Targets all enemies within 5 Range and inflicts magic damage split between Earth and Dark. There is a chance that all enemies damaged will also suffer from Poison LV X (6*Rank) for 3 rounds.

name: Crippling Muysig
title: Crippling Muysig
description: Curse skill. Curse skills will apply a curse to yourself for 3 rounds, and while active, you will suffer the effects of the curse. However, if an enemy damages you while a Curse is active, it will transfer to them. (Once transferred, the curses remain on the victim and the duration is refreshed.) Muysig will cripple the victim, reducing their SKI and CEL.

name: Fellel's Fumble
title: Fellel's Fumble
description: Curse skill. Curse skills will apply a curse to yourself for 3 rounds, and while active, you will suffer the effects of the curse. However, if an enemy damages you while a Curse is active, it will transfer to them. (Once transferred, the curses remain on the victim and the duration is refreshed.) Fellel will cause the next attack of the target to always miss. Its LV will then be reduced by 1 (and if it reaches 0, the effect ends.)

name: Fraility of Credwa
title: Frailty of Credwa
description: Curse skill. Curse skills will apply a curse to yourself for 3 rounds, and while active, you will suffer the effects of the curse. However, if an enemy damages you while a Curse is active, it will transfer to them. (Once transferred, the curses remain on the victim and the duration is refreshed.) Credwa's frailty will cause the DEF and RES stats of the victim to decrease.

name: Noshka's Famine
title: Noshka's Famine
description: Curse skill. Curse skills will apply a curse to yourself for 3 rounds, and while active, you will suffer the effects of the curse. However, if an enemy damages you while a Curse is active, it will transfer to them. (Once transferred, the curses remain on the victim and the duration is refreshed.) Noshka's famine will cause the STR and WIL stats of the victim to decrease.

name: Plisfa's Masochism
title: Plisfa's Masochism
description: Curse skill. Curse skills will apply a curse to yourself for 3 rounds, and while active, you will suffer the effects of the curse. However, if an enemy damages you while a Curse is active, it will transfer to them. (Once transferred, the curses remain on the victim and the duration is refreshed.) Plisfa will make the target unable to dodge attacks. Its LV will then be reduced by 1 (and if it reaches 0, the effect ends.)

name: Hellflame Uorate
title: Hellflame Uorate
description: Hex skill. Hex skills can only target those with a specific status effect, and it will then reset the duration of the status effect (based on Rank; the duration of the Hex is the same) and inflict a Hex on the target. Uorate's wrath will prevent the target's Burn from being cured, and cause it to nullify bonus RES the target has.

name: Imagin's Despair
title: Imagin's Despair
description: Hex skill. Hex skills can only target those with a specific status effect, and it will then reset the duration of the status effect (based on Rank; the duration of the Hex is the same) and inflict a Hex on the target. Imagin will cause a sense of overwhelming despair in the target, preventing Fear from being cured and increasing all damage the victim takes by 10%.

name: Llunel's Decay
title: Llunel's Decay
description: Hex Skill. Hex Skill can only target those with a specific status effect, and it will then reset the duration of the status effect (based on Rank; the duration of the Hex is the same) and inflict a Hex on the target. Llunel will decay the target mentally, preventing Interference from being cured and instead causing it to reverse the effects of regeneration that the target has.

name: Menov's Fang
title: Menov's Fang
description: Hex skill. Hex skills can only target those with a specific status effect, and it will then reset the duration of the status effect (based on Rank; the duration of the Hex is the same) and inflict a Hex on the target. Menovs will intensify the effects of a Poison on its victim, preventing it from being cured and causing it to deal 1.5x damage.

name: Strangling Etacof
title: Strangling Etacof
description: Hex Skill. Hex Skill can only target those with a specific status effect, and it will then reset the duration of the status effect (based on Rank; the duration of the Hex is the same) and inflict a Hex on the target. Etacof will strangle the target from beyond the gates of death, preventing Silence from being cured and causing it to reduce the victim's HP and FP by 5% of their maximum values every round.

name: Silent Spirit
title: Silent Spirit
description: Possesses 1 target enemy within 3 Range and forces them to attack you with their main weapon. If the main weapon is out of range, this skill will fail. You take reduced damage from this forced attack based on Rank.

name: Endurance
title: Endurance
description: The type of body necessary to take a beating. Increases your maximum HP by 10% while equipped.

name: Evil Force
title: Evil Force
description: A mastery of tainted powers, in a sense. Increases the damage you deal with basic attacks if the weapon is Cursed or Doomed (based on Rank). The bonus is halved if Hexer is not your Main Class. Gun attacks will only receive a maximum of (Rank) bonus damage.

name: Sadistic Renewal
title: Sadistic Renewal
description: Serves you right! The Hexer takes glee in hitting a target while they're down, causing them to recover FP (based on Rank) when they hit an enemy who is suffering from at least one negative status effect.

name: Bloody Karma
title: Bloody Karma
description: When it rains, it pours. Blood. From your enemies. For every Curse effect enemies you attack are suffering, you gain increased Critical, based on Rank.

name: Dark Invasion
title: Dark Invasion
description: By honing your skills with the dark arts, you increase the chance you have of successfully inflicting status ailments. In addition, increases your Dark ATK by 2*Rank. The status infliction rate is doubled if your main hand weapon is Cursed or Doomed.

name: Essence Taking
title: Essence Taking
description: By absorbing the spiritual energy of defeated enemies, you restore your own Focus. At the end of a battle, you regain FP for every enemy that was defeated based on Rank.

name: Payback
title: Payback
description: What goes around comes around. When an enemy deals damage to you, they gain a status that reduces their Status Resist for one infliction instance, for up to 2 rounds.

name: Walk In Darkness
title: Walk In Darkness
description: Those who walk in darkness prepare themselves for pain unlike any other. Passively increases your DEF and RES based on Rank.

name: Hirazuki
title: Hirazuki
description:
Kensei Combo Skill. Stab your target and run with them in a line, carrying them with you. Run forward, dealing pierce Physical damage to the first enemy you hit, pushing them along until you reach the end of the line. If the sword you are using is a Katana-type, the Momentum cost is reduced by 1. The size of the line can be changed using the +/- keys.

Sacred Art Effect: Fire physical damage.

Combo Effect: Skewer the target several times, inflicting Fray LV X (X = Rank * 3) on them until your next turn, before damage is dealt.

name: Kagekiri
title: Kagekiri
description:
Kensei Combo Skill. Dash forward in a 3-5 Size line, and slash all around you faster than the eye can see, dealing Slash damage. If the sword you are using is a Katana type, the Momentum cost is reduced by 1.

If Voltiger is available, it can be consumed to change the pattern into flexible line.

Sacred Art Effect: Darkness physical damage.

Combo Effect: Ignores evasion. After the dash, you turn around towards the way you came.

name: Raijinken
title: Raijinken
description:
Kensei Combo Skill. Slash upwards at your target, and follow them into the air. Deals Slash damage to an within 1 range, making you both airborne. If the sword you are using is a Katana-type, the momentum cost is reduced by 1.

If the Voltiger is available, it can be consumed to target an enemy within 5 range, teleporting you to an unoccupied tile next to them before other effects.

Sacred Art Effect: Lightning physical damage.

Combo Effect: All enemies within 3 Range of the target are also hit by the skill.

name: Sharenzan
title: Sharenzan
description:
Kensei Combo Skill. Strike your target with forceful sword blow. Deals Slash damage to 1 enemy within 1 range, and knock them back 3 tiles (this knockback ignores immunity effects.) If the sword you are using is a Katana-type, the Momentum cost is reduced by 1. If you are airborne, the damage is increased by 1.25x. If the target is airborne, they are also knocked down. (Airborne Compatible)

Sacred Art Effect: Earth physical damage.

Combo Effect: The target is swung around, hitting all enemies within 1 Range for half damage and knockback, then the normal skill effect takes place.

name: Toiken
title: Toiken
description:
Kensei Combo skill. Draw your sword with such precision and speed that it kicks up razor-sharp wind that deals Slash damage to all enemies in a crescent pattern. If the sword you are using is a Katana-type, the Momentum cost is reduced by 1. The size of the pattern can be changed using the +/- keys.

Sacred Art Effect: Wind physical damage.

Combo Effect: Affected tiles that have field objects are blown away 3 tiles away from you.

name: Wazabane
title: Wazabane
description:
Kensei Combo skill. An overhead slash at a target within 1 range, performing a basic attack on them with bonuses to Hit and Critical. If you are airborne, and your target is not, the Hit and critical bonuses are doubled. Afterwards, your airborne status ends. If the sword you are using is a katana-type, the momentum cost is reduced by 1.

Sacred Art Effect: Water physical damage.

Combo Effect: Damage cannot be parried. Gains Guard Break properties. (When used, will cause Guard Break if the enemy is Guarding.)

name: Sheath Sword
title: Sheath Sword
description:
Sword skill. Targets 1 tile in 5 Range. Put your sword in your sheath after facing target location; if it is a Katana, you also gain Quick Draw (LV X, until your next turn). If an enemy is in the target tile, you inflict them with Watchful Eye (1 round).

Quick Draw will be expended at the start of your next turn or after successfully triggering. If it doesn't trigger, you will gain Sacred Art at the start of the next round, if it is equipped.

name: Absolute Death
title: Absolute Death
description:
Kensei Stance Skill. Grants you Absolute Death Lv 10 (Permanent duration, but requires 10 FP every round.) When active, enemies damaged by Kensei Offensive skills that are already affected by your Sakki will cause you to swiftly move to slash all other enemies within 5 range of that target, dealing Protection-ignoring Bonus Slash damage equal to your kensei class (or 10, whichever is higher). Enemies can only be damaged this way once per skill use.

Small Note: There is an in-game typo in the word 'targeting'; it is instead written as 'targetting'.

name: Absolute Fear
title: Absolute Fear
description: Kensei Stance Skill. Grants you Absolute Fear Lv 10 (Permanent Duration, but require 10 FP every round). A stance useful for inflicting Fear on Enemies, and making them show their back to you.

name: Absolute Pace
title: Absolute Pace
description:
Kensei Stance Skill. Grants you Absolute Pace Lv 10 (Permanent Duration, but requires 10 FP every round). A baiting stance focused on dodging, and parrying which can grant you Battle Flow.

Small Note: There is an in-game spelling mistake. Subtly is written as subtlely.

name: Blade Barrier
title: Blade Barrier
description: Deflection Skill. You become capable of spinning your katana so fast that it deflects bullets. When attacked by a Gun weapon by an enemy you are facing, there is a percentage chance based on Rank to negate the attack and reduce your Katana's durability by 1. This skill will fail if your katana's durability is 0, and can only successfully activate once per round. (Only one Deflection Skill can apply at a time.)

name: Counter Edge
title: Counter Edge
description: Attacks made through Riposte and Sheath Sword receive bonus damage based on Rank.

name: Hidden Cut
title: Hidden Cut
description: Sometimes your enemies don't realize they've been cut until after you put your sword away. When you use Sheath Sword, all enemies you have attacked and hit with a Katana-type Sword, or used a Kensei Sword skill on this turn take Slash damage that ignores armor, based on Rank.

name: Reflect Shots
title: Reflect Shots
description: You skillfully manipulate any deflected Gun attacks into bouncing back towards your enemies. When you successfully block a Gun attack with Blade Barrier, rather than cancelling the attack, it is reflected to a random enemy within X Range, based on Rank.

name: Sacred Art
title: Sacred Art
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Kensei often utilize multiple techniques in succession, turning their sword play into an art rather than a skill. When you deal damage to an enemy using a Kensei Offensive Skill, the next Kensei Offensive Skill this turn does not require any FP to use, and if it hits an enemy, it will deal elemental damage based off of your elemental ATK (each offensive Kensei skill uses a unique element; if you have a Starsign, its element will be used instead).

name: Tekagen
title: Tekagen
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Toggle skill. A term used in Oniga for someone who is holding back. While toggled on, damage you deal will not reduce an enemy below 1 HP.

name: Zen Blade
title: Zen Blade
extras: Does not take up a SP slot.
description: Calm your center, and restore strength. When using a Sheath sword with more than 3 momentum, you recover 15 FP per momentum point exceeding 3 (IE, 4 Momentum would restore 15, 7 Momentum would restore 60.) After activating, this effect have a 3 round cooldown, unless Kensei is BOTH your main class, and sub-class.

name: Channel Spirit
title: Channel Spirit
description: Kensei perform better when not burdened by things like armor. When you are using an Unarmored torso, you regain X FP every round, based on Rank.

name: Katana Master
title: Katana Master
description:
Needless to say, Kensei are masters of the katana. Increases your Power with Katana-type weapons.

At the start of battle, If you only have a Katana Weapon(s) equipped, You gain a permanent status that boosts the power of your Katana Weapons, Touki, Sakki, and Kenki. This boost is lost if you swap weapons.

name: Kenki
title: Kenki
description: Kenki is an aggressive type of spiritual energy that most Kensei possess. It is used offensively, projected towards enemies, to try and intimidate them, or trick them by confusing it with Touki or Sakki. When applied by Sharenzan or Wazabane, it reduces the target's Hit versus you for 3 rounds.

name: Peerless
title: Peerless
description: The Kensei are both respected and feared for their immense prowess with a blade, but also their incredible speed and skill with it. Passively increases STR and SKI.

name: Sakki
title: Sakki
description: Sakki is a type of spiritual energy that gives off the intent to kill. Kensei possess the ability to suppress this energy, hiding their killing intent from enemies. When applied by Kagekiri or Hirazuki, it reduces the target's Critical Evade versus you for 3 rounds.

name: Touki
title: Touki
description: Touki is a type of spiritual energy that shows the will to fight. Hiding it from your enemies will make them feel less threatened just before your attacks, causing their evasion to be sloppy or mistimed. When applied by Toiken or Raijinken, It reduces the target's Evade versus you for 3 rounds.

name: Yomidori
title: Yomidori
description: Yomidori is the act of predicting your opponent's movements with such precision that it becomes akin to mind-reading. When you are attacked by a person who has already attacked or damaged you this turn, your parry skills have a higher chance to activate, based on Rank.

name: Altera
title: Altera
description:
Unleash a black fog from your lantern, covering all enemies within 3 Range and dealing Dark magic damage to them. It can also inflict Blind for 2 rounds on affected enemies.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: WIL, RES

name: Fenrir
title: Fenrir
description:
The ice wolf releases a chilling howl, dealing Ice magic damage to all enemies within 3 Range, and slowing their Move by 2 for 2 rounds.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: STR, SKI

name: Focused Beam
title: Focused Beam
description: Can only be used if Eternal Flame is active. Focus the light of your lantern into an arcane beam at a target within Range, dealing damage to the target. The damage type is equal to the damage type of the Lantern's flame (Phoenix will deal Light damage.)

name: Golem
title: Golem
description:
Unleash a shockwave from your lantern, staggering all enemies within 3 Range and dealing Earth magic damage to them. All enemies damaged are also Magnetized for 2 rounds.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: DEF, RES

name: Quetal
title: Quetal
description:
Summon lightning from your lantern, shocking all enemies within 3 Range and dealing Lightning magic damage to them. It can also inflict Interference for 3 rounds on those enemies.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: LUC, GUI

name: Rebia
title: Rebia
description:
Spout water from your lantern, soaking all enemies within 3 Range and dealing Water magic damage to them. It can also inflict Soaked for 2 rounds on those enemies.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: Reduces the LV of Cinder tiles within the range of your lantern by EF * 3 every round.

name: Salamander
title: Salamander
description:
Unleash the flames of a volcanic spirit from your lantern, engulfing all enemies within 3 Range and dealing Fire magic damage to them. It can also inflict Burn LV X (2*Rank) for 3 rounds on those enemies.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: STR, CEL

name: Skyhigh
title: Skyhigh
description: Spear skill. A swift spear move that launches a target upwards. Deals Pierce physical damage to the target, and makes them Airborne.

name: Typhur
title: Typhur
description:
Releases a gust of wind from the king of the skies, dealing Wind magic damage to all enemies within 3 Range and knocking them back. If a knocked back enemy is Airborne, they are also Knocked Down.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: CEL, SKI

name: Guiding Light
title: Guiding Light
description: Targets an ally within 2 Range that is suffering from a Blind status effect and fills them with light, curing the Blind. However, this skill cannot be used if you are Blinded yourself.

name: Phoenix
title: Phoenix
description:
Bathes allies in the warmth of the endless bird, healing allies in its area of effect. This healing can revive Downed allies within a certain Range.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: Restores HP every round.

name: Eternal Flame
title: Eternal Flame
description: A magical flame that resides in the lantern of the Lantern Bearer. It causes lantern spells to have a lingering effect that increases certain statistics equal to the Flame Strength. If Lantern Bearer is your Main Class, Eternal Flame is always active as long as it is equipped. If it is your Sub Class, you must activate this skill, and it is active for a certain number of rounds.

name: Bask in Light
title: Bask in Light
description: At the end of a round, if Eternal Flame is active, and you have not used Movement this turn, your flame glows quietly, causing you and all allies within 3 Range to gain damage resistance to its element for 2 rounds, based on Rank.

name: Gentle Embers
title: Gentle Embers
extras: No longer takes up a skill slot when equipped.
description: A pacifist's approach to lantern bearing. While toggled on, lantern activations will not deal damage or inflict status effects. Instead, all allies in the lantern's aura will gain immunity to the status it normally inflicts, if any, for 2 rounds. It will also reduce the FP cost of Lantern spells (except General domain ones) by 50%.

name: Hard Light
title: Hard Light
description: The warmth of your lantern creates a protective barrier around you. While Eternal Flame is active, you gain X% (based on Rank) resistance to the element of the last lantern flame you invoked.

name: Imbue Strike
title: Imbue Strike
extras: No longer takes up a skill slot when equipped
description: Lantern Bearers can cause strikes they make to hold the power of their lantern. Basic attacks with Spear weapons will, while this skill is toggled on, change their damage type to your currently active Eternal Flame's damage type.

name: Raging Flame
title: Raging Flame
description: The light from your lantern becomes hotter, burning those within its light. At the start of every round, enemies within your Lantern's range take unresistable damage (based on Rank) of your last invoked flame's element.

name: Farlight
title: Farlight
description: The Lantern Bearer's lantern burns more brightly, increasing the reach of all auras, Lantern Bearer spells, and Lantern Bearer bonus effects.

name: Warding Light
title: Warding Light
description: A protection against magic that the Lantern Bearer's lantern leaks, increases RES passively. If at max Rank, RES is further increased by +1.

name: Air Pressure
title: Air Pressure
description: Targets a circular location and pulses powerful wind gusts from it, dealing Wind magic damage to all enemies inside of it. It will also push certain field objects, such as rocks, away. If an enemy is hit by one of those objects, they are stunned, reducing their Momentum to 0 this turn and destroying that object. If you are enchanted with Talvyd, the object pushback is stronger.

name: Explosion
title: Explosion
description: Targets a Circular location, and begins rapidly compressing air inside as a Fuse Field Objective (X turn, +1 per extra circle size, X = numbers of battle participants or 8, whichever is lower.), when it explodes, it deals Fire magic damage to all enemies inside of it. If enchanted with Nerhaven, the Explosion may inflict burn, and will knock enemies airborne, and then away from the center by 3 tiles.

name: Famiuga
title: Famiuga
description: Deals Ice magic damage to all enemies within the area of effect. All tiles in the area are also covered in ice, which will prematurely end movement by 1 tile for every ice sheet walked upon. These ice sheets will last up to 3 turns.

name: Fir
title: Fir
extras: Can be enhanced with weapon charges.
description:
Unleashes a fireball in a line in one direction that travels up to 4 Range. First enemy hit takes Fire damage. If enchanted with Nerhaven, the fireball explodes when it hits an enemy or at the end of its travel, dealing its damage to all enemies in an AoE.

This spell can be enhanced with the usage of weapon charges.

name: Isendo
title: Isendo
extras: Can be enhanced with weapon charges.
description:
Targets a 2 size circle around the user and deals Earth Magic damage to all enemies inside of it; Enemies within 1 range of the center take bonus damage. All enemies magnetized by the users are drawn one square toward the center before damage is dealt. If enchanted with Galren, the magnetization is stronger, pulling enemies in 3 squares, and increases the area of effect by 2 tiles.

This spell can be enhanced with the usage of weapon charges.

name: Miu
title: Miu
extras: Can be enhanced with weapon charges.
description:
Launches a projectile that pierces enemies in a 4 Range Line. All tiles in the line are covered in ice, which will prematurely end movement by 1 tile for every ice sheet walked upon. If enchanted with Kraken, it also has a chance to inflict Frostbite LV (1 + Rank*3) for 3 rounds, which damages enemies who step on ice tiles.

This spell can be enhanced with the usage of weapon charges.

name: Rectifer
title: Rectifer
description: Deals Lightning damage to all enemies within a 2 Range circle around you. If you are enchanted with Redgull, this damage cannot be Reflected.

name: Rye
title: Rye
extras: Can be enhanced with weapon charges.
description:
Calls down a thunderbolt at a target enemy within 7 Range, dealing lightning magic damage to them. Damage is slightly lowered near maximum range. If enchanted with Redgull, the lightning may critically hit, dealing extra damage.

This spell can be enhanced with the usage of weapon charges.

name: Stone Dragon
title: Stone Dragon
description: Send a dragon made of stone flying from the earth in a line from target location. The longer the distance it travels, the more Earth magic damage it will deal to the first enemy hit. If the dragon travels within 1 square of someone under the effect of Astral Belt, it boosts the damage by its LV*4. If enchanted with Galren, the dragon will crumble into dense rocks that last for 2 rounds, after it finishes.

name: Vyd
title: Vyd
extras: Can be enhanced with weapon charges.
description:
Creates a sharp gust of wind around a target enemy within 4 Range, dealing Wind magic damage to them. If enchanted with Talvyd, it also has a chance to inflict Lingering Damage LV (10 + Rank * 5) for 3 rounds.

This spell can be enhanced with the usage of weapon charges.

name: Astral Belt
title: Astral Belt
description: Surrounds yourself or target ally with protective stones, increasing their DEF. If a magnetized enemy is pulled with 1 square of someone under this effect, they take Earth magic damage equal to 4x the DEF bonus and are knocked airborne via polarity reversal. This effect lasts for 3 rounds, but may be extended by effects that lengthen Magnetize. Also grants a special skill called Astral Gravity that uses up the buff to quickly pull nearby enemies closer.

name: Fire Fairy
title: Fire Fairy
description: A fairy made of fire floats near yourself or target ally, increasing their STR. After each movement step, they will destroy all Ice sheets within 1 range (up to Rank*2 Ice Sheets). Also grants a special skill called Fairy Fly that uses up the buff to destroy a circle of Ice sheets up to 6 Range away.

name: Ice Fairy
title: Ice Fairy
description: A fairy made of ice floats near yourself or target ally, increasing their SKI. It will also lower their next instance of Fire damage taken by 50%. Also grants a special skill called Fairy Fall that uses up the buff to destroy a circle of Cinders up to 6 Range away.

name: Relent Gale
title: Relent Gale
description: An invisible wind that follows yourself or target ally, increasing their CEL. In addition, knockback/pull effects that put enemies within 1 Range of you (whether it's you or them), it will suddenly push back, knocking back all enemies within 1 Range 2 times, and knock them down (once). Also grants a special skill called Quick Gale that uses up the buff to push nearby enemies away.

name: Static Air
title: Static Air
description: Charges the air around yourself or target ally, increasing their LUC. In addition, it will deal Lightning damage equal to Rank*5 when you evade an enemy attack (once). Also grants a special skill called Static Excel that uses up the buff to quickly activate Charge Weapon.

name: Galren
title: Galren
description: Enchants yourself or a target party member with an elemental, increasing Earth ATK, RES and DEF, and causing all Earth damage to inflict Magnetize (LV = 1 + Rank*3) for 2 rounds. However, hosting an elemental also has its drawbacks; you take 1.25x Water damage while enchanted. This effect lasts for 3 rounds. You cannot cast this spell on a character already enchanted with an elemental.

name: Kraken
title: Kraken
description:
For the god, see Kraken (God).

Enchants yourself or a target party member with an elemental, increasing Ice ATK, DEF and SKI. However, hosting an elemental also has its drawbacks; you take 1.25x Wind damage while enchanted. This effect lasts for 3 rounds. You cannot cast this spell on a character already enchanted with an elemental.

name: Nerhaven
title: Nerhaven
description: Enchants yourself or a target party member with an elemental, increasing Fire ATK, STR and WIL. However, hosting an elemental also has its drawbacks; you take 1.25x Ice damage while enchanted. This effect lasts for 3 rounds. You cannot cast this spell on a character already enchanted with an elemental.

name: Redgull
title: Redgull
description: Enchants yourself or a target party member with an elemental, increasing Lightning ATK, CEL and LUC. However, hosting an elemental also has its drawbacks; you take 1.25x Fire damage while enchanted. This effect lasts for 3 rounds. You cannot cast this spell on a character already enchanted with an elemental.

name: Talvyd
title: Talvyd
description: Enchants yourself or a target party member with an elemental, increasing Wind ATK, CEL and Move. However, hosting an elemental also has its drawbacks; you take 1.25x Earth damage while enchanted. This effect lasts for 3 rounds. You cannot cast this spell on a character already enchanted with an elemental.

name: Blink
title: Blink
description:
By targeting an empty square, you briefly disappear into the void and reappear at that square. Using Blink will not break any Invocations you are casting.

Small Note: There is an in-game spelling mistake. Targeting is written as targetting.

name: Swap Position
title: Swap Position
description: Caster and target swap positions, faced directions, and airborne states, as if both had stepped on the new location. If the target was Airborne and the target was not, the target is Knocked Down.

name: Auto-Enchant
title: Auto-Enchant
description: A toggle skill. When on, at the start of a battle, you have a chance to automatically use the first Mage enchant spell equipped in your skill pool on yourself, for free.

name: Elemental Augment
title: Elemental Augment
description: Allows you to utilize elementals offensively while enchanted with them. When you (or someone enchanted with one of your Elementals, in which case it will use their Elemental ATK instead of yours.) hit with a basic attack, your basic attacks will deal elemental Magic damage to the target, based on Rank. The damage type depends on the elemental you are enchanted with (for example, you will deal Fire damage if Nerhaven, etc). If applied by a Gun attack, the damage is divided by the Gun's total rounds.

name: Whispering Cant
title: Whispering Cant
description: Allows you to use the simple Offensive spells offered by the Mage base class even while you are Silenced, but increases their FP cost by 50% while under that effect.

name: Tome Specialist
title: Tome Specialist
description: Nothing beats a good tome, and there as many as there are Mages. Grants +5 Hit with Tome weapons. When dealing damage with a Tome of a damage type that matches the Tome's, or its material's element, grants an additional +5 Hit.

name: Blaze Shell
title: Blaze Shell
description: Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Fire DMG Bonus: 10 x B.P. Fire DMG, chance to inflict Burn LV (3 x B.P.)/3 rounds High Charge: In 5 Range - 10 x H.P. Fire DMG, and create Cinders LV X (25% of Fire ATK)/3 rounds

name: Bright Shell
title: Bright Shell
description: Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Light DMG Bonus:10 x B.P. Light DMG, chance to inflict Glowing LV (3 x B.P.)/3 rounds. Creates Light Shafts LV X (3 x B.P.)/3 rounds in a line to target. High Charge: Fires a powerful laser at the target dealing 15 x H.P. Light DMG that ignores evasion, and chance to inflict Blind/3 rounds.

name: Celsius Shell
title: Celsius Shell
description: Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Ice DMG Bonus: 10 x B.P. Ice DMG, chance to inflict Frostbite LV (3 x B.P.)/3 rounds High Charge: In 5 Range - 10 x H.P. Ice DMG, and create Ice Sheets/3 rounds. Original Target: Inflicts Frozen LV 20 x H.P./ 2 rounds. Other Targets: Inflicts Celsius LV2 until your next turn.

name: Chain Shell
title: Chain Shell
description: Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Lightning DMG to target + 1 other in 3 Range Bonus: 8 x B.P. Lightning DMG to target + 2 others in 3 Range High Charge: 15 x H.P. Lightning DMG, and chance to inflict Immobilize until your next turn. If successful, also inflict Lingering Damage (Lightning) LV X (5 x H.P.)/3 rounds (Note: Effect will only apply to one enemy at a time during an AoE basic attack.)

name: Interference Shell
title: Interference Shell
description: Shell: 3 x S.P. FP Reduction. Bonus: If target is a summoned unit, unsummons them. Otherwise, inflicts Spelldaze/1 round. High Charge: Within 4 Range: Unsummons summoned enemy units. Breaks enemy invocations. Inflicts Interference for X rounds (50% of HP). Can inflict Stun on Machines, Mechanations, Dullahans, and Liches.

name: Lucky Shell
title: Lucky Shell
description: Shell: Increases LUC by 1 x S.P. for 1 x S.P. rounds. Can stack up to LV 1000. Bonus: You may negate damage at (Lucky Shell LV)% chance for Bonus Power rounds. High Charge: Steals target's LUC equal to current LUC bonus for High Power rounds, then inflicts Pierce damage equal to your LUC. Cannot affect same target for High Power rounds.

name: Magnet Shell
title: Magnet Shell
description: Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Earth DMG, inflicts Magnetize LV X (3 x S.P.)/3 rounds. Bonus: 10 x B.P. Earth DMG. Pulls all Magnetized enemies up to 3 tiles towards the target. High Charge: 15 x H.P. Earth DMG and inflicts Attract Objects LV3/3 rounds.

name: Null Shell
title: Null Shell
description: Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Null DMG Bonus: 10 x B.P. Null DMG and lower target's elemental resistances by 10%/3 rounds High Charge: Dispells up to 4 beneficial status effects.

name: Sonic Shell
title: Sonic Shell
description: Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Sound DMG. Bonus: 10 x S.P. Sound DMG, chance to inflict Silence/2 rounds. High Charge: If Safety is Off: Attack becomes an auto-hit. Chance to inflict Knocked Down. User gains Sonic Speed LV X (2 x H.P.)/5 rounds.

name: Vamp Shell
title: Vamp Shell
description: Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Dark DMG and restore HP equal to half DMG dealt Bonus: 10 x B.P. Dark DMG and steal FP equal to half the DMG dealt High Charge: 10 x H.P. Dark DMG, and steal 2 of all the target's stats (except VIT)/3 rounds.

name: Parting Shot
title: Parting Shot
description: Gun skill. Jump back and away from an enemy, guns blazing. By targeting an enemy in 3 Range, you attack them with your Gun as per normal, but with a small penalty to hit. You also jump away X tiles, where X = Rank.

name: Covering Fire
title: Covering Fire
description: Gun skill. Target an enemy in range and shower it with bullets. For 3 rounds, the target suffers a penalty to Hit and Critical (based on Rank) when they are attacking any target but you.

name: Charged Shot
title: Charged Shot
description: By feeding Focus into the Magic Gunner's gun, they increase its power output, causing the next basic attack with a Gun that hits to trigger the current bullet's Bonus Effect on the target. The power of the Bonus Effect increases with additional ranks of Charge Shot.

name: Cooldown
title: Cooldown
description: By releasing a certain valve on their Gun, the process of cooling down the gun takes less time. Using this skill reduces the cooldown of both Overcharge and Spark Drive by X Rounds (based on Rank), and reduces the LV of any Burn status you are suffering from.

name: Overcharge
title: Overcharge
description: Overloads the Gun with Focus energy, dramatically increasing its power output. In this state, the next basic attack with a Gun that hits will trigger both the bullet's Bonus Effect and High Charge effect. However, afterwards, this skill is put on a 3 round cooldown. While this skill is on cooldown, magic shell effects will not activate.

name: Recklessness
title: Recklessness
description: The Magic Gunner is a risk taker. The thrill of danger is something they love, and have very little regard for the consequences. Upon activation, the Magic Gunner removes certain negative status effects from themself, and gain an immunity to them for 3 rounds.

name: Akimbo
title: Akimbo
description: If you have a Handgun-type Gun as both your Main Weapon and Sub Weapon, when you use Attack or Sub-Attack, enables the Twin Dance skill from Rogue base class, even if you do not have it active. In addition, the sub-weapon will use all its rounds instead of just 1.

name: Overheat bullet
title: Overheat Bullet
description: Your gun may be hot, but the bullets are hotter. While Overcharge is on cooldown, your Scaled Weapon Attack and Critical Damage with Gun weapons increases.

name: Safety
title: Safety
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: By turning on the safety of your gun, you will not consume Charge Shot or Overcharge when you attack. This skill can be toggled on and off during your turn for free.

name: Spark Drive
title: Spark Drive
description: A special modification to an arcane gun that allows it to steal focus from enemies. At a percentage based on rank, when you land a Critical Hit on an enemy with a Gun weapon, you will automatically become charged as if by Charge Shot. Once activated, this skill is put on a 2 round cooldown.

name: Stand Off
title: Stand Off
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Defensive Knowledge skill. Used to holding their ground, the Magic Gunner's confidence allows them to intercept attacks made at them, increasing Phys. Def by 1% by 20% of your Scaled WIL. (Multiple Defensive Knowledge skills will not stack).

name: Thunder Drive
title: Thunder Drive
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: A further augment to the Spark Drive that causes it to draw too much energy from the target. If Spark Drive would trigger while you already have a Charge Shot prepared, you become Overcharged.

name: Arcane Gun
title: Arcane Gun
description: The Magic Gunner utilizes a special gun that has been modified with certain magical parts, letting them utilize what are called 'Magic Bullets'. Magic Bullets have three different effects listed: Shell, Bonus, and High Charge. You can only have 1 Bullet selected at a time. When you attack with a Gun weapon, on-hit, the Shell effect is applied. See Charge Shot and Overcharge for info on the other two effects.

name: Exposure Tolerance
title: Exposure Tolerance
description: When you're constantly exposed to things like danger and magic, you tend to build up a resistance to them. Passively increases CEL and RES based on Rank.

name: Focused Mind
title: Focused Mind
description: When firing a critical shot, it's important to be completely accurate. While the Magic Gunner has a Charged Shot prepared, they gain a bonus to Hit while attacking with a Gun. If they are Overcharged, the bonus is doubled.

name: One-Hit Wonder
title: One-Hit Wonder
description: Opportunities to blast your opponent in the face are rare, so it's best to make the most of them. Increases Power with Shotgun-Type weapons based on Rank.

name: Geldoren
title: Geldoren
description:
Fist skill. A sweeping tiger strike that cracks through an enemy's defenses. Performs a basic attack on the target with a bonus to damage equal to 2*Rank. If it hits, the target loses DEF and RES for the duration. This lasts for 3 rounds. If the attack is a critical hit, the status power and duration are increased by 1.5x.

Urawaza: Inflicts Fear and knocks back the target on a successful hit.

name: Heaven Kick
title: Heaven Kick
description:
Fist skill. Launch yourself into the air and fall down onto the target enemy, dealing more damage the further away they are. The Range of this skill is equal to your Move.

Urawaza: Enemies within 5 Range of the target are also affected by this skill as if targeted normally.

name: Light Tomahawk
title: Light Tomahawk
description:
Fist skill. Use your leg strength to quickly flip yourself into a quick kick at an enemy in 1 Range, dealing Blunt physical damage. Having a low weight Torso equipped will increase the damage. If you use this skill while Airborne, the maximum potential damage is doubled as you drop down on your enemy, ending your Airborne status.

Urawaza: Rank*20% chance to inflict Guard Break on guarding enemies.

name: Peddling Wheel
title: Peddling Wheel
description:
Fist skill. Spin your body in a somersault, while simultaneously punching and kicking any enemies you pass. You perform this attack in a line that must end in an unoccupied square, and deal Blunt physical damage to every enemy you pass over, or within 1 cardinal tile of a square you pass through.

Urawaza: All enemies hit are also thrown Airborne.

name: Meditate
title: Meditate
description:
Cannot be used while Airborne. Enter a meditating state, focusing your ki and increasing the duration of all positive status effects you have by 1 round. At the start of the next round, you recover HP equal to 200% of your Scaled SKI, plus a bonus based on Rank (you also recover FP equal to half of this rank based bonus). Fear and being knocked back will halve the effectiveness of the heal.

Urawaza: Reduce incoming damage by a percentage equal to the bonus heal until the healing effect triggers.

name: Cleanse Body
title: Cleanse Body
description:
Enter a meditative posture and channel ki to remove harmful effects from your body. If you are affected by certain status effects (based on Rank), they are immediately healed. (The listed status removals are cumulative, so you will remove both Slow and Poison at Rank 2, for example.)

Status effects with a LV higher than your WIL will not be cured.

name: Crack Joints
title: Crack Joints
description: Spend a moment to crack your knuckles, your neck, and all that good stuff. Grants Loosened body LV X (Based on rank) for 5 rounds. If you have no torso equipped, or your total weight is 5 or less. This skill costs 1M less.

name: Crane Hop
title: Crane Hop
description: Can only be used once per round. A simple jump that causes you to move to a nearby tile and become Airborne in the same motion. Since it's so simple, it has low Momentum and FP costs. If you target a tile with an enemy in it, before you land, you will flip them into the air, causing them to become Airborne instead of you.

name: Phoenix Talon
title: Phoenix Talon
description: Enchants your kicks for 5 rounds, causing your kick attacks on Airborne targets to deal Light damage (based on Rank) that ignores armor. Being within an allied Lantern Bearer's Phoenix Aura boosts the damage by 50%. When triggered, you recover HP equal to the bonus damage.

name: Shukuchi
title: Shukuchi
description:
A special martial art, named such because masters of it appear as if they use magic to get rid of the distance between themselves and their enemy. Increases your Move for 1 round, and causes your movement type to become Teleport.

While under the effects of Shukuchi, Geldoren and Light Tomahawk's Range is increased by the Move bonus. Using one of those skills on an enemy will teleport you next to them.

name: Combination Strike
title: Combination Strike
description:
When it comes to fighting a worthy foe, true Martial Artists know that two things are true; first, if you keep using the same technique over and over, your opponents will undoubtedly create counter-measures against it. Secondly, using various techniques in combination often results in a stronger front.

This skill increases the total Power of all Offensive skills by 15%, provided it is the first time you have used it this round, and only if you've used a different Offensive skill from the same class in the same round.

name: Evasive Strike
title: Evasive Strike
description: When you duck out of the way of a punch, the only proper thing to do is hit them back. Serves them right! When you successfully evade an attack from an enemy within 1 Range, you deal Blunt physical damage to them based on Rank. This damage is not affected by their Defense.

name: Mixed Martial Arts
title: Mixed Martial Arts
description:
It's not uncommon for users of the sword or other weapons to mix in unarmed attacks in melee combat. For one thing, the 'sharp weapon' element makes them less weary of your fists, and for another, it gives you another avenue of attack, which is invaluable.

As long as you do not have a sub-weapon or shield equipped in your Hands slot, you can use Fist skills without having a Fist equipped (it will use your bare fists instead). Furthermore, if you have access to the Sub-Attack trait, you gain access to a Sub-Attack with your bare fists.

name: Urawaza
title: Urawaza
extras: This skill does not take up any Skill Pool slots.
description: Toggle skill. What's better than having a special attack? Having a secret special attack. While toggled on, when you use a Martial Artist Offensive skill (or Meditate), you will be prompted to enter a series of directions. If you enter them all successfully, the skill will gain some manner of bonus effect. (Failure has no penalty.)

name: Empty Palm
title: Empty Palm
description: While some Martial Artists prefer to employ gauntlets and other such hand-based weaponry, some still prefer to use absolutely no weapon at all. These users of the empty palm receive a bonus to Power, Hit, and Critical when using their bare fists, based on Rank.

name: Kip-Up
title: Kip-Up
description: Knocking you down just gives you an opportunity to flip yourself back to your feet. Reduces the Momentum needed to get up from a Knocked Down status effect. Kip Up has no effect in Heavy Armor.

name: Protection from Arrows
title: Protection from Arrows
description: The ability to intercept arrows in flight from hitting you. You gain Evade VS Bow weapons based on Rank.

name: Trained Fists
title: Trained Fists
description: Throwing punches and kicks all the time tends [to] make you good at it. Increases Hit when attacking with a Fist weapon.

name: Unarmored Prowess
title: Unarmored Prowess
description: Martial Artists typically do not like armor weighing them down. This skill grants them bonus Evade while using an Unarmored torso.

name: Weathered Body
title: Weathered Body
description: True Martial Artists treat their body as a weapon and armor, having no use for the over-encumbering metal sheets of other fighters. While you have an Unarmored torso with base Armor + base Magic Armor of 4 or less, are not using a shield, and have a sub-weapon that counts as a Fist weapon (or no sub-weapon), all damage you receive is reduced by 10%.

name: Backflip
title: Backflip
description: A simple-looking movement that is actually quite challenging to pull off in practice. Upon using this skill, you can turn yourself in any direction, and when you confirm its usage, you will backflip 3 tiles away from the direction you are facing, without changing direction.

name: Dense Thunder
title: Dense Thunder
description:
A spinning kick that targets an enemy within 1 range, dealing blunt physical damage.

Ki: Knocks them away 1 tile per 3 Ki, to a max of 8, using 1 Ki per tile. Deals Sound magic damage to all enemies in 3 Range equal to half of the original damage if they run into an object. Otherwise, if Shukuchi is active, teleport next to them if the next tile in the same direction is empty, and apply the same effect (half effectiveness).

name: Dragon Gale
title: Dragon Gale
description:
A heavy punch followed by a roundhouse kick, dealing damage based on Rank over two hits, to an enemy within 1 Range.

Ki: Gains +1 Range per 3 Ki, to a max. of 6. If you target an enemy outside of melee range, 2 Ki will be consumed per tile, but will launch a ki dragon at the target, applying the effect of this skill, creating air shafts for 3 rounds, but doing Wind magic damage (and bonus damage equal to 100% of Wind ATK).

name: Kadouha
title: Kadouha
description:
Consumes Ki, up to a max, and unleashes a ball of it that travels up to X (5+1 per 5 Ki) Range away. ON hit, it deals Light magic damage (+Ki consumed% bonus damage). Gains bonus effects if it consumes enough Ki.

10 Ki: Grows in size, hitting a wider area. Pierces enemies instead of being destroyed. (3 tile width)

20 Ki: Explodes when the projectile ends, dealing 75% of its damage to enemies who weren't hit within 3 Range.

30 Ki: Inflicts Knockdown.

If Ki Awoken is active, this skill will not consume any Ki.

name: Ki Blast
title: Ki Blast
description: Concentrate your Ki into a small projectile blast. Uses 5 Ki. Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range and performs a basic attack on them with your Fist weapon, which deals magic damage. If Ki Awoken is active, the damage is increased by 15% and is done over 3 hits.

name: Setting Sun
title: Setting Sun
description:
Targets a 1-X Range circle within 7 Range, and launches a sun-like Ki sphere. It will hover there for 3 rounds until it expires (or this skill is used again), where it will descend, dealing Fire magic damage that ignores evasion to all enemies in its radius.

Ki: Can be resized, +1 maximum size per 5 Ki to a max. of 5. Damage increases by 25% per 1 extra range. Consumes 3 Ki per range, even at the default size. (IE, default = 3, 1+ size = 6, etc).

name: Sky Chariot
title: Sky Chariot
description:
A crashing drop kick that slams into one enemy in 1 range, dealing blunt physical damage to them.

Ki: If used while airborne, and you have 5 or more Ki, 5 is consumed, increasing the damage dealt by 15% and knocking down the target. If the target is already knocked down, the damage is increased by 30% instead and target is inflicted with Immobilize for 2 rounds. Your airborne status then ends.

name: Terra Strike
title: Terra Strike
description:
You strike the ground with your fist at a location within 1 Range. Any enemy there takes physical Blunt damage and inflicts them with Slow LV3 until your next turn. Also destroys enemy-created tiles in that tile.

Ki: Gains 1 Range per 5 Ki, (max. 6). If the tile is more than 1 Range away, you launch a Ki dragon towards that location, applying its effect at it, dealing Earth damage instead and increasing damage by 100% of Earth ATK. (Costs 1 Ki per range).

name: Body of Isesip
title: Body of Isesip
description: Cover your body in a barrier of ki harder than diamond. You gain the 'Body of Isesip' status, which negates all damage, but halves your Evade. If you take damage, the duration is reduced by 1, and if it reaches 0, the status ends. The base duration is 1 round. If 10 Ki is available, it will be consumed and increase the duration by 2 rounds.

name: Aid
title: Aid
description: Targets yourself, or an ally within 5 Range. The target is healed based on your Scaled WIL (based on Rank). If the target was an ally and not yourself, you dash to an empty tile next to them and generate Ki, based on Rank.

name: Ki Awoken
title: Ki Awoken
description:
A dangerous skill that boosts Ki Generation and the user's own capabilities by combining their bodies with the Ki itself. Increases all statistics (except VIT) and generates Ki by Rank every round. However, this comes at a risk; it drains HP every subsequent round, starting at 5% of max HP and doubling every round after that (but will never reduce you below 1 HP) while active.

Activate this skill again to end the effect before it's too late (Momentum will be refunded for the second use).

name: Power Up
title: Power Up
description: Raise your arms and focus your power. Uses up all of your available Momentum, to a minimum of 3, and restores your FP and generates Ki based on the amount consumed, based on Rank. If 6 or more is consumed, both effects are increased by 50%. (The values listed are per point of Momentum).

name: Sun Flare
title: Sun Flare
description: You put your hands in front of your face and release a blinding flash of light. Requires and consumes 15 Ki. All enemies within 1 Range are inflicted with Blind for 2 rounds. All other enemies have a luck-based chance to be inflicted with Blind for 2 rounds. All enemies also take armor-ignoring Light magic damage equal to 15 * Rank.

name: Serpent Strikes
title: Serpent Strikes
description: Your spiritual energy augments your strikes. You gain Critical equal to your Ki when using Fist weapons. In addition, at 20 Ki or higher, your Fist basic attacks will get a serpent's bite, dealing Acid magic damage equal to 100% of your Acid ATK on hit.

name: Suppress Ki
title: Suppress Ki
description: The ability to control and contain your ki is highly valuable for a Monk. While toggled on, offensive skills (excluding Kadouha and Setting Sun) that utilize Ki will treat your Ki as 0, and won't consume any Ki when used.

name: Woki
title: Woki
description: Focused, you are a source of positive energy for yourself and allies. When your Ki is 10 or more, you generate an aura that gives all allied units in Range a bonus to STR and WIL.

name: All Fight
title: All Fight
description: True monks know the value of time and being efficient, and therefore try to deal with as many enemies as possible at once. When damaging an enemy, if that enemy has not been damaged by the Monk in same round, the damage is increased by 5% and it generates 2 Ki for the user.

name: Discipline
title: Discipline
