description: A type of martial arts mastery that instills the importance of patience and precision. Passively increases SKI and CEL.

name: Golden Glow
title: Golden Glow
description: A golden glow associated with legends. When using Power Up, if your Ki is increased to the upper limit of 30, you gain Golden Glow for 3 rounds. Golden Glow increases your Phys. and Mag. Def based on Rank.

name: Power Impact
title: Power Impact
description: Makes your power up even more of a power up, or maybe a power out. When you use Power Up, all enemies within 2 Range of you will be knocked back by 3 tiles.

name: Spirituality
title: Spirituality
description: You generate a special energy called Ki, which is a type of spiritual energy. You gain Ki based on Rank every round, to a maximum of 30. The rate is doubled if Monk is both your Main Class and your Sub Class.

name: Bloody Ball
title: Bloody Ball
description: Performer song skill. More worries than just stepping on toes. Play your instrument, causing all Confused enemies within 7 range to use their main weapon's attack skill on a random enemy within its attack range (except your allies and themself). This attack gains a bonus to Critical (based on Rank).

name: La Finita
title: La Finita
description:
Performer Song skill. Adieu, bonsoir, farewell!

Targets 1 Converted Enemy within 5 Range. Play your instrument, filling them with magic energy, until they burst, dealing massive elemental magic damage that ignores evasion based on your Starsign (Fire by default; Elemental ATK scaling is based on your Starsign) in a 5 Size Circle around them. As you might expect, your new 'friend' won't live through the experience, reducing their HP to 0 afterwards.

name: Rain-Caller Rondo
title: Rain-Caller Rondo
description:
Performer Song skill. Alternatively, one could call it the song of storms, played to call the rain.

Play your instrument, dealing Water magic damage and reduce the Fire ATK (3 rounds; LV based on Rank) of all enemies within 5 Range. If a Rainstorm is currently active on the battlefield, this song will affect all enemies instead.

name: Snake-Dancer Medley
title: Snake-Dancer Medley
description:
Performer Song skill. A song said to make even snakes dance with delight.

Play your instrument, dealing Acid magic damage and attempting to inflict Poison LV X (3 rounds; LV based on Rank) to all enemies within 5 Range. Affected enemies who are Charmed Snakemen or Serpentkind also have a chance to be inflicted with Confusion for 3 rounds.

name: Conductor's Direction
title: Conductor's Direction
description: Performer Song skill. Give the players some guidance. Targets 1 tile within 5 Range containing an enemy or Converted enemy and 1 unoccupied tile within that same Range, and play your instrument, forcing that enemy to take X steps towards it (based on Rank). (Non-Converted, non-Confused enemies require an infliction check for this effect to activate.)

name: Piped Piper
title: Pied Piper
description:
Performer Song skill. A charming melody inviting foes to doom.

Play your instrument, attempting to inflict Charmed LV X (based on Rank) and Confusion for 3 rounds each to all enemies within 5 Range.

name: Song of Susceptibility
title: Song of Susceptibility
description:
Performer Song skill. A haunting tone that invites darkness.

Play your instrument, inflicting all enemies in 5 Range with Song of Susceptibility, which lowers their Status Resistance by LV (based on Rank), for 3 rounds.

name: Warmonger's Drums
title: Warmonger's Drums
description:
Performer Song skill. Beat the drums of war.

Play your instrument, and in 5 range around you; deals Sound magic damage to enemies, and boosting the Scaled Weapon Attack of all allies by X (based on Rank) until your next turn.

name: Beat It
title: Beat it
description:
Cannot be used until Round 2. You know, I think it would be best if we just left...

Avoid paying bar tabs and angry fathers by having you and the boys flee from the battle immediately. Can only be used in battles against monsters, however (which might raise more than a few questions...) Certain enemies, such as bosses, cannot be run from.

name: Bewitching Melody
title: Bewitching Melody
description:
Performer Song skill. Let them give into the music. Tagets 1 enemy within 5 Range under the Song of Susceptibility; effect differs if the target is a monster or not.

Monster: Tries to Convert Enemy (Performer) Other: Attempts to inflict Pacify until your next turn. (Skill enters 2 round CD if used this way.)

This skill can make a monster into an ally temporarily. If successful, the monster that is converted will be treated as a member of your party for the rest of the battle, will be cured of Confusion, and it will give EXP at the end of it as if you defeated it normally. Bosses, minibosses, and undead-race monsters are immune. You also cannot convert enemies with a level higher than (your level + 10). Only one Converted Enemy can be in your party at a time.

Your success rate is equal to the following: Scaled GUI + (Galdr talent Rank * 2) + (your level - target's level, or 0 if less than 1) + 25 if target is Charmed by you + 25 if target is Confused = success percent.

Cannot use basic attacks or Offensive skills. Taking non-status, non-bonus damage will reduce its duration by 1 round.

name: Active Performance
title: Active Performance
description: Performing isn't just about playing the notes; it's about putting on a show. If you have used a Dance skill this round, the Range of your Bard and Performer songs increases by 2.

name: Amplified Aria
title: Amplified Aria
description: A new twist on an old favorite. When playing the Aria of Agility, all affected allies also gain +X Evade for 2 attacks/3 rounds. (x = 3*Aria of Agility's Rank)

name: Curing Cantus
title: Curing Cantus
description: A new twist on an old favorite. When playing the Cantus of Consideration, all affected allies are also healed of 1 or more random negative status effects. (Maximum healed = 1 + half of Cantus of Consideration's Rank; 3 at Rank 5. Your LUC improves the chance of more statuses healed.)

name: Defending Dawr
title: Defending Dawr
description: A new twist on an old favorite. When playing the Dawr of Defense, all affected allies also gain Swift Guard LV X until their next turn. (X = 2*Dawr of Defense's Rank)

name: Dodging Tomatoes
title: Dodging Tomatoes
description: Everyone's a critic. While you are Singing, your Evade is increased by X (based on Rank).

name: Encore
title: Encore
description: Sometimes a song is so good, people want to listen to it over and over. When one of your Bard song effects expires due to its duration on you or an ally), there is a chance (based on Rank and SAN) that the same effect will reapply itself with a 2 round duration automatically. (NOTE: Songs reapplied this way will not trigger this effect.)

name: Exceptional Enthusiasm
title: Exceptional Enthusiasm
description: A new twist on an old favorite. When playing the Anthem of Enthusiasm, all affected allies also deal Sound bonus magic damage on hit equal to 5+X% of your Sound ATK (up to 3 times) for 3 rounds. (X = 10*Anthem of Enthusiasm's Rank.)

name: Music Heals
title: Music Heals
description: What more is there to say? The healing aura of your tunes will spread their good vibes to allies. Your Bard song aura effects grant +5 HP regeneration to all affected units.

name: Performer's Heart
title: Performer's Heart
extras: No longer take up a skill pool slot.
description: A true Performer is made better just by putting on a show. While you are Singing, your HP and FP Regeneration are increased by 5.

name: Second Verse
title: Second Verse
description: The second verse? It's the same as the first. If you are Singing at the start of a new round, there is a chance (based on Rank and LUC) that all allies will have your currently active Bard effects extended caused by you by 1 round.

name: Shower of Applause
title: Shower of Applause
description: The true reward of a Performer is nothing but the gratitude of the listener. Boosts EXP gained, Murai found, and chance to find items after a battle by 10%. (Does not stack with skills of the same name.)

name: Striking Samba
title: Striking Samba
description: A new twist on an old favorite. When playing the Samba of Strength, all affected allies also gain +X Critical for 2 attacks/3 rounds. (X = 3*Samba of Strength's Rank.)

name: Tune Up
title: Tune Up
extras: No longer take up a skill pool slot.
description: Instruments get worn out, just as much as the person playing them; a little maintenance here and there goes a long way. At the end of a battle, any Instrument weapon(s) you have equipped regain 1-3 durability.

name: Divine Judgement
title: Divine Judgement
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Targets 1 enemy within 8 Range. For 5 rounds, that enemy's Faith is used instead of Defense/Resistance when calculating Phys/Magic Def for Mercalan domain spells respectively. In addition, the target's Light resistance is also negated, they become vulnerable to Antithesis, Blessed and Holy enchants, and lost elemental ATK equal to LV * 2. This effect cannot be dispelled.

name: Divine Shower
title: Divine Shower
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Targets all enemies on the battlefield and deals Light magic damage that ignores evasion to them equal to WIL + a bonus based on rank. At Rank 5, all enemies damage also have a chance to be Blinded for 2 rounds. After being successfully casts, goes on a 3 round Cooldown.

name: Gentle Torrent
title: Gentle Torrent
description: Sends out a bubble of water as a projectile in a 7 Range line, which washes over enemies and allies alike. If it passes over an ally, all negative status effects the ally has are reduced by 1 round in duration. If it hits an enemy, they take Water magic damage, and the projectile will stop.

name: Holy Spark
title: Holy Spark
description: Targets a 2 Range circle up to 7 Range away from the caster and deals magic damage to all enemies within it. The damage is split evenly between Light and Lightning.

name: Mercalan Mist
title: Mercalan Mist
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Mist skill. Upon being cast, the battlefield is covered in a light blue mist for 5 rounds, which grants all allies bonus HP regeneration equal to 25% of your Light ATK (or a Rank-based minimum, whichever is higher) and increases their Evade (based on Rank). Enemies gain a 3% weakness to Lightning damage (per Rank) while the mist is active. (Only one Mist skill can be active on the battlefield at a time; the last one cast will take priority and nullify previous ones.)

name: Needle
title: Needle
description: Unleashes a barrage of needles as projectiles in a line (4+Rank Range); one projectile per Rank. Each projectile that hits an enemy pierces them with needles and deals Light damage that ignores armor (based on Rank). The target remains pierced by the needles for the rest of the round, and if they take Light damage from any source except Needle, the needles will explode, dealing Light damage to the target equal to half the original amount, and releasing a healing pulse that recovers the HP of any ally within 2 Range by the same amount.

name: Shine Knights
title: Shine Knights
description:
This skill requires a Rank C Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Summons a Shine Knight is summoned next to the caster. At Rank 1, they have the Protect skill. At Rank 2, they boost stats for nearby allies. At Rank 3, they reduce the Hit of nearby enemies. At Rank 4, basic attacks receive damage and range. (Shine Knights last until defeated.)

Rank 1: LV:20

Rank 2: LV: 30, Gains immunity to Dark/Light

Rank 3: LV: 40, gains Blinding aura.

Rank 4: LV: 50, Alondite weapon upgrade.

Rank 5: LV: 60, summons 2 Shine Knights instead of 1.

name: Shine Ray
title: Shine Ray
description: Targets 1 enemy within 5 Range away from the caster and deals Light magic damage to them. In addition, a Light Shaft is created at the target location for 3 rounds with a LV equal to half that. (A Light Shaft decreases the Hit of anyone who stands within it by LV.)

name: Cool Burns
title: Cool Burns
description: Treatment skill. Targets 1 ally (or yourself) within 1 Range and removes any Burn effect they are suffering from, as long as it has a LV equal to or lower than X (based on Rank). If you have a Staff-type weapon equipped, the Range of this skill is increased by 3.

name: Malmelo
title: Malmelo
description: Healing skill. Recovers the HP of all party members by a percentage of their maximum HP equal to Scaled FAI/2, up to a maximum of Rank*6%. The healing effect is only half as effective on summoned allies, such as Shine Knights, Youkai, Engineer machines, etc.

name: Purify Poison
title: Purify Poison
description: Treatment skill. Targets 1 ally (or yourself) within 1 Range and removes any Poison effect they are suffering from, as long as it has a LV equal to or lower than X (based on Rank). If you have a Staff-type weapon equipped, the Range of this skill is increased by 3.

name: Strong Legs
title: Strong Legs
description: Treatment skill. Targets 1 ally (or yourself) within 1 Range and removes any Fear effect they are suffering from. If you have a Staff-type weapon equipped, the Range of this skill is increased by 3. At Rank 2, Hesitation is also affected. At Rank 3, Knockdown is also affected.

name: Sanctuary
title: Sanctuary
description: Creates a Sanctuary in a 2-5 Range circle around your current location. At the start of a new round, if you are not within the Sanctuary, it is dispelled. While active, all allies within it receive a bonus to DEF and RES, and all enemies within it receive a penalty to STR and WIL. In addition, special effect tiles cannot be created within the Sanctuary's confines. (The Sanctuary will be last for 5 rounds or until dispelled. Casting this spell again will remove the first Sanctuary.)

name: Blackened Faith
title: Blackened Faith
description: Sometimes, we put our faith in unorthodox sources. For priest spells, spells that utilize Light ATK and deal light damage are changed to use Dark ATK and deal Dark damage respectively (there is no change to the scaling values). Some invocation may be altered in similar way if they deal with Light ATK or light damage.

name: Detailed Care
title: Detailed Care
description: Being up close and personal with someone you're treating often allows for a better level of care. When you are within 1 Range of a target you are using a Healing or Treatment skill on (Curate and Priest only), the power of the heal or cure is increased by 10% per Rank. (This does not apply when you are the target. This will affect the maximum LV healed by Treatment skills.)

name: Devocation
title: Devocation
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Let the power of faith see you through. While this skill is equipped, whenever you are invoking a Mercana spell, any chance for the Invocation to break upon taking damage is reduced by half of your Scaled FAI.

name: Longterm Cure
title: Longterm Cure
description: Treating an illness is important, but it's also just as important to prevent it from happening again. When you use a Treatment skill on an ally (except yourself), they also become immune to the status type(s) it cures for X rounds (X = Rank). At Rank 5, when you use a Treatment skill on an ally or yourself, you also become immune to the same status type(s) for half the normal duration (rounded down).

name: God Rod
title: God Rod
description: A staff is a common symbol attributed to priests and bishops, and through it, they channel their holy power. Lets Staff weapons be used as casting tools for Mercalan domain spells.

name: Mercalan Tenants
title: Mercalan Tenets
description: The way of Mercala teaches that healing magic should not be abused, because mankind would come to take it for granted, spurring on more aggressive or reckless pursuits. As such, her followers are taught that it is best to treat with non-magical methods when possible, and to use the magic only in emergencies or situations that do not act against this desire. When you use a healing item (except a Staff) on an ally, you regain FP, based on Rank.

name: Piety
title: Piety
description: A good priest isn't good nor a priest without faith guiding them. Increases FAI based Rank. At Rank 5, FAI is increased by an additional +1.

name: Staff Mastery
title: Staff Mastery
description: Utilizing staves gives the Priest a unique source of power, which causes their WIL and FAI to increase by 1 for every Staff Battle Item they have equipped in their Item Belt.

name: Agile Androcobra
title: Agile Androcobra
description:
Arcane skill. Fires a slithering arrow that deals Acid magic damage to the first enemy hit and applies Acidity LV X (X = 2+Rank). If it passes over an allied Rain Trap, it will apply its damage & effects in its range, create LV 20 Poison Pools for 3 rounds, and destroy the trap. (Enemies can only be damaged once per skill use.)

Annorum: The arrow will continue even after hitting an enemy and the Acidity LV is doubled.

name: Cherry Blossom
title: Cherry Blossom
description:
Arcane skill. A cherry blossom blooms at a tile in 7 range, which boosts the stats of those near it (only one can be active). Enemies beneath it will take Earth magic damage, be knocked airborne, and one tile away. An enemy damaged by Cherry Blossom while within 3 range of it are covered in Cherry Petals for 3 rounds.

Annorum: Targets a Cherry Blossom. Destroys it, but deals this skill's damage to all enemies, and restores all allies' HP by 50+(50*Rank.)

Cherry Petals

Additionally treated as plant race, due to being covered in petals. Because that's all it takes.

name: Deos Danzai
title: Deos Danzai
description:
Creates four arrows of light in 2-long lines of tiles on either side of you. After a turn of priming, they will launch at the nearest enemy every round there after, one at a time, dealing Light magic damage. They can be attacked and destroyed, however; if so, the attacker recovers 20 FP.

Annorum: Danzai arrows gain an additional hit of durability and have no priming time.

name: Flip Shot
title: Flip Shot
description: An acrobatic shot that targets two locations. While moving toward location (2), you fire at location (1), performing a basic attack on any enemy on that location with a bonus to Hit (based on Rank).

name: Forest Fiend
title: Forest Fiend
description:
Arcane skill. Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and deals Fire magic damage to any enemy, and destroys any plant field objects in that tile. Deals 10% bonus damage to Plant/Doriad race enemies.

Annorum: Effect is applied in a 5 Range circle instead, can inflict burn LV X (X = Rank * 10) for 3 rounds, and may stun Plant/Doriad enemies.

name: Frigid Arrow
title: Frigid Arrow
description:
Arcane skill. Deals Ice magic damage to an enemy within 5 Range. It can also target a Rain Trap instead; doing so will apply this skill's damage & effects in its range, create ice sheets for 3 rounds, and destroy the trap.

Annorum: Inflicts Frozen LV X (X = Rank *75) for 3 rounds, and Heavy Frost for 2 rounds.

Heavy Frost

Your armor type is being treated as heavy armor, due to being covered in heavy chunks of ice.

name: Ghost Arrow
title: Ghost Arrow
description:
Arcane skill. Fires a ghastly arrow which will pass through enemies for 3 tiles, before becoming tangible and traveling until it hits an enemy. An enemy hit by it takes Dark magic damage. If it passes over an allied Rain Trap, it will apply its damage & effects in its range, create delayed Dark Water tiles for 3 rounds, and destroy the trap. (Enemies can only be damaged once per skill use.)

Annorum: If the enemy hit is reduced to 0 HP, summons a Ghost ally.

name: Pressure Fletch
title: Pressure Fletch
description:
Arcane skill. Fires a powerful water jet as an arrow that deals Water magic damage over 3 hits to 1 enemy within 5 range. Alternatively, it can target an allied Rain Trap, destroying the trap but applying this skill's effects and creating flooded water (3 rounds) in it's AoE.

Annorum: Washes away a number of positive status effects from the target(s) equal to the number of successful hits.

name: Retreat Flight
title: Retreat Flight
description: Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range. You perform a flip off that target's body, becoming airborne and moving backwards 1-4 Range, which must end in an unoccupied tile, and become Airborne. You also perform a basic attack on the target, with a bonus to Hit, based on Rank.

name: Sonic Arrow
title: Sonic Arrow
description:
Arcane skill. A fast, magical arrow that screeches painfully past enemies. Deals Sound magic damage to 1 enemy within 5 Range. If the target is wearing heavy armor or is your Marked Target, or an ally who is singing, the arrow resonates, applying to all other units in 3 range. Allies affected gain Sound ATK Up LV (Rank * 5, x1.5 if Annorum enhanced) for 3 rounds.

Annorum: Chance to inflict Silence for 3 rounds, and shatters ice sheets.

name: Thunder Bolt
title: Thunder Bolt
description:
Arcane skill. Targets a 5 Range cross pattern and deals Lightning damage to all enemies in it. If you are airborne, it can target up to 10 range away.

Annorum: Leaves behind a quaking bolt at the center, which explodes next round, dealing Sound magic damage to all enemies hit and knocking them down.

name: Twin Shot
title: Twin Shot
description: Fires two shots from your bow which travel diagonally in the direction you are facing. The first enemy hit by each projectile will take Pierce physical damage, which can critically hit, based on Rank. If the projectile hits an enemy, it also applies on-hit effects of the bow weapon that fires it.

name: Wind Runner
title: Wind Runner
description:
Arcane skill. Unleashes a windy arrow in a 5 Range line, dealing Wind magic damage and knocking back all enemies hit 1 tile.

Annorum: Becomes a 2-7 Range line that must end in an empty tile. You fly on top of the arrow, becoming Airborne. Enemies hit are knocked back 1 tile and knocked down. In addition, if you have a melee weapon equipped, you attack enemies you pass in 1 range of with it (50% damage).

name: Gentle Garden
title: Gentle Garden
description: Can only target an allied unit within 2 Range of a plant field object. Releases natural healing energies from a nearby plant, healing the target's HP for 50 + X (X = the target's level * Rank)

name: Annorum
title: Annorum
description: A magic sigil that is inscribed on an arrow, filling it with enhanced power. Rangers have an Annorum gauge in battle, which is filled with charges when casting a Spell (3 for Ranger spells, 2 for other spells) up to a maximum of 9. When 9 are available, the next Arcane-class Ranger spell will be enhanced with a bonus effect (see specific skills for those). After activating a bonus effect, charges cannot be regained automatically during the same round.

name: Forest Walk
title: Forest Walk
description: Can only be used while on a tile with a Nest or a plant on it, and can only target an unoccupied tile with the same conditions. You disappear into the brush and reappear at the target location.

name: Rain Trap
title: Rain Trap
description: Places a Rain Trap at a location within 2 range for 10 rounds. When triggered, and for 3 rounds, after that, it sprays water in an X (based on Rank) Range diamond, inflicting Soaked on all enemies in that area for 3 rounds. Soaked causes special effects when the target takes Fire, Lightning, Ice, or Earth damage.

name: Expert's Aim
title: Expert's Aim
description:
A steady hand makes for a steady shot. If you have Longdraw equipped, it activates automatically (for free) at the start of a round. However, using any movement skill will cause it to end (while this skill is equipped).

Most Ranger Arcane spells benefit from Longdraw's Range increase.

name: Spellshot Sigil
title: Spellshot Sigil
extras: This skill does not take up any Skill Pool slots.
description: Turning the shot into spell energy, the Ranger is capable of using their well placed shots to amplify the Arcane. When you score a critical hit with Bow weapons, you generate 1 Annorum charge.

name: Acrobatic Shooting
title: Acrobatic Shooting
description: Rangers are skilled at moving swiftly and unpredictably, even while attacking. Grants a bonus to Evade until your next turn after using a Ranger Offensive skill that causes you to move.

name: Agile Protection
title: Agile Protection
description:
When using Light Armor, increase your Critical Evade, based on Rank.

Main Class skill. Ranger only.

name: Beast Hunter
title: Beast Hunter
description:
Trained in hunting animals, among other things. For Beast and Avian race enemies: +10% Damage Dealt, -10% Damage Taken. Also half effective versus Kaelensia.

Main Class skill. Ranger only.

name: Nest of Nests
title: Nest of Nests
description: You're a master of nests. Increases the Range of Nest by 5 and extends the duration of its effect by 3 rounds.

name: Fire Trap
title: Fire Trap
description:
Places a fire trap at an unoccupied square within 2 range for 10 rounds. If an enemy walks within 2 cardinal squares of the trap, it triggers, dealing Fire physical damage to them. They may also be inflicted with Burn LV X (X= Rank * 10) for 3 rounds.

Traps become stronger every round they are active.

name: Fire Trap
title: Hand Trigger
description: A hand-made trigger is something you use to detonate a trap from a longer range at will. Using this skill will do just that; cause all traps you have set to detonate automatically. Naturally, any enemies within range of the trap will be affected by it.

name: Gust Trap
title: Gust Trap
description:
Places a gust trap at an unoccupied square within 2 range for 10 turns. If an enemy walks within 2 cardinal squares of the trap, it triggers, deals Wind physical damage, causes the triggerer to stop their movement, and knocks them away from the trap 1 square. They may also be inflicted with a Poison LV X (X = Rank * 5) for 3 rounds.

Traps become stronger every round they are active.

name: Ice Trap
title: Ice Trap
description:
Places an ice trap at an unoccupied square within 2 range for 10 rounds. If an enemy walks within 2 cardinal squares of the trap, it triggers, which will cause all tiles in its Range to be covered in Ice Sheets for 3 rounds, as well as dealing Ice Physical damage to the one who triggered it. They may also be inflicted with Frostbite LV X (X = Rank * 10) for 3 rounds.

Traps become stronger every round they are active.

name: Northern Wind
title: Northern Wind
description: Gain the blessing of the harsh northern winds, granting you bonus Critical. If you are closer to the north edge of the battlefield than the south edge, you gain additional Critical. This bonus lasts for 3 rounds.

name: Southern Wind
title: Southern Wind
description: Gain a blessing from the southern winds of avoidance, increasing your evasion. If you are closer to the south edge of the battlefield than the north edge, you gain additional Evade. This bonus lasts for 3 rounds.

name: Eastern Wind
title: Eastern Wind
description: Gain a blessing from the eastern winds of agility, increasing the target's accuracy and speed. If you are closer to the east edge of the battlefield than the west edge, the stat bonus is higher. This bonus lasts for 3 rounds.

name: Improvised Weapon
title: Improvised Weapon
description: Grab something, anything to use as a weapon from nearby, replacing your main weapon with a random object (Rock, Glass Shard, or Pointy Stick) from nearby, for 2+Rank rounds. This weapon does not count as a specific weapon type, and it always has 5 Power, 85 Accuracy, and 10 Critical. It's better than having a broken weapon, for sure, and you can always throw it away when you don't need it (during your turn).'

name: Pocket Sand
title: Pocket Sand
description: Reach into your pocket, grab a fist full of sand, and throw it in the eyes (or whatever seems the most like them) of 1 enemy within 2 Range, Blinding them for 2 rounds. Afterwards, your pocket will be empty of sand, meaning you can only use this skill once per battle

name: Quick Slide
title: Quick Slide
description:
Throw yourself into a slide at a target unoccupied location within 3 Range, quickly repositioning yourself.

Trickery: If you have a Trap skill equipped, automatically apply it at your current location before you slide.

name: Rough Tumble
title: Rough Tumble
description: Use your enemy as a springboard to flip yourself to a more useful location. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range; if the tile on the other side of them is unoccupied, you will vault over them and land on that tile.

name: Steal
title: Steal
description: Take something from another for yourself! But only the good things. And only status effects. At a chance equal to your Scaled CEL + a bonus based on Rank, you can take up to 1 beneficial status effect from the target for yourself.

name: Western Wind
title: Western Wind
description: Gain a blessing from the western winds of fleeting, increasing your Move for the duration. If you are closer to the west edge of the battlefield than the east edge, you gain additional Move. This bonus lasts for 3 rounds.

name: Dodger
title: Dodger
description: Rogues are, without saying, naturals at avoiding things, whether that be the law, or a swift kick to the jewels. Increases your base Evade (this is considered a base increase, and is not affected by the +50 Evade bonus cap.)

name: Incognito
title: Incognito
description: Hiding yourself is a pretty useful thing to do in the midst of monsters. Monsters in battle will treat you as a low priority target, making them more likely to attack and approach your allies, summons, or associates.

name: Relentless Strikes
title: Relentless Strikes
description: With every strike, you aim for better spots, honed and relentless. After performing a basic attack, you increase the damage dealt by your basic attacks by 2 for 1 round. (This effect can stack up to a maximum LV.)

name: Stealth Traps
title: Stealth Traps
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Traps can be effective in certain situations. Even if your enemy knows there's a trap, that doesn't mean they can ignore [it]. Hidden traps are even better. When you place a trap, after a short arming animation, the traps disappears from the view of everyone.

name: Thorn Scratch
title: Thorn Scratch
description:
Leave a little mark when you pass, just like bumping against a thorny vine. While you have at least one Dagger weapon equipped, when you move over a tile, any enemy located in that tile will be slashed by you, dealing up the X damage (based on Rank) equal to your Dagger's Power, of your dagger's damage type. This damage ignores protection.

If both of your classes are Rogue classes, the damage cap is doubled.

name: Throwing Daggers
title: Throwing Daggers
description: Toss your daggers as if they were projectiles. You can utilize 1 LV of Throwing Daggers to increase the basic attack range of your Dagger weapons by 3. You start battle with LV X (based on Rank), and gain 1 at the start of a new round, up to a maximum of 3. (If both classes are Rogue classes, you gain 2 at the start of a new round instead.)

name: Twin Dance
title: Twin Dance
description: On the battlefield, true Rogues tend to prefer to strike quick and often. When you Attack or Sub-Attack while you have two non-Bow weapons equipped of the same weapon type, you will attack with the other, but this attack deals significantly reduced damage if it hits. (Attack target must be in 1 Range unless using Shuriken weapons. Mutated weapons may not qualify.)

name: Flank
title: Flank
description: Attacking a target from a vulnerable angle is quite beneficial, letting you hit them harder in softer spots. When attacking an enemy from the side or behind, you gain damage based on Rank. (Guns do not receive a damage bonus from Flank.) If the attack is from a Dagger weapon, you also ignore up to 6 Armor from the target.

name: Quick Rise
title: Quick Rise
description: A true Rogue always takes any small opportunity and turns it into an advantage for them, if possible. When you are Knocked Down, if you successfully Evade an attack, you are cured of Knock Down for free by quickly jumping to your feet.

name: Resourceful
title: Resourceful
description: Being flexible is usually a good thing. It's beneficial to anyone, most of all adventurers, to always have new tricks up their sleeve, and a resourceful rogue is just that. Flexible. This inate skill will increase your maximum possible equipped skills.

name: Wind Dancer
title: Wind Dancer
description: A mastery of calling upon the four winds. Will increase the duration and reduce the cost of Northern Wind, Eastern Wind, Southern Wind, and Western Wind based on Rank.

name: Complex Shatter
title: Complex Shatter
description: Targets an enemy within X range (based on Rank), and performs a basic attack on the target with your whip which deals magic damage. If the target is Crystalized, the attack gains a bonus to Hit, and if it hits, the Crystal shatters into 2 gemstones for 2 rounds, landing at random tiles within 2 range of the target.

name: Despot Drill
title: Despot Drill
description: Turn your whip into a spinning drill and rush in a 3 to 5 range line. You move until stopped, each step affecting enemies and natural resources in 1 range. Enemies take Pierce Magic damage, and resources are refined. (Enemies are damaged once.) Can guard-break guarding or crystalized units at X% chance ( X = 10 x Ruler/Mage Buffs), on success digs up a rock near the enemy.

name: Rawhide Slash
title: Rawhide Slash
description: Flourish your whip wildly. Hitting a 4 size crescent area within 3 range. Enemies in those tiles take Slash physical damage, and up to X ( X = rank) Natural Resources in that area cut up by your whip and refined (Ruler) into Geomaterial.

name: Ruler's Revocation
title: Ruler's Revocation
description: Targets 1 ally within 8 range, and charge all of the non-permanent mage/ruler enchant spell effect that they been granted by you into arcane missiles. These missiles are elemental homing projectile that target random enemies within 10 range around them, which deal armor-ignoring armor damage with Great Accuracy (Can never be missed). The element is based on the domain of the spell that granted the buff.

name: Simple Shell
title: Simple Shell
description: Targets an enemy within X range (based on rank), causing your whip to wrap around them like a snake, dealing Blunt Physical damage to them. If it hits, you infuse your whip with geomancy and make the target Crystalized for 3 rounds.

name: Slicing Benten
title: Slicing Benten
description:
Dance skill. Spin your whip in a wild motion around yourself as you dance in a 3-5 range line that must end in an unoccupied tile. Everytime you move, a random enemy and 1 natural resource within 2 range are affected. Enemies take Slash Magic Damage (based on rank), while resources are Refined.

Trickery - Gain Ranged Attack Deflection Lv. 1 until your next turn.

name: Tyrant's Throne
title: Tyrant's Throne
description: Requires 2 Geomaterial. Create a permanent Tyrant's throne under you (only 1 can be active). While on your throne, you can use the Sit on Throne skill. While sitting on your throne, you gain a bonus to DEF/RES/CEL/LUC/STR equal to it's LV x 2, immunity to knockback/pull, and knocked down and gain LV attack range for whip attack, but you are immobile. This effect lasts until your next turn.

name: Crest of Bishop
title: Crest of Bishop
description: Requires 3 Geomaterial. Create a magic sigil that enchants an ally within 5 range, granting them Crest of Bishop for 5 rounds. If the target is one of your Pawn Automatons, if you do not have a Bishop Automaton, they instead gain it permanently and are transformed into a Bishop automaton and gain 1 LV of Automaton Energy. Trickery - Target's negative status effect caused by enemies are reduced by 1 round. Crest of Bishop's buff: LVx2 Light ATK. Decreases the duration of status effect by 1 round.

name: Crest of Knight
title: Crest of Knight
description: Require 3 Geomaterial. Create a magic sigil that enchants an ally within 5 Range, granting them Creste of Knight for 5 rounds. If the target is one of your Pawn Automatons, if you do not have a Knight Automaton, they instead gain it permanently and are trained into a Knight Automaton and gain 1 LV of Automaton Energy. Trickery effect - Automaton targets use their main weapon's atack skill on a target in its range (Deal 50% damage.) Crest of Knight buff gives guard skill, and LVx25 chance to counter-attack once per round for 50% damage.

name: Crest of Rook
title: Crest of Rook
description: Requires 5 Geomaterial. Create a magic sigil that enchant an ally within 5 range, granting them Crest of Rook for 5 rounds. If the target is one of your pawn Automatons, if you do not have a Rook automatons. They instead gain it permanently and are transformed into a Rook Automaton and gain 1 LV of Automaton energy. Trickery - Target also gains Swift Guard Lv30 until their next turn. Crest of Rook: LvX2 Earth ATK. When within 1 range of Status causer, intercept damage for them and gains Scaled WPN UP LV X ( 5xLV) for 2 rounds.

name: Form Pawn
title: Form Pawn
description: Requires 2 Geomaterial. Targets 2 unoccupied tiles within 3 range, and use the Geomaterial to create 2 Pawn Automatons at those locations. Pawn Automatons are not particularly strong, but they do not suffer from normal Servant Automaton restrictions. Cannot be used if you already had 3 or more Servant Automatons active.

name: Seal of Fortune
title: Seal of Fortune
description: Create a magic sigil that enchants an ally within five range. Granting them Seal of Fortunes for 5 rounds. Seal of Fortunes: Unit gains +(3 x number of Positive Mage And/or Ruler effects they have) FP regeneration. If a servant automaton, also generate 1 LV of Automaton energy at start of a new round.

name: Seal of Labors
title: Seal of Labor
description: Create a magic sigil that enchants an ally within 5 range, granting them Seal of Labors for 5 rounds. If the target is a Servant Automaton, they also recover HP equal to LV. Seal of Labor: When unit deals damage via basic attack, applies a vampiric effect equal to 5 + ( 2x number of positive mage and/or Ruler effects they have)%.

name: Cruel Enchant
title: Cruel Enchant
description: Whip Skill. Flows the arcane energy of Enchantment through your whip, delivering your support in rather violent fashion. Changes your Mage/Ruler enchant spells to target a 4 size diamond, allowing them to affect multiple allies at once, for 1 round. Allies other than yourself who receive that spell take kickback damage, as you whip them to cast it.

name: Dig Order
title: Dig Order
description: Exercise your Authority as Ruler and give the order to dig, which washes over all your other allies (Except Rulers), and confused enemies you have damaged this round. All affected units will Pillage the tile they are standing on, digging up rocks and other objects valid that can be refined. A unit charmed by the Ruler digs up 2 objects instead of 1. Enemies affected also are inflicted with Muddy for 2 rounds.

name: Heir of Gluttony
title: Heir of Gluttony
description: You're not a fan of big, rocky monsters. Maybe you're just an artist. Maybe you want to surround yourself with something soft and sweet. Changes your Servant Automatons into Sweet Automatons. Target 2 tiles within 6 range. One must have your sweet Automaton, and one must be monster enemy with Sweet Seduction LV5+. Attempt to convert Enemy (Sweet) it to your side; if successful, they are served a slice of Selected Automaton.

name: Promotion
title: Promotion
description: Requires 9 Geomaterial. Target 1 of your Pawn Automaton and puts it in Geostatis until its turn, granting it 2 LVs of Automaton Energy and transform it into a Queen Automaton. Cannot be used while you already have a Queen Automaton.

name: Reliable Counsel
title: Reliable Counsel
description: Sometimes one need a second opinion to sort through any matters they find confusing. Targets one other allied unit in 5 range, and cures both the ruler and target of any non-permanent confusion effect and grants both confusion immunity for 3 rounds. Trickery - Automatically apply a mage defensive spell to the target that you have equipped for free (Preference to spells the target does not have effect of.)

name: Ruler's Carriage
title: Ruler's Carriage
description: Whip skill. Location 1 must be within 3 range, and contain a different allied unit that can move, and location 2 must be an unoccupied tile within 9 range. You whip that ally, and pull yourself to them dealing some kickback damage to them. Afterwards, they carry you up to X steps (based on rank) toward Location 2, and then set you down on an unoccupied tile within 1 range. If no such tiles exist, all enemies within 1 range are knocked back 3 tiles, and you are Knocked Down.

name: Enhanced Enchantcraft
title: Enhanced Enchantcraft
description: The Ruler has studied the basics time and time again, letting their mage enchantment effects become a little more potent. Enhances your mage base class enchant spells. When removed before expiring, they create a 2-range magic burst. Deals (LV x 10) armor-ignoring bonus magic damage. Furthermore, if defensive category, casting it on a single target increases its LV by 2.

name: Primal Ruler
title: Primal Ruler
description: Piece Style Skill. Changes the appearance (But not the skills, etc) of your Servant Automatons to be more akin to Golems rather than chess piece statues. This does not take up a skill pool slot.

name: Arcane Whip
title: Arcane Whip
description: The sign of a Ruler's power is their scourge, and as a being of Arcane skill. It would be nice to show that power, be it through a horse-driver or a cat's string toy. Allows you to use any whip weapon as a casting tool (Tome-whip are exempted as they're already tomes.)

name: Patient Scourge
title: Patient Scourge
description: Most terrifying is not the ruler quickest to lash out, but the one who strikes hardest. Casting a mage/ruler enchant spell grants or power up Patient scourge LV10 (Max Lv50 for 5 Rounds. Patient scourge boosts the damage, and critical of your next whip basic attack and is consumed on hit.

name: Ruler's Geocraft
title: Ruler's Geocraft
description: Rulers utilize a special resource called Geomaterial for some of their skills. They can have a maximum of 9 Geomaterials stored at once, and begin battle with 3 geomaterial plus per Geoheart enchantment they have on equipped items. When they score a critical hit with a Whip Weapon, they gain 1 Geomaterial.

name: Ruler's Reign
title: Ruler's Reign
description: True Rulers know how to assert their station, using it both as a shield and as a sword. Increase damage dealt to and reduce damage taken by Subservient enemies (Non-boss enemies, Curate/Soldiers, Pack Follower/Little Cheese) by 7% each. if Ruler is both your main class and sub-class, this is doubled. And all enemies except other Rulers are treated as subservient. In addition, increases your skill pool size by 0.5 for every enchant-class spell you have equipped.

name: Anchor Rune
title: Anchor Rune
description:
Engrave: Attempts to inflict the target with Immobilize until your next turn. (Cooldown 1 turn longer when used this way)

Trigger: Attempts to inflict Immobilize on all enemies within effective range for 2 rounds.

Allies within the effective range of this rune are immune to most push and pull effects.

name: Chilling Rune
title: Chilling Rune
description:
Placed: Covers tiles in effective range (+1) in Ice Sheets for 2 rounds.

Triggered: Covers tiles in effective range in Ice Sheets for 3 rounds. Enemies in those tiles may be inflicted with Frostbite LV X for 3 rounds. (X = Rune Level * 3)

Engrave: Attempts to inflict Frostbite LV X (X = Rank * 5) for 3 rounds.

name: Chronos Rune
title: Chronos Rune
description:
Linked Runes do not trigger normally. Rune Level increased by Chronos count. When Chronos count is 4, effective range is increased by 3.

Engrave: Attempts to inflict the target with Slow LV X (X = Rank) for 2 rounds.

Resonate: Increased Chronos count by 1 if not at 4. If it was at 4, the rune will trigger, unless a Null rune was linked with it.

name: Destruction Rune
title: Destruction Rune
description:
Placed: Destroys enemy-created special effect tiles with a Hardiness of 1 or less in it's effective range (+1).

Linked runes that deal damage have +30% increased damage.

name: Elemental Rune
title: Elemental Rune
power: 100% Scaled Weapon Attack (+100% Elemental attack based on tome)
description:
Engrave: Deals elemental magic damage to the target.

Triggered: Deals elemental magic damage to enemies in range, increasing with Rune Level.

Damage dealt is based on your currently tome (Or fire, by default),(100% of SWA + 100% Elemental Attack).

name: Haste Rune
title: Haste Rune
description:
Resonate: All allies in X range gain +2 Move for 1 round.

Engrave: Target Ally gains + Rank Move until your next turn.

Linked Runes that deal damage are given Great Accuracy.

name: Illuminated Rune
title: Illuminated Rune
description:
Resonate: Attempts to inflict all enemies within effective range (+1) with Glowing LV X for two rounds.(X = Rank * Rune Level)

Engrave: Attempts to inflict the target with Glowing LV X for 2 rounds. (X = Rank * 5)

Trigger: Attempts to inflict Glowing LV X on all enemies in effective range for Y rounds. (X = same as Resonate LV, Y = higher of 3 or 1 + half the rune level)

name: Magnet Rune
title: Magnet Rune
description:
Placed: If any Runes that can be linked are within 3 Range, draws them in and links them. (Only triggers on move effects once.)

Resonate: Moves towards the nearest enemy.

Engrave: Attempts to inflict Magnetize LV X (X = Rank * 5) for 2 rounds.

Trigger: Attempts to inflict enemies in effective range with Magnetize LV X (X= Rune Level * (Rank * 2)) for higher of 3 or 1 + Rune Level/2 rounds.

name: Null Rune
title: Null Rune
description:
Engrave: Status infliction based chance to dispel 1 buff from the target.

Linked Runes will not be triggered.

name: Razor Rune
title: Razor Rune
description:
Resonate/Trigger: Deals X Slash magic damage to all enemies in effective range (+1), which ignores armour. (X = 5 * Rune Level)

Engrave: Deals Slash magic damage to the target.

Resonate effect will trigger every time the Rune moves.

name: Smoking Rune
title: Smoking Rune
description:
Placed: Creates Smokescreen tiles LV X for 2 rounds in effective range (+1) if none exist. (LV = Rank x 3 + Rune Level).

Engrave: Attempts to inflict the target with Blind for 2 rounds.

Trigger: Attempts to inflict Blind for (1 + half of Rune Level) rounds to all enemies in effective range.

name: Warding Rune
title: Warding Rune
description:
Place/Resonate: Creates stone pillars on certain tiles without units on them for 1 round within it's effective range (Max range: 4). At Rune Level 2 or higher, the tiles are not created in the same column as the rune.

Engrave: Knocks the target back in the direction they're facing X times. (X = Rank).

name: All Rush
title: All Rush
description:
By snapping your fingers, you command all of your active Runes to fly forward 5 tiles. Moving this way can cause the rune to link with other runes, as well as trigger on enemies in it's effective range.

Deals 10 damage to the rune after forcing it to move.

name: All Turn
title: All Turn
description: With a wave of your finger, you point at a location within 6 range. All of your active Runes turn to face that location.

name: Designia: Alpha
title: Designia: Alpha
description:
The Rune Magician follows through on simple pre-planned patterns at a target location within 5 Range, using equipped Rune spells in order at that location. These uses all require the proper FP cost, use the appropriate amount of Momentum, and so on - this simply serves as a quick 'shortcut' method. The effect will continue until you have 1 Momentum left, or when no more Rune spells can be used.

Order: Same order as Rune spells equipped.

name: Focus Tuning
title: Focus Tuning
description: Send out a pulse of focus that merges with your Runes. All your currently active Runes trigger their Resonate effects.

name: Solo Rush
title: Solo Rush
description:
You snap your fingers, causing a target Rune within 7 Range to fly forward in it's current direction up to 5 tiles. Moving this way can cause the rune to link up with other runes, as well as trigger on enemies in it's effective range.

Deals 10 damage to the rune after forcing it to move.

name: Solo Turn
title: Solo Turn
description: Targets two locations. Location 1 must contain one of your Runes. When used, the selected rune will turn to face Location 2.

name: Swift Rune Crafting
title: Swift Rune Crafting
description: Accelerates your movements, allowing you to quickly set the stage. For one round, your Rune spells cost 1 Momentum less. (To a minimum of 1.)

name: Arcanum: Rune
title: Arcanum: Rune
extras: Reduces Skill Pool cost of Rune spells to 0.5
description: Rune Magicians are masters of runes, essentially arcane writings and patterns that can evoke predictable magic spells and effects. Runes can have a variety of effects; Placed effects activate when the rune is created on the battlefield. Resonate effects activate around the Rune at the start of a new round. Trigger effects activate when an enemy steps into the effective range of a Rune. Engrave effects activate if the Rune spell targets a unit instead of a location.

name: Salvage Rune
title: Salvage Rune
description: Letting no rune go to waste, you quickly recover them if they're left unused. At the end of a battle, for every Rune left untriggered, you recover FP equal to 10 times it's rune level, effectively refunding the cost.

name: Sturdy Rune
title: Sturdy Rune
extras: +10 (+20 if your Main and Sub Class are both Rune Magician)
description:
Having refined your rune crafting skills, your runes are sturdier than normal, granting them +10 HP (Or +20 HP if both your Main and Sub Class are both Rune Magician)

Runes start with 10 HP and each attack on them takes away 10 HP.

name: Chaos Onslaught
title: Chaos Onslaught
description:
Costs 1% of your maximum HP. Can only be used if you are Installed with a Youkai. Burst a target within 5 Range with a strange energy, dealing magic damage to them (based on Rank; any weapon can use this skill) based on the element of the installed Youkai, which can critically hit. If it does, it triggers Bloody Shift.

Damage is dealt in a number of hits equal to 1 + 1 per Grow Appendage.

name: Shift Strike
title: Shift Strike
description:
Costs 1% of your maximum HP. Can only be used if you are Installed with a Youkai. Making use of your shifted form, you perform a basic attack with a weapon unique to your Installed Youkai, which gains bonus Critical (based on Rank).

The special weapon's scaling tags are identical to your main hand weapon's, but it may have unique effects.

name: Grow Appendage
title: Grow Appendage
description:
Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, and can only be used if you are Installed with a Youkai. You gain an appendage of your installed Youkai's race, which can give a variety of benefits, and extends all other effects from Grow Appendage by 1 round (2 if monoclassing). The effect's duration varies based on Rank.

If Bloody Shift was triggered this round, this skill costs 1 less Momentum to use.

name: Chimera Install
title: Chimera Install
description: Can only be used if you are Installed with a Youkai. Targets 1 of your summoned Youkai (who is not Installed with a Youkai) within 5 Range and installs them with your Installed Youkai, restoring their HP by X% of their maximum HP (based on Rank) and giving them Chimera Install for 5 rounds. You gain Lockout for the Youkai you transferred for 3 rounds, which prevents you from summoning them.

name: Meld Form
title: Meld Form
description: Costs 5% of your maximum HP. Targets one of your summoned Youkai at a tile within 5 Range. You merge your form with theirs, teleporting to that tile, unsummoning the Youkai, triggering Chaotic Form with them, and gaining any beneficial status effects they have (excluding those you have).

name: Split Form
title: Split Form
description: Costs 5% of your maximum HP, and can only be used while Installed with a Youkai. Split your installed Youkai from you and summon them to a target unoccupied location within X Range (based on Rank), increasing their Momentum to 3 (if possible). The split also causes your copiable, non-permanent beneficial status effects to have their duration halved, but the split Youkai will receive all of them as well.

name: Avian Glide
title: Avian Glide
description: Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Avian race. Quickly adjust the wind near you to become Airborne and glide in a 2 Range line (the last tile must be unoccupied).

name: Beast Gait
title: Beast Gait
description: Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Beast race. Move in an agile fashion along a darting line; all tiles in the way must be unoccupied.

name: Dragon Strength
title: Dragon Strength
description: Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Dragon race. Infuse yourself with a divine Draconic energy, increasing your Critical by 15 and Critical Damage by 15% for 2 rounds.

name: Fairy Trick
title: Fairy Trick
description: Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Fairy race. Hide you and target Ally within 6 Range with fairy dust. When the dust clears, the two of you will have swapped locations.

name: Mystic Magic
title: Mystic Magic
description: Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Mystic race. Channel ancient arcane mysteries to boost the Scaled Weapon Attack of your next Offensive category Spell (or Youkai Evoke Spell) by 30 (expires afterwards, 5 rounds duration).

name: Night Shade
title: Night Shade
description: Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Night race. You and all other Night allies coat yourselves in a veil of darkness, increasing your Evade by 25 for 2 attacks, 5 rounds. For each other ally affected, the number of attacks the effect lasts for increases by 1.

name: Plant Rejuvenate
title: Plant Rejuvenate
description: Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Plant race. Use the focus around you to trigger a rapid regeneration, healing you for 2% of your maximum HP and reducing the duration of a random negative status effect caused by an enemy by 2 rounds. If no such effects exist, the HP recovery is doubled instead.

name: Alteration Fixation
title: Alteration Fixation
description:
Your interest in changing things, namely yourself, leads you to perfect the art as much as you can.

Transformation effects (including Install) have increased duration based on Rank.

name: Bloody Shift
title: Bloody Shift
description:
Take the lead by going for full offense, regardless of the cost.

Upon scoring a critical hit with a basic attack, you gain Bloody Shift for 1 round. Bloody Shift decreases the Momentum cost of Youkai Evoke skills by 1, but makes them cost 1% of your maximum HP when used. (This effect does not stack.)

name: Chaotic Form
title: Chaotic Form
description: Shapeshifting is a dangerous art, but the one the Shapeshifter is known for. Requires Install to be in your skill pool. After you use the Evoke skill of a Youkai you do not have Installed, you Install them (any active Install effects will be replaced). Secondly, while you have a Youkai Installed, your form changes to match theirs.

name: Dripping Dimension
title: Dripping Dimension
description:
Your chaotic installing causes even the environment to change.

Triggering Chaotic Form will cause you to create a special effect tile at all tiles within 1 Range of you for 2 rounds (LV X, based on Rank), based on the element of the Youkai that was just Installed (only applies at the time you are Installed).

name: Mirror Mimickry
title: Mirror Mimickry
description: When using Split Form, effects gained by Mimickry skills are not halved in duration.

name: Normalize Form
title: Normalize Form
description: Regaining your physical senses can lead to a more stable body, but it makes you more predictable. At the start of a new round, if Chaos Reflex is active, its LV will be reduced by 8, and you will recover 1% of your maximum HP.

name: Preservation Instinct
title: Preservation Instinct
description:
You are skilled at avoiding the risks involved with this dangerous art.

HP costs associated with Shapeshifter skills and effects are halved. If Shapeshifter is both your Main Class and Sub Class, they are instead negated. (Has no effect when used with Self-Destructive Shifting.)

name: Self-Destructive Shifting
title: Self-Destructive Shifting
description:
Who cares about consequences?

HP costs associated with Shapeshifter skills and effects are increased by 50%, but their cool downs are decreased by 1 round. If Shapeshifter is both your Main Class and Sub Class, HP costs are instead increased by 100%, and their cool downs are instead decreased by 2 rounds.

name: Vague Shift
title: Vague Shift
description: Does not cost SP to equip. While equipped, Chaotic Form will not change your appearance.

name: Chaos Reflex
title: Chaos Reflex
description:
Constant shifting makes your form hard to predict, and when you're hard to predict, you're hard to hit.

When you trigger Chaotic Form, you gain or power up a status called Chaos Reflex LV 8 for 3 rounds (Max LV based on Rank/5 rounds max). Chaos Reflex increases your Evade by LV, but will end at the start of a round you are not Installed with a Youkai.

name: Install Element Boost
title: Install Element Boost
description: Natural affinity with your Youkai increases your elemental powers. When installed with a Youkai, increases the Elemental ATK of the element associated with that Youkai by X (based on Rank).

name: Natural Evoke
title: Natural Evoke
description: Honestly, if it didn't get any easier like this, you'd be worried. Reduces the FP cost of evoke skills of your currently installed youkai based on rank.

name: Akihono Tobitoro
title: Akihono Tobitoro
power: 80%/90%/100% Fire ATK, 100% Scaled WPN ATK, LV: 5/9/13
description:
Ninjutsu. Throw flaming shuriken at a 2 Zie Crescent up to 4 Range away, dealing fire magic damage that can critically hit (25% damage) over 2 hits. Damaged enemies may be inflicted with Lingering Damage (Fire) (2 Rounds), or Burn instead (if critically hit). Size, total hits and status LV increase based on total Shuriken equipped (+1, +1, +3 respectively)

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Fire Mark

name: Arashi Sanseiken
title: Arashi Sanseiken
description:
Ninjutsu. Targets all enemies in a 3 Size Diamond (+1 Size per 25 Ice ATK, max 5) around you, increasing your aerodynamic qualities with ki for an instant. Teleport next to each enemy you can and slash with a gusting blade, dealing Wind magic damage.

Trickery: If you have Kagebunshin active, each time before you teleport, you leave behind a Kagebunshin.

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Wind Mark.

name: Bone Breaker
title: Bone Breaker
description:
Kenpo. Targets 1 Knocked Down or Grappled (by you) enemy in 1 Range. Perform a painful joint strike, dealing evasion-ignoring Blunt damage. If target is Knocked Down, inflicts Cripple Leg (LV X, 2 rounds). If Grappled, inflicts Cripple Arm (LV X, 2 rounds). Regardless, they're cured of the effect (except non-boss monster or summoned units).

Shukuchi: Range increases by its LV and teleports you next to the target.

name: Habari Tori
title: Habari Tori
description: Kenpo. Become airborne and burst forward in a 4 Size line (+1 under Shukuchi), using your knee, spear or shuriken as a bird's beak. The first enemy you encounter takes weapon-based damage. If that enemy was Airborne, they can be critically hit and are inflicted with Spinning (as an Airborne substatus). Otherwise, they are knocked Airborne.

name: Hyakuhachi Rengeki
title: Hyakuhachi Rengeki
description: Kenpo. An unrelenting flash of swift attacks on an enemy within 1 Range, dealing your wepano's damage type over a barrage of 8 hits. If any hit, the target is inflicted with Critical Evade Down LV X (X = Hits x 2) until your next turn.

name: Kan Saiganki
title: Kan Saiganki
description:
Ninjutsu. Focus your ki into your arms and swipe in a direction, creating a piercing projectile of sharp dust that travels 5 steps away (+1 per 25 Wind ATK, max 7). Enemies the projectile passes over take magic damage (weapon based + Earth). Empty tiles the projectile passes over will spawn attackable Rock Pillars (2 Rounds).

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Mountain Mark

name: Kokuhaku Kagedan
title: Kokuhaku Kagedan
power: 100%/110%/120% Fire ATK, 100% Scaled WPN ATK, LV: 4/7/10
description:
Ninjutsu. Conjure ki explosions near all enemies in a 3 Size Diamond (+1 Size per 25 Light ATK, max 5). They explode in a bright flash, dealing Fire magic damage and may inflict Glowing (LV X, 2 rounds). After, shadows of those enemies dance and attack enemies not hit by the fire (in skill Range around them), dealing Dark magic damage and may inflict Blind (2 Rounds).

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Fire Mark.

name: Ryumai Suikan
title: Ryumai Suikan
power: 100%/110%/120% Water ATK, 100% Scaled WPN ATK, LV: 4/7/10
description:
Ninjutsu. Targets 1 empty tile in 3 Range (6 if on water), vanish into the ground like mist, and reappear at it. After, water pillars damage enemies in a 3 Size Diamond (+1 Size per 25 Lightning ATK, max 5), knocks them Airborne, may inflict Soaked (3 rounds), and leave Flooded Water (3 rounds, in 1 range). If you teleported onto water, gain Ryumai Suikan LV X (3 rounds, +1 per 25 Water ATK, max 5).

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Forest Mark

name: Ryusei Ryugeki
title: Ryusei Ryugeki
description:
Kenpo. Targets 1 Airborne enemy in 1 Range and slams them to the ground with the force of a dragon, dealing weapon-based damage. If you Grappled the target, gains Great Accuracy. If the target was Spinning, can critically hit.

If you have at least 50 Scaled STR, the impact creates a shockwave that deals Earth damage to enemies and field objects in 3 Range. If you have at least 50 Scaled GUI, the target may be Knocked Down.

name: Slash Moon
title: Slash Moon
description: Kenpo. Create a circular cut in the shape of the moon, dealing Slash damage to all enemies in a 2 Size Circle around you. If you are Airborne you can target a unoccupied tile up to 3 Range away and teleport to it before performing the attack.

name: Kagebunshin
title: Kagebunshin
description:
Genpo skill. You manipulate your shadow and create a Kagebunshin at your current location, gain Sneak (2 rounds), and then swiftly dash towards another unoccupied tile within 5 range in a flexible line.

Kagebunshin: Kagebunshin are shadow clones of the user. They are illusion units, but do not receive turns, and will fade away at the start of the cloned unit's next turn (unless otherwise stated). Primarily, they are used as decoys.

If an enemy within 2 Range of a Kagebunshin defeats it, and you have the Evasive Strike skill equipped, that enemy will receive its damage.

name: Kiomite Moriomizu
title: Kiomite Moriomizu
description:
Ninjutsu. Targets 1 tile containing a non-dense plant and teleports to it, then cloak yourself in ki-fueled camouflage, blending in with your surroundings, giving yourself Kiomite Moriomizu (LV X, 3 rounds, +1 per 25 Earth ATK, max 5 rounds).

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Mountain Mark.

name: Usuake
title: Usuake
description:
Genpo skill. Give life to the shadows, investing uncertainty in the mind of 1 enemy within 3 Range, attempting to inflict them with Usuake (LV X, 3 rounds, +1 per 25 Dark ATK, max 5), which can critically hit; if it does, they are also inflicted with Confusion (2 Rounds)

Standing in Darkness doubles the Range. LV is doubled against non-boss monsters.

name: Kaicho Kaisu
title: Kaicho Kaisu
description:
Ninjutsu. Requires you to be standing on a Flooded Water or Dark Water tile, and targets 1 ally within 5 Range. This ninjutsu will conver all of those tiles within 2 Range around you into a healing aura, restoring the targets' HP by (Rank x 25) + (Rank x tiles absorbed), and grants them HP Regeneration LV X (X = 10 x tiles absorbed, 2 rounds).

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Forest Mark.

name: Mahi no Miwaku
title: Mahi no Miwaku
description:
Genpo skill. Cannot be used while Blind. Targets 1 unit within 3 Range. A type of trance induced through ki transfer via the user's eyes, it can cause paralysis of body and mind.

Allies gain Jine Ippo (5 rounds). Enemies may be inflicted with Mahi no Miwaku (LV x 2, 2 rounds), which can critically hit; if it does, they are also immobilized (2 rounds, or until your next turn for player characters).

name: Invoke Elemental Art
title: Invoke Elemental Art
description:
Perform hand signs rapidly a number of times equal to Rank (up to a max of 4 - current elemental marks), gaining an elemental mark of your choice each time, and gaining Enhanced Art (1 round). Afterwards, if you have 4 elemental marks, you will invoke an Elemental Art.

If you have a Lossened Body, this skill costs 1M less.

name: Sensui Shippu
title: Sensui Shippu
description:
Ninjutsu. Evoke the powerful gusts of a protective whilrwind conjured by ninjutsu, which creates a Sensui Shippu at your current location (Rank based LV, 2 rounds, can only have 1 active). All enemies within 2 Range are also knocked back 2 tiles by the conjuring force.

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Wind Mark.

name: Shinobi Step
title: Shinobi Step
description:
The shinobi is adept at moving as swiftly as the wind. Targets 1 onuccupied tile within 3 Range and quickly teleports to it.

If you are not wearing Heavy Armor: +2 Range while on a Nest, +1 Range under Shukuchi, and +1 Range and -1 Momentum if monoclassing Shinobi.

If you are in a Nest, and step into another Nest, recover 1M.

name: Swift Grab
title: Swift Grab
description:
As a master of speed and hand to hand combat, the shinobi is quite effective at grappling.

Targets 1 enemy within 1 range and applies the Grapple skill to them (no bonus effects). If you are in the tile behind the target, the Grapple success rate increases by 25%

name: Assassination Art
title: Assassination Art
description:
Specializing in striking targets before they know what hit them is the shinobi way.

On Battle Start: If your party back attacked the enemy, all enemies take protection-ignoring damage equal to your Shinobi class level. (Only the highest Assassination Art takes effect, but all other units with the same skill increase the damage by 10. Damage dealt this way cannot defeat enemies.)

name: False Target
title: False Target
description:
Parry skill. If you can use movement skills, at a chance of 25% + (higher of 25% CEL & 50% DEF) + 15% (if enemy is under your Genpo), you can parry incoming physical damage (35% reduction).

Once per round, when this triggers, you teleport to an empty tile within 3 Range (except in 1 Range of an enemy) and leave behind a Ninja Trick.

name: Furinkazan
title: Furinkazan
description:
Toggle Skill. While on, the shinobi can gain elemental marks; Fire, Forest, Mountain, and Wind. A maximum of 4 total marks, and 2 of each type, can be accumulkated by utilizing various Shinobi skills. Once 4 marks have been acquired, an Elemental Art based on the combination of marks automatically activates (no marks can be gained during this round after).

Marks can be gained by casting spells gained via Scrolls; the type gained depends on the spell's domain.

name: Hand Signs
title: Hand Signs
description:
One of the shinobi's hidden arts. Using hand signs and ki, the Shinobi can sidestep the need for verbal components. As long as they aren't immobilized and have at least 40 CEL, they can cast Spells (excluding invocations) and Ninjutsu even while Silenced.

Additionally, Shinobi can utilize fist weapons as casting tools.

name: Kenpo Master
title: Kenpo Master
description:
The shinobi is a master of unarmed combat, capable of flowing one blow into another like droplets of rain forming a stream.

Allows your Shinobi class Knepo skills, and Martial Artist base class Offensive skills to build and utilize Combination Fighter.

name: Concealed Weapon
title: Concealed Weapon
description:
The unseen blade is the deadliest.

When attacking with Small size weapons, the Shinobi has +5 Hit and +5 Critical.

name: Formless Form
title: Formless Form
description:
The shinobi is a shadow; a shape without form, ever changing and ever moving.

The Shinobi has 10% FP Efficency for any movement skill. They also passively gain 10% Status Resistance versus Immobilize, Frozen and Slow effects.

name: Gear Mastery
title: Gear Mastery
description:
Because of the circumstances, limitations, and available resources for any mission are wildly different, Shinobi are trained in the use of a variety of tools.

As such, item-based skills (such as bombs), most damaging skills give nby their equipment (except basic attacks), and Item Potentials gain a damage bonus when used by them. This bonus is also applied to the EXP gained towards Item Potentials.

name: Shuriken Wrap
title: Shuriken Wrap
description:
A shuriken wrap, when unrolled, allows a shinobi quick access to a valuable throwing weapon.

For Shinobi skills and Ninjutsu subtalents that can use a Shuriken, if no other valid item is equipped, a Shuriken in the Item Belt can also be used instead (if possible). Additionally, Shuriken in the Item Belt also count for Shinobi effects that care about the number of them equipped.

name: Chariot Star
title: Chariot Star
description:
Targets a 3-5 Size Line in front of you. You create a shield of light in front of you and fly forward in that line. The first enemy you encounter slams into the shield and is pushed along with you the rest of the distance, taking damage once the flight is over.

If you have the following effects active, gain bonuses: Charge gives +2 Max Range. Holy Shield cause Guard Break. Holy Aura increases damage dealt by 15%, knocks the enemy back 2 tiles and makes them Airborne.

name: Godray Undertow
title: Godray Undertow
description:
Targets a 5 Size Line in front of you. You quickly dash through those tiles until you encounter an enemy in the tile you are facing. That enemy takes weapon-based damage and is knocked Airborne.

Holy Aura increases the amount of tiles you move by 2, and will cause the skill to check all tiles within 1 Range of you every step for an enemy, instead of just the tile you are facing. (Applies even if you gain Holy Aura mid-attack.)

name: Light On High
title: Light On High
description:
Targets an unoccupied tile within 5 Range. Rise like the sun, flying towards the target tile, then slam a hammer of light into the ground, causing all enemies within 1 Range to take Blunt/Light damage.

Airborne enemies may be inflicted with Knocked Down. Otherwise, they are knocked Airborne.

If you have Holy Aura, airborne enemies are always Knocked Down, and their Light Resistance is lowered by 15% for 2 Rounds.

name: Luminous Arc
title: Luminous Arc
description:
Focus light into your casting tool and release it in an arc-shaped projectile, which travels in a line up to 6 tiles away. If it encounters your Solsphere, the projectile becomes enhanced.

Enemies hit by the projectile take Light magic damage. If enchaned, it explodes into a 3 Size Circle when it ends, dealing its damage to all enemies in that area (only once). If you have Holy Aura, the projectile also creates Light Shafts for 2 Rounds.

name: Lux Relido
title: Lux Relido
description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation.

Targets a tile up to 8 Range away and fires a swift, destructive thread of light through it, in a flexible line. All enemies in the path of the beam take Light magic damage with Great Accuracy, and special effect tiles are razed. Critically hits against Glowing enemies for 25% extra damage.

name: Photon Ring
title: Photon Ring
description:
Requires 1 Solcharge. Targets 2 tiles in 6 Range. Location 1 must have an enemy, Location 2 can be any other tile.

Creates a circle of light that wraps around the enemy in L1, dealing Light magic damage, and pulls them 3 tiles towards L2. If the target's Scaled STR is higher than your Scaled WIL, they resist the pull, reducing it by 1 tile.

name: Radiant Surrender
title: Radiant Surrender
description:
Must target your Solsphere within 6 Range, releasing its magic and causing it to end, creating a destructive wave of energy.

In a 3 Size Circle around it, creates special effect tiles (based on elemental, Light Shafts by default, 2 rounds) with a LV of 15 and deals Light magic damage to enemies. If the Solsphere was enhanced, +2 Circle Size and +25% damage dealt. If you are within its effective range, you gain Holy Aura.

name: Rising Dawn
title: Rising Dawn
description:
Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and performs a rising basic attack on them (with increased damage), which makes you become Airborne. If the target is Airborne, you will quickly rise to the tile opposite of them (if a valid battle tile), otherwise they will become Airborne.

If Holy Aura is active, this attack cannot be parried and does not trigger 'On Attacked' effects.

name: Sapping Sol
title: Sapping Sol
description:
Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range, which is Knocked Down or Grappled by you. You lift the target and pull divine energy from their body.

This ends those conditions, but you deal armor-ignoring Light magic damage to the target, and gain Solcharges (based on Rank.)

name: Blazing Sol
title: Blazing Sol
description:
Requires at least 2 Solcharges (but does not consume them). Infuse yourself with divine might, gaining Blazing Sol for X rounds. (X = 1 per 2 Solcharges when used.)

Requires 15 FP per round to maintain. You can reactivate this skill to end the effect for free. When Blazing Sol ends, you lose all Solcharges and this skill enters a 5 round CD.

+3 to all stats and gain Holy Aura at the start of a new round. Cannot gain or lose Solcharges. Drains 15 FP every round.

name: Holy Shield
title: Holy Shield
description:
Requires 2 Solcharges. Targets 1 allied unit within 5 Range.

Utilize the magic of the Solcharges to manifest or enchant a shield of light around the target's arm, giving them the radiance of a Holy Shield for 5 rounds.

name: Holy Wings
title: Holy Wings
description:
Requires 2 Solcharges. Targets 1 allied unit within 5 Range.

Utilize the magic of the Solcharges to manifest or develop angelic feathers, giving them the splendor of Holy Wings for 5 rounds.

name: Holy Sword
title: Holy Sword
description:
Requires 2 Solcharges. Targets 1 allied unit within 5 Range.

Utilize the magic of the Solcharges to bless the target's weapon, giving them the divinity of a Holy Sword for 5 rounds.

name: Radiant Solace
title: Radiant Solace
description:
Requires 3 Solcharges. Must target your Solsphere within 6 Range, releasing its magic and causing it to end, creating a wave of healing energy.

Restores the HP of all allies within 5 Range of the Solsphere based on Light ATK; half is applied as healing, and the other half as an HP Regeneration effect (over 2 rounds). +50% Range and Heal if the Solsphere was enhanced. If you are healed by this, you gain Holy Aura.

name: Day Shift
title: Day Shift
extras: Does not require a Skill Pool slot.
description:
Requires 1 Solcharge. Targets 2 locations within 6 Range

Location 1 must have your Solsphere, and Location 2 must be an unoccupied tile. Utilize the magic stored in the Solcharge to instantly teleport the Solsphere into Location 2.

name: Radiant Splendor
title: Radiant Splendor
description:
Requires 3 Solcharges. Must target your unenhanced Solsphere within 6 Range. Enhances the Solsphere, providing a variety of bonuses:

The enhancement will wear off after 5 rounds, reverting to a normal Solsphere.

name: Sol Charge
title: Sol Charge
description:
The Solblader utilizes the art of solmancy in a special way, focusing them into 'Solcharges', encapsuled fragments of light magic that they store in their weapons, which appear like miniature stars.

Allows you to gain Solcharges (max 6). Using this skill will convert the Momentum spent on it into an equal amount of Solcharges. Solcharges are used by Solblader skills and effects, but passively give +1 Light ATK per Solcharge.

name: Solsphere
title: Solsphere
description:
The blessed art of the Solblader. Targets 1 unoccupied tile within 3 Range and creates a sphere of light called a permanent Solsphere at it. You can only have 1 active at a time.

This is a special, sun-like field tile that is created by the Solblader class. Only 1 can be active at a time, it can't be destroyed, and its placement can't be stopped by effects like Priest's Sanctuary.

When you enter the same tile as your Solsphere, you gain Holy Aura until your next turn. When your Solsphere and an enemy encounter each other, they take armor-ignoring magic bonus Light damage equal to X + 50% of Light ATK (X = half of Solblader level). This can only occur once per action.

The Solsphere can be interacted with by many Soldier base class skills. If you target the Solsphere with one, the following effects will occur (this will apply even if an enemy and the Solsphere are in the same tile).

name: Star Parade
title: Star Parade
description:
Requires 3 Solcharges. Targets the tile in front of you, which must be unoccupied. Creates a Fading Solsphere at that location, which moves forward up to 3 tiles, activating if it encounters an enemy.

Fading Solspheres are the same as regular Solspheres, but last only the round they are created. You can have 1 Solsphere and 1 Fading Solsphere active at the same time.

name: Yester Shift
title: Yester Shift
extras: Does not require a Skill Pool slot.
description:
Requires 1 Solcharge. Must have a Solsphere active to use. Cannot be used if the tile you started the round on is the same tile you are on now.

Utilize the magic stored in the Solcharge to teleport your Solsphere into the tile you were in at the start of this round.

name: Divine Radiance
title: Divine Radiance
description:
The holy light cleanses all it touches.

While you have Holy Aura active, enemies you pass over take protection-ignoring Light magic bonus damage, based on Rank. (Only applies once per action, per enemy.)

name: Divine Spark
title: Divine Spark
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a SP slot.
description: While equipped, this skill changes all Solblader effects and skills that deal Light damage and scale with Light ATK to deal Lightning damage and scale with Lightning ATK respectively, and changes the appearance of the Solsphere.

name: Exceeding Sol
title: Exceeding Sol
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a SP slot.
description:
Toggle skill. Utilizes your Solcharges in destructive ways. While on, allows them to be consumed when you use a Soldier base class skill as if they were Weapon Charges for Excel Crash effects.

Weapon Charges will be prioritized and cannot be used with Solcharges. Skills enhanced by Solcharges gain Great Accuracy instead of being evasion ignoring.

name: Flash of Light
