title: Flash of Light
description:
Solblader Style skill (only 1 can be equipped, doesn't take up a skill pool slot). A spell and blade type of Solblading.

Passive: Soldier base class Offensive skills can use any weapon type. Soldier base class Offensive skills and weapon attack skills that target your Solsphere grant a stacking buff that reduces the Momentum cost of your next Mercalan domain spell by LV (max: 6). Holy Aura Bonus: +5 to all Elemental ATK and -15% FP cost for spells. Holy Aura Triggered: Recover 15 FP and deal protection-ignoring Light bonus magic damage to all enemies within 3 Range. The damage is equal to your Solblader level.

name: Speed of Light
title: Speed of Light
description:
Solblader Style skill (only 1 can be equipped, doesn't take up a skill pool slot). A quick and tricky type of Solblading.

Passive: Allows Solblader and Soldier Offensive skills (except spells) to utilize Combination Fighter, successively reducing Momentum costs but also damage for those skills. Holy Aura Bonus: Also increases your Evade by 15. Holy Aura Triggered: Immediately gain 1 stack of Combination Fighter (max 2).

name: Wall of Light
title: Wall of Light
description:
Solblader Style skill (only 1 can be equipped, doesn't take up a skill pool slot). A slow and sturdy type of Solblading.

Passive: Reduces the Range of Solblader Offensive skills that move you by 1 or 2 Range, but increases the damage they deal by 15%. Holy Aura Bonus: Also increases Armor and Magic Armor by 5. Your Protect skill gains +3 activation Range. Reduces redirected damage you take by 10%. Holy Aura Triggered: Gain Swift Guard LV 20 until your next turn.

name: Illuminating Sol
title: Illuminating Sol
description:
The light of divinity grants not only the sureness of one's steps, but the clarity of one's mind.

Passively increases FAI and GUI, based on Rank. If you are monoclassing Solblader, you start battles with Solcharges equal to Rank.

name: Unerring Light
title: Unerring Light
description:
The holy light pierces all it reaches.

While you have Holy Aura active, your Light damage pierces Absorb, Reflect, and Immunity affinities.

name: Unerring Light
title: Faithful Sol
description:
Solmancy and Solblading go hand in hand. A rather natural talent, only used by certain spellblading types.

Once per round, casting a Mercalan domain spell from a non-Solblader class, using Pray, or scoring a critical hit, automatically grants 1 Solcharge.

name: Execute
title: Execute
description: Can only target 1 enemy within 1 Range that is Knocked Down. Deals physical damage that ignores evasion to the target, increased by a percentage of their missing HP (max +100 damage), but cures their knockdown, making it a good idea to make sure they won't get back up after this blow.

name: Incise
title: Incise
description:
Sword or Dagger skill. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and deals Pierce physical damage to them, as well as inflicting Lingering Pierce Damage LV X (based on Rank) for 2 rounds. Daggers deal only 80% normal damage, but use 1 less Momentum, and cause the Lingering Damage's LV and duration to be increased by 50%.

If the target of this skill already has Lingering Pierce Damage, its duration will be reset and its LV will be increased by only 25% of the normal value.

name: Mad Chop
title: Mad Chop
description: Axe skill. Repeatedly smash your axe into a target in 1 Range, dealing Slash physical damage over several hits. The total damage is increased by 0.5% for every 1% of HP you are missing. (Can only be used once per round.)

name: Retreating Swipe
title: Retreating Swipe
description: Sword skill. A close range swipe as you fall back, dealing physical damage of your weapon's damage type to all enemies within 1 Range, except those behind you. Afterwards, if the tile directly behind you is unoccupied, you will jump backwards to it.

name: Roundtrip
title: Roundtrip
extras: Second hit pulls enemies towards you.
description: Axe skill. Throw your weapon in a line, dealing Slash physical damage to all affected. Then, the axe will return to you, dealing Slash physical damage again. (Half the damage is dealt on the first trip and the other half on the return trip)

name: Shinken
title: Shinken
description: Sword skill. Swipes your sword against the ground, creating a gust of sharp wind that will travel up to 5 tiles, starting behind the tile directly in front of you. If it hits an enemy, they take Slash physical damage. In addition, if there is an enemy directly in front of you in the direction you use this skill in, you will perform a basic attack on them. If no enemy is attacked, the projectile's base Range is doubled. (Bonus damage is given to both based on Rank.)

name: Thousand Stab
title: Thousand Stab
description: Spear skill. Pierce an enemy within 2 Range with a flurry of stabs, dealing Pierce physical damage, plus 100% of your Scaled STR. (Elementals may substitute STR for a different stat if it's higher.)

name: Turnover
title: Turnover
description: Spear skill. Stab your target, dealing Pierce physical damage, and slam them into the tile directly behind you. Turning enemies over onto battle field objects, such as rocks, may have bonus effects.

name: Enchant Shield
title: Enchant Shield
description:
Shield skill. Requires you to be enchanted with an elemental (item effects that treat you as if you were enchanted with one will not work). Transfers the elemental from you to your shield, ending the effect for you, but granting you an Elemental Shield for 3 rounds of the same element.

The elemental shield will grant resistance to the same element equal to X% (X = Rank*5) and will deal damage (ignores armor) to enemies who attack you or that you Bash equal to X. Guarding will double the elemental resistance and retaliation damage, but no effect is given when under Guard Break.

name: Protect
title: Protect
description: Shield skill. Allows you to take basic attacks (or skills that perform them) in the place of an ally within melee range. When you intercept an attack, you gain DEF (based on Rank) until your next turn. Can be toggled on and off.

name: Watchful Eye
title: Watchful Eye
description: Targets 1 enemy within 7 Range and focuses on them intently (you can only focus one target at a time with this skill) for 5 rounds, granting a bonus +5 Hit against them. When the target uses Movement or most movement skills, or damages you, you will follow and face them, preventing them from getting behind you. (Teleports are too fast to see. You must have a line of sight on the target to follow them. Does not function while Blinded.)

name: Bash
title: Bash
description: Knocks away an enemy or ally within 1 tile. Using this on an enemy while you are Charging will knock back more and make you follow the target.

name: Charge
title: Charge
description:
Gather your energy in a charge, which boosts your Move based on rank for 1 turn. If you use Movement and are not within 3 Range of an enemy, the effect ends and this skill is put on a 3 Round cooldown. Ends similar movement effects from class skills.

If you Bash an enemy while under the effect of Charge, you will move along with that enemy in a line, pushing them away and pinning yourself against them in the same motion. (The Bash Charge Distance and the Move Bonus are the same.)

name: Charging Strike
title: Charging Strike
description: Learning to put your momentum behind an attack can have impressive results. When you use Charge and Movement during the same round, in that order, your next basic attack with a melee weapon, or your next Soldier Offensive skill, will end Charge's effect, but deal bonus damage based on Rank, and may have an additional effect.

name: Flatfoot
title: Flatfoot
description:
A true Soldier knows that there's more to combat than just hitting your opponent until they stop moving, even though that's a big part of it. You need to use tactics, use terrain and your non-weapon body parts to create openings to hit your opponent, because they sure aren't going to do it for you.

When you use Bash on an enemy, infict the enemy with LV1 Flatfoot (-5 evade -1 move) until the start of their next turn. If you are charge bashing, there is a 50% chance to knock them down instead.

name: Weapon Discipline
title: Weapon Discipline
description: When you're trained to use weapons, and then trained to repair those weapons, you get a feel for using it in a way that won't damage it nearly as much. Reduces the durability cost of using weapons, skills, and casting spells by a percentage, based on Rank.

name: Bulwark
title: Bulwark
description: One of the most basic combat rules is 'always have your shield up', and true Soldiers follow this discipline religiously. When you have a shield equipped, all damage you take from enemies you are facing is reduced by 15%.

name: Fortitude
title: Fortitude
description: A life on the front-line offers some benefits, namely that you learn how to stay alive longer on them. Increases your maximum HP.

name: Tenacity
title: Tenacity
description: A type of physical stamina that works well in long, drawn-out battles. You regain HP every round.

name: Final Flare
title: Final Flare
description:
Dagger skill. Must have at least one non-Invocation Copy spell. Loads up your dagger with magical energy for 3 rounds. The next target you hit with a basic attack deals no damage, but instead releases up to Rank Copy Spells (excluding Invocations) on the target randomly. Spells cast this way deal only 75% damage and are lost after being cast (until the end of the battle).

After the magical energy is expended, or time runs out, your dagger explodes, reducing its durability to 0, knocking you back from the target by 7 tiles and knocking you down.

name: Flying Dagger
title: Flying Dagger
description: Dagger skill. Throw a barrage of daggers in a line, which will travel up to 3+Rank tiles away and inflict unresistable Piercing damage to the first enemy hit equal to Dagger Power + Rank. Can only be used once per turn.

name: Goose Bite
title: Goose Bite
description: Dagger skill. Dig your dagger into an enemy within 1 Range, dealing unresistable Pierce damage equal to Rank + Weapon Power. Afterwards, if you are behind the target, they suffer -X (X = Rank) to all stats for 3 rounds. (If you are not behind them, they suffer half of that instead.)

name: Hot Potato
title: Hot Potato
description: Requires you to have Final Flare active. Unequips your dagger and tosses it to a nearby location up to X (based on Rank) Range away. At the start of the next round, it will explode, treating all units (friend or foe) as if they were hit by Final Flare (however spells cast do only 50% damage instead of 75%). Enemies who step onto the same location as the dagger will kick it 5 tiles away in the direction they are moving.

name: Mystic Dagger
title: Mystic Dagger
description: Attack an enemy within 1 Range with your dagger, dealing magic damage. If it misses, it will mystically attack again, dealing reduced damage, based on Rank.

name: Snatch Spell
title: Snatch Spell
description: Prepare to steal a spell. If you are targeted by an enemy spell which can be stolen before your next turn, you negate its casting and steal it as if you have Spell Snatched it.

name: Distortion
title: Distortion
description: Illusion skill. Manipulates waves of light around a target ally within 6 Range for 5 rounds, increasing their Evade (based on Rank).

name: Blue Steal
title: Blue Steal
description: Give an enemy within 1 Range a stern and magical look and steal FP from them equal to 5 + (Rank*5) (or their current FP, whatever is lower). Requires a stat-based roll and is modified by bonuses to steal (and counts as stealing if successful). Can only be used once per round.

name: Confusion
title: Confusion
description: Illusion skill. Target 1 enemy within 7 Range and attempts to inflict them with Confusion for 3 Rounds.

name: Create Shade
title: Create Shade
description: Illusion spell. Targets 3 separate tiles in a triangle pattern that can be sized. At each target location, you create a shade and hide yourself as one. Shades are illusions and have 1 HP, and at the start of your next turn, they will vanish. However, enemies will not be able to examine shades and tell them apart from you, making them useful decoys, especially against monsters.

name: Energy Laundering
title: Energy Laundering
description:
Move your leeched energy through various legitimate businesses and right into your pocket.

Requires Leeched Energy. Ends your Leeched Energy status and restores FP equal to the LV* X (based on Rank).

name: Invisible Weapon
title: Invisible Weapon
description: Illusion skill. Wraps yours or an ally's weapon(s) in mystery, making them almost completely transparent. While under this effect, the target's weapon's identity will be hidden. Targets attacked by invisible weapons have reduced Evade based on Rank (if they have Blind Fighting, the effect is halved).

name: Negotiate
title: Negotiate
description: Work out a mutually beneficial deal with one enemy within 5 Range. If both you and the target have a negative status effect caused by an enemy, you and the target are both cured of one of those effects randomly. Then, this effect is repeated up to Rank times, as long as the condition is met.

name: Smoke Screen
title: Smoke Screen
description: Illusion skill. Creates a harmless but obstructive 3-6 length horizontal line of smoke up to 3 Range away. The smoke cannot be seen through, and anyone standing in it suffers a penalty to Hit (based on Rank). The smoke screen will last up to 3 rounds, but if you cast this spell while a smoke screen is active, or if the smoke screen would be moved by an effect, it will disappear.

name: Spell Snatch
title: Spell Snatch
description:
The trademark skill of the Spellthief. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and attempts to steal a spell from them. Bosses are immune. If successful, you steal the spell and add it to your skill pool as a Copy spell, and the target loses it.

Copy spells are lost if unequipped and do not take up any skill pool slots, but function normally otherwise. You can have a maximum of 1+Rank Copy spells (stealing another one while at max will remove the oldest). All Copy spells will be lost if you begin a battle without Spellthief as one of your classes.

name: Bluff
title: Bluff
description:
Do you feel lucky, punk?

Can only be used if you have an Invocation spell in your skill pool. When toggled on, when you use Snatch Spell, you will pretend to be invoking a random Invocation spell in your skill pool, which just might bait your enemy into casting a spell for you to steal. (Note: This will cause Snatch Spell to use up 6 Momentum to keep up the illusion.)

name: Margin Manipulation
title: Margin Manipulation
description:
They won't notice if a little is missing from the top, will they?

Damage taken from spells is reduced by 1+X% (X = Rank*3) and stored as Leeched Energy (max LV: 10*Rank) for up to 3 rounds. Offensive spells you cast have increased Power equal to the amount of Leeched Energy you have, but after inflicting damage with one, the status will end.

name: Mysterious
title: Mysterious
description: A sense of mysterious destiny that makes someone unpredictable and unreadable. Hides your HP, FP, equipped skills, and status effects from others. Of course, since monsters aren't particularly interested in details, it won't do much against them.

name: Shuffle
title: Shuffle
description: One of the most important parts of illusions are making them less obvious, which is easy enough with a shuffle of the deck. When toggled on, when you cast Create Shade, you switch places with one of the illusions at random.

name: Tricky
title: Tricky
description: Imagine the look of surprise on your enemy's face when there's suddenly three of you. When toggled on, at the start of a battle, if Create Shade is in your skill pool, you cast it for free.

name: Free Focus
title: Free Focus
description: Is there anything better than getting something for free? Every round, recover 2 FP for every positive status effect you have that was caused by an enemy.

name: Overload Copy
title: Overload Copy
description: Since it's not yours, you don't know its limits as well. Increases the Power of Copy spells by 2*Rank.

name: Sneak Attack
title: Sneak Attack
description: They'll never see it coming. Damage dealt while you have Sneak active is increased by 10%.

name: Thrillseeker
title: Thrillseeker
description: The rush you get from stealing something is not an experience everyone gets. For those who do, however, it is a strong rush of adrenaline. When you successfully steal something from an enemy, you gain +2 to all stats for 2 rounds.

name: Versatile
title: Versatile
description:
When you get your hands on a lot of completely legitimate items, you get interested in them. So much so that you effortlessly do what most mages can't, memorizing and mastering the art of magic through pure talent.

Spells do not take up skill pool slots.

name: Energy Transfer
title: Energy Transfer
description: Supplement a summoned youkai's focus with even more of your own. By targeting a Youkai within 5 Range with this skill, you restore the FP of it by the FP cost of this skill plus a bonus (based on Rank). In addition, if you have the appropriate Affinity skill, the FP restore will be increased by the growth bonus it gives that Youkai.

name: Cracked Mirror
title: Cracked Mirror
description: Weakens the wall between your youkai and yourself, letting energies from the astral plane flow into you. Recovers FP based on Rank every round.

name: Install
title: Install
description: Grants access to Install summons. The cost of an install is equal to twice the cost of summoning the youkai and lasts 2 rounds ( +1 for Mechanations). Installed Youkai cannot be summoned, but the following happens: * Your race's base stats are replaced with the Youkai's racial base stats, excluding FAI, SAN, and APT. * You gain access to all of that Youkai's skills.. * Affinity statistical boosts are effective for you (max +1). Some Youkai may have special skills that apply if they're installed.

name: Affinity: Avian
title: Affinity: Avian
description: Shows a particular compatibility with Avian-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.

name: Affinity: Beast
title: Affinity: Beast
description: Shows a particular compatibility with Beast-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.

name: Affinity: Dragon
title: Affinity: Dragon
description: Shows a particular compatibility with Dragon-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.

name: Affinity: Fairy
title: Affinity: Fairy
description: Shows a particular compatibility with Fairy-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.

name: Affinity: Mystic
title: Affinity: Mystic
description: Shows a particular compatibility with Mystic-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.

name: Affinity: Night
title: Affinity: Night
description: Shows a particular compatibility with Night-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.

name: Affinity: Plant
title: Affinity: Plant
description: Shows a particular compatibility with Plant-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.

name: Sync-Mind
title: Sync-Mind
extras: Allows you to use the Youkai's Evoke-Active skill.
Allows you to use the Youkai's Evoke-Passive skill.
description: An advanced summoning method called 'Evoking', whereby a Youkai is only partially summoned, and its powers are channeled through the Summoner. This allows the Summoner to utilize some of the Youkai's power themself. (You do not gain any benefits while the Youkai's HP is 0.)

name: The Contract
title: The Contract
extras: Allows you to enter summoning houses and converse with youkai.
description: An agreement with an unknown entity, stating that you choose this fate of your own free will. It grants you the title and abilities of a 'Summoner'.

name: Arcane Formation
title: Arcane Formation
description:
Tactical Formation skill. Create a magical formation at a location within 5 range, which reduces FP costs for spells, and chance of invocations being broken for allies inside of it, for 3 rounds.

Range increased by 1 per 15 Scaled GUI. Duration increased by 1 round if a tome is equipped.

name: Acid Rain
title: Acid Rain
description: Rains acid down on a 2 Range circle of enemies within 5 Range, dealing Acid magic damage that ignores evasion to them. It also reduces their Phys. and Mag. Defense by X (X = 1+3*Rank%) for 3 rounds. For each enemy that is weak to Acid, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

name: Assault Order
title: Assault Order
extras: If you have a Tome equipped, the bonus damage is increased by it's power, OR 50% of scaled GUI.
description: Tactical Order skill. Order all allies to attack this turn, boosting their next attack's damage based on Rank + Tactics Rank.

name: Attack Formation
title: Attack Formation
description:
Tactical Formation skill. Create an offensive formation at a location within 5 range, which boosts the Hit of Allies inside of it, for 3 rounds.

Range increased by 1 per 15 scaled GUI. Duration increased by 1 round if Tome is equipped.

name: Dark Eye
title: Dark Eye
description: Target 3 separate tiles in a triangle pattern that can be sized. At each target location, you summon a Dark Eye. Dark Eyes have a self-detonate skill that marks enemies with Dark Eye and deals Dark magic damage to them (if they do not already have Dark Eye). Enemies marked by Dark Eye will be affected by your Analyze Weakness and Enemy Evaluation skill when it's used on any enemy, regardless of range, and increase its effect by 50%. (This skill can only be used if you do not have Dark Eyes active.)

name: Domino Resonate
title: Domino Resonate
description: Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and deals Sound magic damage to them. The damaged enemy will also be knocked 1 + Rank tiles away in a cardinal direction, and then knocked down. If they encounter any other enemies while being knocked back, the effect will also apply to the enemy, and so on. If an enemy is weak to Sound, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

name: Fire Whip
title: Fire Whip
description: Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range and deals Fire magic damage to them, based on Rank, and has a chance to inflict Hesitation LV X (X = Rank*5, plus 10). If the enemy is weak to Fire, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

name: Frigid Formation
title: Frigid Formation
description: Targets all tiles your party currently has formation tiles on. All enemies in those tiles take Ice magic damage that ignores evasion. For each enemy that is weak to Ice, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

name: Pinpoint Electro
title: Pinpoint Electro
description: Targets a single tile within 5 Range, as well as all tiles that enemy units which your Analyze Weakness and Enemy Evaluation skills are affecting (regardless of Range). Enemies in those tiles take Lightning magic damage. For each enemy that is weak to Lightning, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

name: Sacred Prism
title: Sacred Prism
description: Targets all tiles within 1 Range of yourself, and all allies. All enemies in those tiles take Light magic damage (each enemy can only be damaged once). All allies also gain X% Dark Resistance (X = 5+Rank*5) until your next turn. For each enemy that is weak to Light, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

name: Splash
title: Splash
description: Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range and inflicts Water magic damage to them, which inflicts Soaked on them for 5 + Tactics Rank rounds. Soaked enemies will cause Lightning damage taken by them to jump to adjacent allies who are also Soaked. If the enemy is weak to Water, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

name: Titan Gale
title: Titan Gale
description: Launches a spinning wind blade projectile up to 6 Range away, dealing Wind magic damage to the first enemy it hits. They will also be inflicted with Titan Ghost LV X (X = Wind ATK) for 10 rounds. (Titan Ghost transfers upon the unit being defeated, which refreshes its duration to 5 rounds. After doing so at least once, if the person with the status is an ally, it increases their Scaled Weapon Power by LV.) If the enemy is weak to Wind, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

name: White Prison
title: White Prison
description:
Summons a 3-6 Range horizontal line of walls up to 3 Range away, for 3 + Tactics Rank rounds. The walls can be attacked to destroy them (+10 HP if enchanted with Galren). Any enemies in the target location will be pushed away and take Earth magic damage. For each enemy that is weak to Earth, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

If at Tactics Rank A, cooldown is reduced 1 round. If at SSS, it is further reduced by 1 round.

name: Bunker Formation
title: Bunker Formation
description:
Tactical Formation skill. Create a defensive formation at a location within 5 Range, which boosts the Armor and Magic Armor of allies inside of it, for 3 rounds.

Range increases by 1 per Scaled GUI, Duration increased by 1 round if a tome is equipped.

name: Guard Order
title: Guard Order
extras: If you have a Tome equipped, the HP Recovery is increased by it's power, or 50% of Scaled GUI.
description: Tactical Order skill. Order allies to protect themselves this turn, granting them access to the Guard Skill. Allies who guard will recover HP based on Rank + Tactic Ranks.

name: Analyze Weakness
title: Analyze Weakness
extras: Range increased by 1 if a Tome is equipped.
description: The simplest way to win, in any scenario where victory is a possibility, is to exploit your enemy's weakness, and step one is to actually learn what it is. Targets an enemy within 3 Range and Analyzes them. You can only Analyze one enemy at a time. When Analyzed, the enemy will suffer increased damage from all party members. The duration of Analyze is (1+ Tactic Ranks) rounds. If your Tactics Rank A or better, you will also call out all of that enemy's elemental weaknesses, if any exist.

name: Cast Order
title: Cast Order
description:
Tactical Order Skill. Order all allies to utilize spells, boosting their next Offensive Category spell's damage based on Rank+Tactic Rank.

Rank 3+: Damage is further boosted by an equipped tome's power, or 50% of scaled GUI (whichever is higher.)

name: Field Medic
title: Field Medic
extras: Removes one debuff caused by an enemy.
description: Sometimes, there is no time to move someone to a safer location; They need treatment then and there. Target 1 ally within 1 range (or yourself), restoring HP based on rank, plus (Tactic Rank * 2)% of the target's max HP.

name: Charge Order
title: Charge Order
extras: If you have a Tome equipped or 30 scaled GUI, allies who end their Movement within 1 range of an enemy inflict Fear on them for 2 rounds.
description: Tactical Order skill. You give an order to all allies to charge, increasing their next Move based on Rank + (Tactics Rank/2).

name: Enemy Evaluation
title: Enemy Evaluation
extras: Range increased by 1 if a Tome is equipped.
description: Knowing your enemy is more important than knowing yourself. You perform an evaluation on a target enemy within 3 Range. The evaluation's effectiveness is based on Skill Rank and your Tactics Rank. Evaluated enemies suffer a penalty to Hit, Evade, Critical, and damage they deal (equal to 10+Tactics Rank+Skill Rank%). The duration of the evaluation is equal to 1 + Tactics Rank rounds. (If you are defeated, the evaluation immediately ends.).

name: Volley Formation
title: Volley Formation
description:
Tactical Formation skill. Create a ranged formation at a location within 5 range. Which boosts the attack range (and range before Farshot penalty applies), and critical of ranged weapons for allies inside of it for 3 rounds.

Range increased by 1 per scaled GUI. Duration increased by 1 round if a tome is equipped.

name: Dualpower
title: Dualpower
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill point slot.
description: Toggle skill. Sometimes power doesn't need to be raw. It is far more effective if it is tempered by experience. While toggled on, increases the STR scaling of Tomes by 10%, and the WIL scaling of Swords by 10%.

name: On My Mark
title: On My Mark
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill point slot.
description: Give your allies the boost they need by giving them orders to follow. At the start of a battle, automatically applies your first Order skill you have equipped. Additionally, increase the duration of your order skills by 1 round (they still only apply once).

name: According to Plan
title: According To Plan
description: The book just isn't for show. It holds detailed reports of a number of battles, information about the types of soil various places have, and other such valuable information. It also shoots out magic, which a lot of people don't expect. Taking advantage of that will restore your Focus Points based on Rank when you hit an enemy with a Tome weapon attack. The bonus is also increased based on your Tactics Rank.

name: Always Learning
title: Always Learning
description:
Both victories and defeats are important to learn from. For victories, you can learn strengths, and from defeats. You can learn flaws. The Tactician knows this well and passes that onto his allies. Increasing Experience Point gains for them by 10%.

Additionally, passively increases your WIL and GUI, based on Rank.

name: Performance Rating
title: Performance Rating
extras: If you do not learn this skill, your Tactics Rank will be stuck at D.
description: Tacticians are only as good as their tactics. In battle, a gauge will appear in the bottom left, displaying a ranking from D to SSS, known as your Tactics Rank. Some Tactician skills will be influenced by your Tactics Rank. Your Tactics Rank increases in different ways when you use Tactician skills. It will be reset to D if an ally is reduced to 0 HP. It will also drop by 1 level every time you take damage (as long as that damage is greater than 5% of your maximum HP).

name: Timely Withdraw
title: Timely Withdraw
description: Sometimes it's best to know when to go. A retreat is a much less costly strategic move than a defeat. When escaping from battle, the success rate is increased by 20% for every player character's HP that is below 25%. If at Tactics Rank S or higher, the success rate becomes 100%.

name: Axe Kick
title: Axe Kick
description:
Hare Discipline technique. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and deals physical Blunt damage, plus bonus Ice magic damage if Ice Point Guard is active (50% Ice ATK).

If you are airborne and have Ice Point Guard, the target is knocked down and knocked away 1 tile. The Ice Point Guard is then deployed in front of you.

name: Cold Front
title: Cold Front
description:
Bear Discipline technique. Targets an enemy in 1 Range, or a tile in 1 Range (if you have Ice Point Guard, or one exists in it), launching it up up to X tiles (2 + Rank) or until it encounters an enemy. The enemy hit by this skill takes Blunt damage and is knocked back based on how close they are when hit.

Bonus effects may occur while Ice Point Greaves, or if an enemy collides into an Ice Point.

name: Crawling Spikes
title: Crawling Spikes
description:
Fox Discipline technique. Targets a line; spikes travel along that line. If it encounters an Ice Point, it will move in another line to another Ice Point within 5 Range, or an enemy within 5 Range.

*Tiles crossed are covered in Ice Sheets (2 rounds).

*Enemies hit take Ice magic damage (+50% if hit more than once, to a max of +200%).

*Can jump a maximum of 5 times.

name: Expanding Ice
title: Expanding Ice
description: Fox Discipline technique. Targets all areas in a cardinal direction from any Ice Sheets you or allies have created. Any enemies within the affected area take Ice magic damage. (Enemies cannot be damaged more than once). Furthermore, all affected areas are covered in Ice Sheets for 3 rounds, and the duration of your existing Ice Sheets becomes 3 rounds.

name: Face Stomp
title: Face Stomp
description:
Hare Discipline technique. Targets 1 enemy within 3 Range that is Knocked Down and has an unoccupied tile next to them, and deals Blunt physical damage to them.

If Ice Point Guard is active, it is deployed to the target's tile. Otherwise, the target is cured of Knocked Down (without paying Momentum).

name: Icicle Spear
title: Icicle Spear
description:
Fox Discipline technique. Targets 2 locations; Location 1 must contain an Ice Point or Ice Point Guard (or you with IPG active), Location 2 must be 1 tile adjacent to that location.

Transform the target Ice Point into a spear of ice that travels up to 5 tiles (tiles with Ice Sheets do not count), dealing Ice magic damage to all enemies it encounters and may inflict Frostbite LV25 for 3 rounds.

If the target is an Ice Point Guard, travels infinitely, the skill's damage is increased by 50%, but stops upon hitting one enemy, and inflicts them with Frozen LV 200 for one round.

name: Point Kick
title: Point Kick
description: Bear Discipline technique. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and deals physical Blunt damage. This kick puts your target into the air as if they were a ball waiting to be punted, making them Airborne.

name: Rapid Kick
title: Rapid Kick
description:
Hare Discipline technique. Targets an enemy in 1 Range, or a tile in 1 Range (if you or that tile have Ice Point Guard) and kicks it X times (X = 3+Rank).

If the target is an enemy, it deals Blunt physical damage. Each kick applies half of Ice Point Greaves' damage. Otherwise, each kick launches three projectiles that deal Ice magic damage which ignore armor (50% Ice atk + bonus kick damage) and puts the skill on a 3 round CD. Reduces the duration of the Ice Point Guard it targets by 1.

name: Rising Kick
title: Rising Kick
description: Bear Discipline technique. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and deals physical Blunt damage. As part of the motion, you rise into the air, making yourself Airborne.

name: Ice Point Guard
title: Ice Point Guard
description:
Targets an Ice Point or Ice Point Guard within 5 Range and turns it into a shield of ice, granting several bonuses (5 rounds):

*30+(Scaled SKI/2)% chance to parry martial weapon attacks/skills (30% reduction).

*Can use Guard.

*Can enhance certain Verglas skills.

*Using this skill while you have 4 Momentum or less grants Guard LV 30 for 1 round.

name: Ice Skate
title: Ice Skate
description: Must target an ice sheet in 1 Range. You then skate along the ice, stopping only when you fail to move or encounter a tile without an ice sheet on it, knocking aside all battle participants in your way, friend or foe. If you have skated for at least X (based on Rank) tiles, enemies knocked away will also be knocked down.

name: Insulate
title: Insulate
description: Targets 1 ally within 3 Range and protects them from the harshness of the cold, increasing their Ice Resistance (based on rank) for 3 rounds. For the same duration, they do not trigger any Ice Sheets by walking on them. It will also cure Frostbite and provide immunity to it for the duration.

name: Ice Point
title: Ice Point
description:
Create an Ice Point (3 rounds) at target location in 4 Range. Enemies at that location are pushed back away from it and take Ice magic damage equal to your Ice ATK. Afterwards, all tiles within 1 Range are covered in Ice Sheets (3 rounds).

If there is already an Ice Sheet at that location and no enemy is hit, Ice Sheets spawn in 3 Range instead and 2 Momentum is refunded.

name: Ice Point Greaves
title: Ice Point Greaves
description: Targets an Ice Point within 5 Range, leaps to it, and turns it into a pair of icey boots (5 rounds). For the duration, the user does not trigger Ice Sheets, leaves behind Ice Sheets for 2 rounds while moving, and deals bonus Ice magic damage (50% of Ice ATK) that ignores armor (based on Rank) when using a Verglas skill that kicks, or the Kick maneuver.

name: Winter's Bite
title: Winter's Bite
description: Targets an enemy within 3 Range. For 3 rounds, any properties that grant certain effects against Ice damage are negated. The types negated are based on Rank. In addition, the target takes additional Ice damage equal to 1+Rank for the duration.

name: Brain Freeze
title: Brain Freeze
description: The icy chill of your movements locks down your enemies. When you evade a basic attack, a random skill the attacker has equipped is put on a 1 round cooldown (or 2 rounds if you have an Ice Point Guard active).

name: Chimera Style
title: Chimera Style
description: When you use a Verglas discipline skill, the Momentum cost of all skills of a different discipline are reduced by 1 for the rest of the round. (You can only gain this effect once per round.)

name: Bear's Might
title: Bear's Might
description: The discipline of the bear teaches that there is little one can do against overwhelming power. While in Bear Stance, when you deal Ice damage, you gain a stacking status that grants +5 Power and +5 Critical Damage (up to +30) for 10 rounds. (This status loses 5 LV every round you are not in Bear Stance. When it reaches 0, it ends.)

name: Fox's Cunning
title: Fox's Cunning
description: The discipline of the Fox teaches that knowledge can act as a wedge. While in Fox Stance, when you deal Ice damage, you gain a stacking status that grants +5 Ice ATK (up to +30) for 10 rounds. (This status loses 5 LV every round you are not in Fox Stance. When it reaches 0, it ends.)

name: Hare's Agility
title: Hare's Agility
description: The discipline of the Hare teaches that not every battle is worth fighting. While in Hare Stance, when you deal Ice damage, you gain a stacking status that grants +5 Evade (up to +30) for 10 rounds. (This status loses 5 LV every round you are not in Hare Stance. When it reaches 0, it ends.)

name: Permafrost
title: Permafrost
description: A type of mastery that increases the quality of ice created through spirituality. Increases the duration of all Ice Point skills by Rank.

name: Black Bolt
title: Black Bolt
extras: Rank 2: Silences for 2 roundsRank 3: Teleports to random squareRank 4: Inflicts Interference for 3 roundsRank 5: Covers ground near target in Void Pollution, doubling spell costs
description: Target enemy takes Dark magic damage equal to your current Void Energy. This will consume all Void Energy you have accumulated. Gains bonus effects based on Rank if enough Void Energy is consumed (10*Rank Effect). Can also be used with Veil Off active; It'll use its LV instead, and then end the effect.

name: Cutthroat
title: Cutthroat
description: Dagger skill. Can only target an enemy that you are directly behind. Performs a basic attack on the target with a modifier to your Hit, which if successful, may inflict Silence on the target for 2 rounds (3 rounds on Critical Hit). If Veil Off is active, the effect is guaranteed.

name: Detogate
title: Detogate
description: Targets one of your Voidgates within 7 range, and causes it to explode, dealing Dark magic damage to all enemies within 4 range of it. They will also be teleported to a random battlefield tile.

name: Eliminate
title: Eliminate
description:
Dagger skill. Uses up 3+M and consumes all Void Energy. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range (or 7 Range if Airborne; you move next to them) and deals Slash damage, and then Pierce damage, which ignores evasion. Damage is increased by (Void Energy consumed)%, plus 40% if you are Sneaking. If the target is a non-boss, non-player character, it also has a chance equal to the damage bonus to instantly kill the target (if the target's level is equal or less than your level +10).

If a target is defeated by this attack, all enemies will be inflicted with Fear for the rest of the battle.

name: Fray
title: Fray
description:
Dagger skill. Targets 1 Enemy or 1 Voidgate in Range.

Enemy: You slash the target wildly, dealing physical Slash damage. Their Phys. DEF is also reduced by 2*Rank for 3 rounds. If Veil Off is active, it also reduces Mag. Def by same amount.

Voidgate: The Voidgate becomes unstable, preventing teleportation, but causing it to release bolts of void energy (on activation and every round) which deal Dark magic damage. If you are in the path of a bolt, you will gain Void Energy equal to half its damage.

name: Vanishing Strike
title: Vanishing Strike
description: Dagger skill. Consumes 10 Void Energy. Targets 2 locations. In Location 1, there must be an enemy, and Location 2 must be an unoccupied tile. The enemy in L1 takes Pierce damage, based on Rank, and is teleported to your current location. Afterwards, you teleport to L2.

name: Dark Shield
title: Dark Shield
description: Passive: Grants Dark resistance based on Rank. Active: Consumes all available Void Energy and envelops yourself or target ally in a Dark Shield which increases RES by 1 + 1 per 5 Void Energy consumed. This shield lasts for 2 Rounds + 1 Round per 10 Void Energy consumed.

name: Black Elixir
title: Black Elixir
description: Consumes 20 Void Energy. Targets 1 Ally within 4 Range and wraps them in a healing-accelerating energy, granting them Regeneration LV X (based on Rank) for 5 rounds.

name: Blotch
title: Blotch
description: Consumes 10 Void Energy to use. Targets 1 Enemy or 1 Ally (or yourself). Enemy: Reduces their Hit based on Rank for 3 rounds. Ally: Increases their Evade based on Rank for 3 rounds and increases their Dark ATK.

name: Ignite Engine
title: Ignite Engine
description: Consumes 10 Void Energy to use. Targets 1 summoned ally (Youkai, mechs, etc) within 5 Range. For 5 rounds, the target's basic attacks, on hit, will deal Dark magic damage equal to a percentage of your Dark ATK. However, they will also lose HP equal to 15% of their maximum HP every round.

name: Wash Away
title: Wash Away
description:
Consumes 20 Void Energy to use. Targets 1 Enemy or 1 Ally (or yourself) in 2+Rank Range. Enemy: Dispels 1 beneficial status effect. Ally: Cures 1 negative status effect.

If you're standing on Void Pollution, the effect is repeated two additional times.

name: Absorb Veil
title: Absorb Veil
description: Break down your Void Energy into Focus, which you then absorb. Using this skill will restore FP equal to your current Void Energy, and reduce it to 0. You can also use this while you have Veil Off active to end the status prematurely, and regain FP equal to half of its LV

name: Extend Void
title: Extend Void
description: Consumes 20 Void Energy. Extends the duration of all of your Voidgates by 3 rounds, and all positive status effects you have by 2 rounds.

name: Obscure
title: Obscure
description: When activated, the Void Assassin hides themselves in obscurity, removing certain status effects that would pinpoint or bring attention to themselves. (Affected Statuses: Glowing, Enemy Evaluation, Analyze Weakness, Hunted, Claret Call, Marked for Death, Watchful Eye)

name: Veil Off
title: Veil Off
description: Removes your Voidveil and consumes the energy it collected, gaining Critical equal to the stored energy for X turns (based on Rank). Your Void Energy then becomes 0. While you are under this effect, Voidveil's effects are negated.

name: Voidgate
title: Voidgate
description:
Targets an empty location or Voidgate in Range. Location: Creates a Voidgate at the target location for X rounds (based on Rank). Voidgate: You leap into the Void and instantly reappear at the Voidgate's location. Teleporting refunds 2M and half the cost of the skill.

If, instead. The Voidgate is Frayed, you manipulate it into firing, but also reduce its duration by 1.

name: Advancing Flow
title: Advancing Flow
description: Toggle Skill. Evasive Reaction skill (only one takes effect at a time). While toggled on, when you evade an attack, you briefly fade into the void, causing you to move 1 tile towards the attacker. If you moved, you also generate Void Energy, based on Rank.

name: Blind Spot
title: Blind Spot
extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
description: Leave your foes wondering where you went. Teleporting to a Voidgate that is not in the line of sight of an enemy will grant you Sneak for 2 rounds.

name: Charred Void
title: Charred Void
description: Taint fire with darkness. When you create a Cinder tile, if you have at least 1 Void Energy, it will be consumed and turn it into a Dark Cinder. (Happens on a per-tile basis.)

name: Dangerous Dip
title: Dangerous Dip
description: By exposing yourself to the void while teleporting, you can gain valuable Void Energy, but it's a risk. When you teleport to a Voidgate, you generate 3 Void Energy, but take 5 unresistable Null damage.

name: Deadly Arms
title: Deadly Arms
description: The Void Assassin is particularly adept at using daggers, capable of hurting people with them like almost no one else. Increases Critical Damage of Daggers by 10%.

name: Impure Element
title: Impure Element
description: Use the power of the void to boost your magic. Upon taking Fire, Ice, Wind, Lightning, or Earth damage, gain Impure Element of the same element. Impure Element increases your Elemental ATK of that element by 10 (if monoclassing Void Assassin, by your Void Energy instead). However, using any skill that uses that Elemental ATK causes you to take damage equal to half of that amount. (Taking damage will reset the status to a new element.)

name: Revile Fray
title: Revile Fray
description: Outfit your veil with sharp blades. When you teleport to a Voidgate, after teleporting through it, you automatically Fray it.

name: Void Flight
title: Void Flight
description: Carried into the air by another dimension. When a unit, including yourself, is teleported by a Void Assassin skill, that unit becomes Airborne.

name: Void Refraction
title: Void Refraction
description: When an allied projectile encounters one of your Voidgates, it disappears, but a copy of that projectile will shoot from every other Voidgate you own in a cardinal direction towards the nearest enemy.

name: Void Reverb
title: Void Reverb
description: Retain your energy as much as possible, at any cost. If you would consume at least 2 Void Energy, reduce the amount by half, but take Null damage equal to the amount reduced.

name: Voidveil
title: Voidveil
description: While wearing an armor made of a Cloth material, it is covered in an almost invisible mesh called the Voidveil. When you take magic damage, you reduce the damage by X% of the damage and gain a special Void energy equal to twice that amount (based on Rank; if Void Assassin is not your main class, no damage reduction is applied). Void Energy is used by other Void Assassin skills, and it persists through multiple battles.

name: Backstab
title: Backstab
description: Backstabbing is an art; an art where you stab your enemies in the back. When you attack an enemy with a dagger while directly behind them, you deal bonus Damage and gain Critical for that attack based on Rank.

name: Black and Blue
title: Black and Blue
description: The skill to apply the term to your enemies, and the resistance to avoid the reverse. Increases SKI and RES passively based on Rank.

name: Break Down
title: Break Down
description: Almost as good as dealing the finishing blow. When you deal a critical hit with Cutthroat, the enemy is also Knocked Down.

name: Radiation
title: Radiation
description: If you have Voidveil equipped, you absorb energy from the Void for yourself. Passively generate a small amount of Void Energy every round based on Rank.

name: Void Circuit
title: Void Circuit
description: Create a circuit of void energy back into your veil through lightning. When you score a lightning critical, you generate Void Energy, based on Rank.
